descriptionZh: 一张非常细致的广度幻想海报,展示了完全108种独特的奇比神话生物,排列在同心的曼达拉环中,是装饰性的关键艺术或展示插图的理想.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed wide fantasy poster showing exactly 108 unique chibi mythical creatures arranged in concentric mandala rings, ideal for decorative key art or showcase illustrations.
promptZh:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. Include fox-like, rabbit-like, cat-like, wolf-like, lion-like, bird-like, dragon-like, deer-like, and hybrid beast characters, all rendered in a cute super-deformed style but with epic high-fantasy armor, robes, crowns, feathers, horns, gems, capes, staffs, and magical accessories. Make every character visually distinct through color, silhouette, species traits, and elemental theme, while preserving a unified painterly anime-fantasy aesthetic.

Use a rich palette dominated by luminous gold, ivory, cream, violet, indigo, sapphire, and soft amber, with accents of crimson, icy cyan, emerald, and sunset orange. Give the image the feel of a sacred celestial chart or zodiac wheel, with each circular band separated by elegant gilded borders and arc dividers. Add glowing magical energy, sparkles, halos, swirling fire, mist, snow, clouds, water splashes, lightning curls, floral motifs, and celestial particles around many of the characters. Around the outer perimeter, place several larger decorative guardian illustrations integrated into the border: a bright sun medallion at the upper left, a white phoenix-like bird in a circular panel at the upper right, a floral or starburst medallion at the lower right, and a fiery character cluster in a circular panel at the lower left, plus additional large elemental beast figures embedded along the left and right edges. Frame the entire artwork with an elaborate antique ornamental border inspired by illuminated manuscripts and fantasy tarot designs, using filigree, corner medallions, geometric trim, and arcane motifs.

The rendering should be extremely dense and crisp, like a 4k fantasy illustration meant for a poster print, with tiny readable character silhouettes across the whole image, intricate linework, soft watercolor-textured shading, glowing highlights, and a polished collectible-card-game concept art finish. Emphasize abundance, harmony, and radial order: exactly 108 chibi figures total, arranged as a majestic mandala of mythical elemental mascots.

descriptionZh: A complex prompt for generating a grid of nostalgic, lo-fi digital snapshots capturing the life of an Akihabara otaku in the early 2010s, featuring specific atmospheric lighting and JPEG artifact effects.
descriptionEn: A complex prompt for generating a grid of nostalgic, lo-fi digital snapshots capturing the life of an Akihabara otaku in the early 2010s, featuring specific atmospheric lighting and JPEG artifact effects.
promptZh:
16:9の2K画像を以下のプロンプトに基づいて3×3のグリッド画像を４枚作成して。
深夜～早朝の2010年代アキバ系オタク男子（平成後期〜令和初期の典型的なアキバ系）をテーマにしたエモーショナルな画像。但し、写真シチュエーションは<テーマ>の中から重複しないようにランダムに選んでください。
2010年代のコンパクトデジタルカメラまたはiPhone 4〜X時代の直射フラッシュを使用したスナップショットスタイル。
デジタルノイズ、軽いJPEGアーティファクト、周辺減光、暖色系のフェードトーンと少しオーバーサチュレーションが特徴的。
2010年代〜2020年初頭のデジタル写真特有のノスタルジックで生々しい質感。
儚く、少しデジタル臭い2010sスナップ写真風。
<テーマ>
・深夜のアキバ中央通り — ネオンと看板に照らされて歩く
・メイド喫茶の出口 — 萌え袖をはめたメイドと記念撮影
・ゲーセン（秋葉原）の格ゲー筐体前 — 対戦終わりに汗だくでハイタッチ
・UFOキャッチャー前 — 取ったフィギュアやぬいぐるみを自慢げに見せる
・プリクラ機の中 — フレームにデコられた痛車シール貼り
・アニメイト深夜 — 新刊ラノベや同人誌を抱えてレジ待ち
・マンガ喫茶の個室 — ブランケットにくるまりながらノートPCでエロゲー
・終電の山手線 — 痛バッグとフィギュアの袋を抱えて寝落ち
・始発電車待ちのネットカフェ — モニターの光だけが顔を照らす
・ラブホ街の路地 — ネオンに照らされた秋葉原の裏路地でたばこ
・屋上駐車場 — 夜景をバックに痛車を自慢しながらスマホチェック
・秋葉原の駅ホーム — 厚底スニーカーやドレスシューズで走る
・ゲームソフト中古店前 — 深夜閉店後に袋いっぱいの獲物を並べて撮影
・カラオケボックス — アニソン熱唱＆タンバリン（またはコスプレ）
・牛丼屋（すき家）深夜 — 夜明け前に大盛り牛丼を頬張る
・ファミレス（ガスト） — トレカやスリーブを並べてデッキ構築
・クレーンゲームの筐体前 — 景品のエロゲやフィギュアを大量ゲット
・TSUTAYA秋葉原店深夜 — アニメBD特典付きを物色
・コンビニの駐車場 — 深夜に新作ゲームの発売日を待つ行列
・タクシーの後部座席 — 痛バッグだらけの荷物と一緒に
・観覧車ゴンドラ内 — 夜景をバックに萌えグッズを見せる
・神社の境内 — 深夜に同人誌即売会の打ち上げ
・スマホ自撮り（フロントカメラ） — 部屋にフィギュア棚が映り込む
・路上でコスプレ調整 — 駅近くの路地でウィッグ直し
・朝帰りの始発電車 — 徹夜明けで疲れ果てて寝落ち
・エレベーター内 — メイド服の女の子と一緒（微妙に距離を取る）
・秋葉原の屋台ラーメン — 〆にこってりラーメンをすする
・自宅マンションの階段 — 段ボールだらけの通販荷物と一緒に
・PCパーツショップ前 — 深夜セール後の巨大なPCケースを抱える
・朝日のアキバ中央通り — スクランブル交差点のような人混みで佇む

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a polished Chinese feng shui annual flying star infographic poster for reference, educational content, or social media sharing.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a polished Chinese feng shui annual flying star infographic poster for reference, educational content, or social media sharing.
promptZh: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. Center the composition around a 3x3 grid of 9 bordered square panels with thin ornamental Chinese-style corners, evenly spaced and perfectly aligned. Each square contains a large colored number, a Chinese star name, one line beginning with 吉星 or 凶星, and an illustrative symbolic object. Top row has 3 panels: top-left labeled 东南 with a purple-framed panel for number 9 and text 九紫右弼星, plus 吉星: 喜庆、姻缘、贵人, illustrated with purple balloons, a gift box, and a small firework burst; top-center labeled 正南 with an orange-framed panel for number 5 and text 五黄廉贞星, plus 凶星: 灾祸、意外、疾病, illustrated with a gold gourd and ancient Chinese coins tied with a red tassel; top-right labeled 西南 with a gold-framed panel for number 7 and text 七赤破军星, plus 凶星: 破财、口舌、盗贼, illustrated with a brass bell and a silver sword. Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

promptZh: An ultra-wide 360-degree equirectangular panoramic view of a futuristic contemporary art gallery exhibition about artificial intelligence, designed for immersive VR viewing. The scene is inside a vast dark-ceilinged museum hall with exposed rigging, many small spotlights, polished reflective concrete floors, and curved white exhibition walls wrapping continuously across the panorama. The environment is filled with {argument name="visitor count" default="about 25"} adult visitors in smart casual and business attire, standing in small conversational groups and scattered around the room, with subtle face blur or indistinct facial detail. At the exact center of the panorama is a circular installation platform containing a tall translucent holographic human figure made of white glowing particles and vertical strands of light, suspended beneath a large circular ceiling ring. On the left side, show a white robotic arm sculpture on a round pedestal in front of a giant wall artwork depicting a luminous side-profile human head composed of particles and constellation-like dots. Across the walls, include 6 visible AI-themed artworks total: 1 giant particle head mural, 3 framed cosmic nebula or galaxy images, 1 large monochrome abstract painting, and 1 tall colorful starfield-like digital piece in the far right background. On the right foreground, place a large transparent cube installation containing a swirling spiral galaxy projection in blue, violet, and white. descriptionZh: 一个非常详细的创建3D效果插图的提示,其中人物从现实的社交媒体简介UI中突出.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed prompt for creating a 3D effect illustration where a character breaks out of a realistic social media profile UI.
promptZh:
创作一幅超逼真的 3D 插画，描绘一个略微倾斜的 {argument name="平台" default="Twitter/X"} 个人资料页面，背景为简洁的灰色。保留原有的卡通头像。界面必须与真实的 X 截图相似，包含真实的布局、认证徽章、粉丝统计、个人资料横幅和推文部分。

个人资料详情：

一位时尚的{argument name="人物" default="年轻男子"}，有着蓬松的亮黑色短发和白皙的皮肤，从个人资料页面的右侧撕开的纸片中跃然而出。他保留了原有的面部特征，只是将表情改为{argument name="表情" default="自然自信的微笑"}。他握着撕开的纸片边缘，纸屑四处飞溅，营造出强烈的 3D 突破效果。

柔和的影棚灯光、电影级的阴影、景深、超高细节、清晰的焦点、逼真的皮肤、逼真的 UI 反射、优质的构图、4K 分辨率、逼真与微妙的皮克斯风格融合。

重要提示：
- 请勿更改头像
- 保持 X UI 界面准确
- 保留原有的面部特征
- 角色为男性
- 仅增强笑容
- 确保所有中文文字清晰易读
promptEn:
Creates a super-real 3D illustration of a slightly tilted {argument name= platform'default=`tweet/X'} personal data page with a simple grey background. Keep the original cartoon header. The interface must be similar to a real X screenshot and contain a real layout, a certified badge, fan statistics, a banner of personal data and tweets.

Personal details:

A fashionable {argument name= "person" default= "young man"} with loose, short-haired black hair and white skin, leaps out of paper torn from the right side of a personal data page. He kept his original facial features, but changed his expression to {argument name= expression’s default=’s smile of natural confidence}. He held the edge of the torn piece of paper and splattered it around, creating a strong 3D breakthrough.

Soft studio lights, film-class shadows, depths, super-high details, clear focus, hard skin, real UI reflections, high quality images, 4K resolution, realism and subtle Pixar style.

Important tip:
- Don't change your head.
- Keep X UI interface accurate
- Retain original facial features
- Men.
- Just a smile.
- Make sure all Chinese texts are clear and easy to read.

titleZh: 3D 现实 X 配置接口
descriptionZh: 基于带有特定字符表达的参考截图生成超现实化的3D社交媒体配置界面的详细提示.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for generating a hyper-realistic 3D social media profile interface based on a reference screenshot with specific character expressions.
promptZh: 根据上传的我的X个人主页截图，生成一幅{argument name="风格" default="超写实"}的3D推特/X个人资料界面插图，略微倾斜，背景干净简洁，灰色极简。原始头像保持不变。个人资料界面完全匹配一张真实的X截图，屏幕右侧边缘，根据上传头像图片中的人物，他正冲破破损的纸张。他的面部特征完全相同（不改变脸部），但现在拥有了自然的灿烂笑容、富有表现力的眼睛和柔和发光的皮肤。他手握着撕裂的纸边，画面中呈现出动态的3D效果。 纸片飞溅，营造出逼真的突破幻觉。灯光是柔和的摄影棚灯光，带有电影般的阴影和景深。超细致，4K，写实+皮克斯风格的混色，清晰对焦。重要提示：- 不要更改头像（DP） - 保持完全相同的 X 界面布局和文本样式 - 保持他们的原始面貌身份 - 仅能将表情增强为自然的微笑 - 比例 {argument name="比例" default="9:16"}
promptEn: According to my uploaded screenshot of my X home page, a 3D Twitter/X personal data interface illustration of {argument name= "style" = "overwritten"} was generated, slightly tilted, with a clean background and a very simple grey background. The original image remains unchanged. The personal data interface fully matched a real X screenshot on the right side of the screen, which, according to the person in the upload image, was breaking broken paper. His facial features are identical (without changing his face), but now he has a natural smile, a performing eye and a soft and glowing skin. He was holding torn pieces of paper with a dynamic 3D effect. Paper splatter to create a real breakthrough. The light is a soft studio light with film-like shadows and depths. Super nuanced, 4K, paper-plus pixie, clear focus. Important tip: - - Do not change the header (DP) - Keep the exact same X interface layout and text style - Keep their original face identity - Only enhance the expression to a natural smile - {argument name= "scale"= "9:16"}

promptEn: An overwritten 3D illustration depicts a slightly tilted Twitter/X personal data interface with a simple black background. The original image remains the same. The personal data interface is fully consistent with a graph 2 with the user name "{argument name="user name" default= "Aigirl"}, with an authentication badge, a detailed personal profile, number of fans and tweets. On the right side of the screen, one {argument name= character=chart1} Her five officials are the same as the original figure (with no changes to her face), but now she has a natural smile, a moving look and a soft and bright skin. Half of her body got off the screen and jumped out of the screen with a moving 3D effect. The screen was broken and the prints were shaking. Lights use soft studio lights with film shadows and deep view. It's a very fine 4-K resolution, it's a real integration with Pixar style, it's clear and it's popular on ArtStation. Important tip: - Do not change the face (DP) - Keep the X interface configuration and text style unchanged - Keep the original face of the girl - Only adjust the face to a natural smile

descriptionZh: A detailed prompt for generating a professional, moody sneaker advertisement with complex typography, shallow depth of field, and urban textures.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for generating a professional, moody sneaker advertisement with complex typography, shallow depth of field, and urban textures.
promptZh:
A hyperrealistic Nike sneaker advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male leg wearing crisp white athletic crew socks with subtle Nike logo detail is suspended mid-air against a near-black charcoal background, angled diagonally toward the camera at a bold 45-degree perspective. The sneaker — a Nike low-top silhouette featuring a clean two-tone colorway of {argument name="color scheme" default="glacier teal suede panels and off-white tumbled leather"}, with an iridescent chrome Swoosh catching ambient light — dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the shoe and soft blur on the upper leg. The background is layered with subtle urban texture - faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the sneaker at different angles, reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}" - evoking motion, speed, and energy. Some text runs vertically, some at 30-degree angles, giving the composition a chaotic yet intentional graphic design feeling.
At the upper right, the bold Nike wordmark and Swoosh logo appear in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads: "PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large, commanding headline is placed center-right in contrasting weight typography - "MOVE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "BEYOND" in lighter weight, creating dramatic type hierarchy.
Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the composition as accent details, adding a contemporary graphic zine aesthetic. Bottom left features a bold brand slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR STRIDE" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline: "An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional - a single cold key light from the left, causing the Swoosh to shimmer and the white leather to glow against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution, 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.

descriptionZh: 一个非常细致的结构化的提示,将人物形象转化为由笔记和符号组成的抽象艺术.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed structured prompt that transforms a character image into abstract art composed of notes and symbols.
promptZh:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。

promptZh:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.

descriptionEn: A realistic smartphone chat-app screenshot showing a Japanese prompt and the resulting dense medical-style anatomical infographic, ideal for recreating viral AI image demo posts.
promptZh: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

promptZh: A comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray square grid, designed like a social media test result poster. At the top are 2 large side-by-side titles in bold sans serif text: “GPT image 2” above the left image and “Nano Banana” above the right image. Below them are 2 vertically oriented illustrated posters placed next to each other with a small gap. Both posters depict the same concept: a hand-drawn foodie walking map of Guangzhou in Chinese, but rendered in 2 different visual styles. The left poster is more detailed, textured, dense, and richly illustrated, while the right poster is cleaner, flatter, and simpler. The left poster has a warm cream paper background and an intricate vintage hand-painted travel-map style with fine linework, watercolor texture, decorative flowers and lychee fruits, miniature buildings, roads, river areas, and many food illustrations. The large Chinese title at the top of the left poster reads “广州 吃货暴走地图”. The map includes roughly 12 featured food spots distributed across the city, each shown as a small food illustration with Chinese labels and short handwritten-style annotations. Visible foods include skewers, roast poultry, noodle dishes, clay pot dishes, rice rolls, dumplings, soups, and dessert bowls, with landmarks such as the Canton Tower and riverfront scenery integrated into the map. The right poster also has the Chinese title “广州 吃货暴走地图” and shows the same general idea but in a cleaner infographic-like map style with simplified roads, icons, floral and lychee border decorations, food callouts, a river, the Canton Tower, and approximately 12 labeled food illustrations around the map. At the bottom of the overall comparison graphic is 1 rounded black text panel with a white outline. Attached to its upper left edge is 1 bright yellow rounded tab label reading “提示词” in bold black Chinese characters. Inside the black panel is a block of white Chinese text describing the image-generation prompt; it appears as a multi-line paragraph. The composition is centered, high contrast, and presented as a polished AI image comparison post for Chinese social media, with crisp typography, poster-like symmetry, and a clean test-benchmark aesthetic.

Around it, include material samples, decorative pattern examples, a horizontal row of 6 circular color swatches, construction details, and a bottom strip with 4 small human figure diagrams showing wearing sequence or silhouette comparison. Make the right poster feel more graphic-design driven, with sharper contrast and more vivid red accents. At the bottom of the overall image, add a large rounded black text box with a thin white outline spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label tab on its upper-left corner containing the Chinese word “提示词” in bold black text. Inside the black box, place a dense paragraph of white Chinese text describing the test prompt for generating a Hanfu-themed decomposition chart, resembling a screenshot quote block. The whole composition should look like a social media comparison graphic, centered, cleanly aligned, high resolution, with strong contrast between the dark background and the two poster panels.

promptZh: A vertical social-media comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray grid, designed like a clean tech review graphic. At the top are two large side-by-side headings: on the left, bright yellow text reading “GPT image 2”; on the right, white text reading “Nano Banana”. Below the headings are 2 tall poster mockups placed side by side with narrow spacing, each in an off-white paper style. The left mockup shows a traditional Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by Journey to the West, with large vertical Chinese calligraphy “西游记” near the upper left, muted sepia and gray watercolor mountains, cliffs, mist, temple architecture, and 4 tiny human figures visible in the composition: 2 heroic figures near the upper middle on a rocky ledge, plus 2 travelers lower in the scene; a swirling luminous mist vortex appears near the lower area. The right mockup shows a more graphic surreal poster built inside the side-profile silhouette of a human head facing left, filled with a Chinese fantasy landscape including pagodas, water, paths, figures, and the vertical title “西游记” inside the silhouette; the silhouette is painted in dark navy and black watercolor with cream paper around it. Each of the 2 posters has a large centered vertical rectangular blur censor block over the middle area, with soft edges and gray-beige color. Along the bottom is a rounded black caption panel with a thin white outline. Attached to its upper left corner is a bright yellow pill-shaped label containing the Chinese text “提示词” in bold black. Inside the bottom panel is a block of bold white Chinese text in multiple lines. The text should read: “西游记主题收藏版史诗海报，人物侧脸剪影中生长出完整世界观与经典场景。整体偏电影海报和梦幻水彩插画风，安静、宏大、神圣、怀旧，带纸张颗粒、轻雾感、飞白刷痕与高级留白。” The overall style is a polished Chinese tech comparison thumbnail, high contrast, editorial layout, centered composition, 4:5 portrait aspect ratio.

descriptionZh: A richly illustrated vintage-style tourism poster showing a five-stop one-day itinerary through Alishan National Scenic Area, ideal for travel marketing and destination infographics.
descriptionEn: A richly illustrated vintage-style tourism poster showing a five-stop one-day itinerary through Alishan National Scenic Area, ideal for travel marketing and destination infographics.
promptZh: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

promptZh: A bright, polished anime-style promotional thumbnail with a summer romance atmosphere. The composition is split visually, with large typography on the left and two handsome young men on the right. Add three lines of Japanese text arranged between and under them: "最新の画像生成で", "作って", and "遊んでみた", in deep blue calligraphic Japanese type. Include subtle decorative accents such as small star glints, diagonal light streaks, dotted texture, and a cyan underline swoosh beneath the middle text. On the right side, show 2 anime boys from the waist up, leaning casually together beside a chain-link fence under leafy trees. The taller boy has tousled dark brown hair, a navy overshirt worn open over a white T-shirt, layered silver necklaces, and holds 1 plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw. The shorter boy has messy silver-white hair, a white T-shirt with a small crest emblem on the chest, black backpack straps over both shoulders, layered silver necklaces, and one small earring. Their poses are relaxed and intimate, with the dark-haired boy’s arm resting around the other. Use a luminous blue-and-white palette with soft sunlight, lens flare, bokeh, and a faint cityscape in the background, creating a clean social-media header or article thumbnail aesthetic.

promptZh: A high-impact anime promotional interview poster designed as a glossy two-page magazine spread for a futuristic live music event. The scene shows a packed nighttime concert arena filled with a crowd holding glowing light sticks in neon yellow, blue, and purple, with a huge illuminated stage in the background, laser beams, bokeh lights, haze, and a giant triangular play-icon screen reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026". In the center foreground are 2 anime-style female presenters seen from a dramatic side and back angle, both looking toward the stage. The left character is {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}, wearing a dark oversized hooded jacket with black and acid-lime accents, large lime-green headphones marked "06", and raising a bright yellow glow stick overhead; her face is partially obscured by a rectangular privacy block. The right character is {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}, with a short silver-white bob haircut and fair skin, wearing a pale oversized hooded coat, softly lit by stage lights, holding a white-blue glowing baton near her chest, with an emotional profile expression as she watches the show. Use cinematic rim lighting, richly saturated purple-blue concert colors, reflective fabric highlights, and detailed anime rendering with a polished editorial-advertising finish. She has a backpack strap over one shoulder and both hands tucked casually into the hoodie pockets. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone, covering the entire face area. Place her in a dramatic twilight coastal city setting that blends travel, nostalgia, and fantasy: on the left, a lit train platform with a commuter train approaching, its destination sign showing Japanese characters; behind it, a glowing city skyline with a ferris wheel. In the distance and lower left, layered mountains and a winding illuminated valley road. On the right, a cliffside coast at sunset with the sea reflecting warm light, a crescent moon in the sky, several flying seabirds, and a curving highway descending along the hillside. Also on the right, include a wooden signpost with exactly 3 directional signs labeled "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS", and "SIN LÍMITES". At the top center, add the Spanish tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} in elegant serif capitals. Place the film title large across the lower center in luminous ornate serif lettering with a magical glow and sweeping flourishes, layered partly over the character. descriptionEn: A high-end Japanese-style anime key visual poster featuring a silver-haired swordswoman, fantasy sci-fi city backdrop, and full promotional text layout for a game, anime, or light novel campaign.
promptZh:
A polished anime-style vertical key visual poster for a futuristic fantasy action series. Center the composition on a full-body young heroine in a confident three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face partially obscured by angle and hair. She has long flowing silver-white hair blowing dramatically in the wind, pale skin, and cool violet accents. Her outfit is a sleek black, white, and purple combat uniform: black cropped jacket with white hood and cape-like layered back panels, fitted bodice, short pleated skirt, utility belt and straps, black gloves, thigh strap on one leg, and subtle star-emblem details. In her right hand she holds a large angular sci-fi sword with glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue daytime sky with soft clouds, several white birds, and an elegant white city of tall cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand utopian futuristic kingdom atmosphere. Use strong wind effects in the hair, ribbons, coat tails, and fabric. Add smooth linework and smooth coloring, clean anime rendering, high-detail cel shading, crisp lighting, glossy highlights, and a premium game-promo illustration finish.

Design it as a complete Japanese promotional poster layout. On the upper left, place a large bold vertical headline in Japanese reading "未来を、自分の手で。" with the middle phrase in purple and the rest in black, over a pale decorative emblem. Beneath it, add a short Japanese blurb in smaller text. On the right side, place a tall dark vertical sidebar with white Japanese text reading "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。". On the lower left, include 3 tilted rectangular inset images stacked diagonally: 1 close-up portrait of the heroine's face, 1 action shot of her fighting with the glowing sword, and 1 wide cityscape view. At the bottom center, place the large series logo text "黎明のリベリオン" with the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION" beneath it, and below that the release line "2025年、始動。". Color palette: white, black, deep indigo, electric violet, and sky blue. Overall mood: heroic, elegant, aspirational, premium anime game or light novel promotional poster.

In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Her outfit is a sleek black business suit with white piping along the lapels, a dark inner shirt, a fitted pencil skirt, a belt, and a visible lanyard with ID card. On her left arm she wears a white armband printed with the company logo and the words OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES. Also show her hanging ID badge with the logo and small text suggesting PR staff credentials. The exhibition floor includes 3 visible industrial display elements: a white robotic construction machine model on a pedestal at left, a smaller mechanical display in the mid-background, and a large white humanoid or armored industrial mech figure on the right background. Use a high-end convention or trade-show setting with glossy reflective surfaces, glass panels, sharp perspective lines, and branded panels throughout. descriptionEn: Generates an anime-style scene of two characters studying magical, floating holographic spheres in a cozy, sunset-lit room.
promptZh: An anime illustration of two characters at a desk in a {argument name="setting" default="cozy study overlooking the ocean at sunset"}. Facing him is a young woman with {argument name="female character hair" default="long blonde hair"} and {argument name="female character eyes" default="striking, glowing blue eyes"}, wearing an elegant navy and white Victorian dress with a sapphire brooch. Floating between them are exactly 4 glowing holographic spheres connected by faint lines, showing {argument name="hologram theme" default="cosmic and futuristic scenes"}: a swirling galaxy, a golden energy tree, a futuristic control room, and a planet with an energy burst. titleEn: Anime Schoolgirl Floating on the Moon
descriptionZh: This prompt generates a single-panel anime sci-fi illustration of a long-haired schoolgirl in uniform floating above the lunar surface with Earth in the background, ideal for character art or atmospheric key visuals.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a single-panel anime sci-fi illustration of a long-haired schoolgirl in uniform floating above the lunar surface with Earth in the background, ideal for character art or atmospheric key visuals.
promptZh: A polished anime illustration of a slender teenage schoolgirl with {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair, floating weightlessly above the Moon’s surface in a calm seated pose. She has extremely long flowing hair that streams dramatically to the right, with two round twin buns on top of her head and long loose strands cascading past her legs. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a white button-up blouse, a dark navy sweater vest, a green ribbon bow at the collar, a charcoal pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers. Place her slightly left of center, facing slightly left, with her legs bent forward and one hand relaxed downward as if gently drifting in low gravity. The background is deep black outer space with a bright realistic Earth visible in the upper right quadrant, glowing blue and white. The lunar ground below is pale gray, dusty, and cratered, with scattered rocks, soft shadows, and a few small futuristic moon-base domes and antenna-like structures along the distant horizon. Use cool moonlight with subtle rim lighting around the hair and body, high detail in the hair strands and fabric folds, soft luminous anime shading, crisp linework, and a dreamy sci-fi atmosphere combining cute schoolgirl character art with realistic space scenery.

promptZh: A breathtaking anime movie poster at golden-hour sunset, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, painted in the polished cinematic style of a Makoto Shinkai-inspired youth drama. The scene overlooks a Japanese coastal hillside town descending toward a glowing bay, with the sun low on the horizon and its reflection stretching across calm water. The sky dominates most of the image: a vast deep-blue to lavender twilight gradient filled with countless stars, wispy pink and peach clouds, and one especially bright star near the upper right. In the foreground on the right, a teenage schoolgirl stands in three-quarter side profile facing left toward the sea, shown from mid-thigh up, with shoulder-length dark hair blowing in the breeze, a short-sleeved white sailor-style school blouse, a red ribbon at the collar, and a navy pleated skirt; her expression is contemplative and wistful. Farther down the steep stone stair street in the center-left, a teenage schoolboy stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a short-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers, also looking toward the sunset and ocean. At the lower right, include 1 black cat sitting on a wall or rooftop edge in silhouette, looking toward the town. At the lower left, include 1 old-fashioned streetlamp and a dense cluster of blooming hydrangeas in blue and violet along a stone wall. The town below is packed with tiled rooftops, narrow streets, warm window lights, and layered houses, with distant mountains framing the bay. Use dramatic rim light, luminous atmospheric perspective, sparkling highlights, delicate cloud detail, and emotional, nostalgic color grading in indigo, ultramarine, pink, peach, and gold. descriptionZh: A lush anime-style movie poster prompt combining the aesthetics of Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai, featuring mystical elements like floating cities and stone colossi.
descriptionEn: A lush anime-style movie poster prompt combining the aesthetics of Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai, featuring mystical elements like floating cities and stone colossi.
promptZh: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant {argument name="language" default="Japanese kanji"} at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a moody anime-style over-the-shoulder driving scene inside a vintage car, ideal for cinematic storyboards, manga-inspired keyframes, or motion comic sequences.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a moody anime-style over-the-shoulder driving scene inside a vintage car, ideal for cinematic storyboards, manga-inspired keyframes, or motion comic sequences.
promptZh: A cinematic anime-style interior car scene viewed from the back seat over the shoulder of {argument name="driver description" default="a young woman with shoulder-length black hair"} driving through a dim urban tunnel at night. She grips a classic three-spoke steering wheel with both hands, left hand around 10 o’clock and right hand around 3 o’clock, wearing a wristwatch on one wrist and a thin bracelet on the other, with a loose light-colored shirt and rolled sleeves. The dashboard is a vintage sports car cockpit with 4 visible round analog gauges glowing warm orange-red, a retro radio console, metallic trim, and a manual gear shifter in the lower right foreground. Outside the windshield, show dense tunnel traffic with multiple cars ahead, red brake lights, harsh overhead tunnel lights receding into the distance, and rough concrete walls streaked with speed lines. Composition is wide and immersive, emphasizing the driver’s hands, steering wheel, and instrument cluster, with the driver’s face seen in partial side profile on the left edge. Render in gritty manga-inspired linework with heavy ink hatching, dark shadows, muted blue-gray and black tones, and warm highlights from the dashboard and tunnel lights. Mood is tense, focused, nocturnal, and stylish, like a dramatic street-racing or thriller anime frame.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a high-detail anime-style concert poster of a five-member anthropomorphic idol group on a glowing stage, ideal for music visuals, key art, or VTuber-style unit branding.
promptZh:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.

promptZh: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. Add hanging ornamental motifs near the mid-left and mid-right edges, and enclose the whole image in a decorative floral border. The overall mood is sacred, elegant, and antique, with intricate linework, delicate textile patterns, muted earthy tones, and a dominant blue-and-gold palette, resembling a treasured museum fresco or devotional hanging scroll.

promptZh: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. descriptionZh: A prompt for transforming a car photo into a professional minimalist advertising poster with drifting effects and technical specifications.
descriptionEn: A prompt for transforming a car photo into a professional minimalist advertising poster with drifting effects and technical specifications.
promptZh:
Ultra-clean automotive poster featuring the exact same car as the photo that will be provided later. The AI must replicate the car from the uploaded photo with identical body shape, proportions, stance, color, trims, wheels, and all visible exterior details.
The car is presented in a front three-quarter angle facing right, matching the perspective of the original reference layout, but now depicted in a subtle {argument name="action" default="drifting action"}. The drift is expressed through realistic weight transfer, slight body lift, controlled smoke plumes from the rear tires, and faint curved tire marks behind the vehicle, without distorting the original car’s geometry.
Headlights follow the exact style from the reference photo of the car, with optional warm fog lights glowing if the provided car has them. All decals, emblems, plates, and window tints must match the car from the uploaded photo.
The car drifts on a glossy white reflective studio-like floor that maintains soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with light drift skid reflections and directional smudges.
Background remains a clean white-to-light-gray gradient with a giant semi-transparent bold typography of the car model name (auto-extracted from the uploaded photo) vertically dominating the background.
At the very top: clean branding text “{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}” (or the brand detected from the uploaded car photo). Under it, spaced-out stylized tracking text containing the same brand and model name.
Below the car: centered title of the exact model name from the uploaded photo.
Under that, a short descriptive paragraph about the car’s character (efficiency, style, reliability).
Bottom section shows a clean grid layout of specifications. If real specs are known from the detected car model, generate accurate values; if not, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type).
Entire poster is minimalist, editorial, high-key studio lighting with ultra-sharp reflections, crisp shadows, modern typography, and 4K believability, blending clean design with dynamic drifting energy, Ratio 9:16

titleZh: Autumn in New York Travel Poster
titleEn: Autumn in New York Travel Poster
descriptionZh: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical Spanish-language poster for a New York autumn photography trip, ideal for travel promotions, workshops, and social media ads.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical Spanish-language poster for a New York autumn photography trip, ideal for travel promotions, workshops, and social media ads.
promptZh: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.

descriptionZh: A cinematic football transfer announcement poster showing Bukayo Saka in FC Barcelona colors, ideal for social media reveal graphics and fan concept art.
descriptionEn: A cinematic football transfer announcement poster showing Bukayo Saka in FC Barcelona colors, ideal for social media reveal graphics and fan concept art.
promptZh: Create a dramatic football transfer announcement poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bukayo Saka"} joining {argument name="club name" default="FC Barcelona"}. Use a vertical 4:5 sports-poster composition with a deep electric blue and crimson red color grade, high contrast lighting, cinematic shadows, subtle glow, and premium social-media graphic design styling. Center a large chest-up portrait of the player wearing the {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 FC Barcelona home shirt with Spotify sponsor"}, facing forward with a serious confident expression. Behind him, place a much larger low-opacity side portrait of the same player on the right side as a background layer, tinted dark blue. Add a huge faint FC Barcelona crest spanning the middle background, blended into the red-blue gradient. At the very top center, place 2 club identifiers: the FC Barcelona crest and above it a small vertical red-and-blue striped motif. On the upper left, include the text “MÉS QUE UN CLUB” in small gold uppercase letters. On the left lower-middle, create a bold typographic name stack with 2 lines: small gold uppercase first name “BUKAYO” above very large white condensed sans-serif “SAKA”. Below that, add 2 welcome lines in uppercase: “BENVINGUT” in white and “AL BARÇA” in red. Add a gold handwritten-style signature reading “B. Saka” with the number “7” beneath it. In the foreground near the lower center, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with arms stretched wide in celebration, wearing the same Barcelona kit, navy socks, light boots, and a white wrist wrap. At the bottom, show a stylized illuminated view of Spotify Camp Nou curving across the width of the poster in dark blue with red highlights, with small visible stadium text “SPOTIFY CAMP NOU”. In the bottom left corner, include 2 small lines of text: “FC BARCELONA” in gold and “2024/25” in red. Add a small gold sleeve detail on the right shoulder area. Keep the layout clean, layered, modern, and aspirational, like an elite club transfer reveal graphic. Use sharp photo-illustration compositing, realistic fabric texture, glossy highlights, and polished poster finish.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a premium city-culture exhibition poster featuring Beijing-themed architectural calligraphy and elegant editorial typography, ideal for tourism, museum, or heritage branding.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a premium city-culture exhibition poster featuring Beijing-themed architectural calligraphy and elegant editorial typography, ideal for tourism, museum, or heritage branding.
promptZh: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. descriptionZh: This prompt generates a dramatic meme-style political campaign poster for social media featuring a man holding a blue pen, bold Portuguese slogans, and Brazilian patriotic visual cues.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a dramatic meme-style political campaign poster for social media featuring a man holding a blue pen, bold Portuguese slogans, and Brazilian patriotic visual cues.
promptZh: A dramatic Brazilian political campaign poster in a square social-media format, hyper-stylized and cinematic, with a dark blue and black color grade, intense contrast, gritty textures, and heroic propaganda-poster composition. On the right half, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt faces the camera from the chest up, extending one hand toward the viewer and prominently holding a blue ballpoint pen upright as the central symbolic object. His pose is confident, assertive, and campaign-like, with the pen close to the lens for forced perspective. Behind him, two large waving flags fill the upper background: the Puerto Rico flag on the upper left side behind the subject and the Brazil flag on the upper right side. The lower background shows a dark crowd silhouette and a distant city skyline at sunset with glowing orange light on the horizon, adding a rally atmosphere. On the left side, create a vertical stack of 4 bold campaign statements, each preceded by a large blue X marker. The 4 text blocks must read exactly: "ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA", "ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS", "ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO", and "O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA". Use condensed uppercase typography, mixing white and electric blue emphasis words, with each statement separated by thin horizontal blue divider lines. At the bottom, place an oversized distressed headline in uppercase reading "CANETA AZUL", with "CANETA" in weathered white and "AZUL" in vivid blue, spanning almost the full width. Below it, add a secondary subtitle in uppercase blue italic condensed text reading "PARA DEPUTADO", flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. The overall design should feel like a viral meme campaign ad, bold, satirical, aggressive, and highly shareable, with dramatic rim lighting, sharpened details, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished poster-quality compositing.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates an impressionistic motion-blurred wildlife image of a single deer-like animal in dense green foliage, suitable for atmospheric nature art or abstract photography.
promptZh: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.

descriptionEn: A photorealistic dark-mode chat screenshot featuring a dramatic boxing impact image, suitable for recreating viral social-media-style AI image demos.
promptZh: A realistic smartphone screenshot of a dark-mode chat interface in Chinese, minimalist and modern, with a charcoal black background and lots of empty space. Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. The ring ropes are red and white, with visible branding including PBC, and the dark blurred arena background includes bright signage reading RODRIGUEZ VS. The action photo should feel like a frozen high-speed sports photograph, dramatic, crisp, and photorealistic. Over both fighters’ faces are 2 rectangular mosaic-blur censor blocks, one on each face. Add small mobile UI overlay details on the image: the Chinese word 编辑 in white at the bottom-left corner of the photo and a circular share/upload icon at the bottom-right corner. Overall composition should look exactly like a casually shared AI-generated image shown inside a messaging app screenshot, clean, believable, and highly realistic.

The left panel shows vertical {argument name="left game" default="Subway Surfers gameplay"}, featuring a character running on train tracks collecting gold coins with UI elements like a score of "001022". The wide center panel displays an academic presentation slide titled "{argument name="slide topic" default="9.3: Infinite Geometric Series"}". The slide contains math text: "Example 3: Find the sum of the infinite geometric series. 1/3 - 1/9 + 1/27 - 1/81 + ... Solution: The series is geometric with a = 1/3 and r = -1/3. Since |r| < 1, the infinite geometric series converges. S = a / (1 - r) = (1/3) / (1 - (-1/3)) = (1/3) / (4/3) = 1/4. The sum of the series is 1/4." The slide footer reads "{argument name="professor name" default="Dr. Larson"}", "{argument name="course name" default="Calculus II"}", "11/14/2024", and "7 / 35". The right panel shows vertical {argument name="right game" default="Minecraft parkour gameplay"}, featuring floating wooden blocks over a grassy landscape with a TikTok watermark at the bottom right. The room has a drop ceiling and blackboards visible behind the screen edges.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a dramatic multi-panel manga page of a red-clad woman violently defeating multiple enemies, ideal for action comic art and intense seinen-style visuals.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a dramatic multi-panel manga page of a red-clad woman violently defeating multiple enemies, ideal for action comic art and intense seinen-style visuals.
promptZh: A gritty black-and-white manga action page with selective red color on the heroine’s clothing, arranged as 6 comic panels with dynamic diagonal borders on a white page. The central and largest panel shows a fierce young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and blunt bangs, wearing a short red kimono-style robe with a wide golden obi sash, barefoot, delivering a high vertical kick into a burly man’s face; her face is obscured by a soft square blur, and the impact explodes with ink splatter and debris. In the top-left panel, the same woman crouches low in a feral fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the earth, hair streaming outward, robe open enough to show powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her intense eyes under straight bangs, cold and focused. In the bottom-left panel, she drives a straight punch into an attacker with a dramatic burst effect at the point of contact. In the bottom-center panel, she performs a rising kick or sweeping upward strike against another large male opponent, with speed lines and hair flowing. In the bottom-right panel, shown from behind, she stands calmly amid defeated men lying on the ground with smoke or dust rising around them, her long hair cascading down her back and the red robe hanging loosely. Use rough ink brushwork, heavy speed lines, splattered impact effects, high-contrast manga shading, violent kinetic composition, and bold Japanese sound effect lettering in black. The mood is brutal, cinematic, and relentless, like a seinen revenge manga. Keep the page mostly monochrome except for the woman’s red robe and subtle warm sash accents.

promptZh: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. promptZh: A monumental cinematic historical painting of the Battle of Red Cliffs at night, showing an entire ancient Chinese river fleet consumed by fire. promptZh: A high-speed macro photograph of a soap bubble bursting in a sunlit garden, framed horizontally. On the far left edge, show the side profile of a young child with visible cheek, nose, lips, and part of one closed or half-closed eye, gently blowing toward the bubble. Place 1 large soap bubble near the center-left of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vivid rainbow colors and strong reflective highlights, including a bright sun glint near the upper area and reflections of trees and garden scenery on the surface. The right half of the bubble is exploding outward into countless tiny droplets, mist, and thin web-like liquid filaments, frozen sharply in mid-air and spreading to the right side of the image. Emphasize the dramatic transition line between the intact sphere and the shattered spray. Use bright direct sunlight, very high shutter speed, crisp macro detail, high contrast, saturated color, dark green leafy background rendered as soft bokeh, and a Kodak Ektar 100 film look. descriptionZh: 这个提示产生一个现实的手持智能手机照相照相咖啡馆场景,一个妇女提供糕点和玩耍的食品贴纸,理想是社交媒体生活方式或AI图像比较.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic handheld smartphone photo-in-photo cafe scene with a woman offering a pastry and playful food stickers, ideal for social media lifestyle or AI image comparisons.
promptZh: A photorealistic close-up of a hand holding a modern black smartphone vertically in a cozy sunlit cafe. The phone screen shows the live camera view in photo mode, with a young woman seated at a table and leaning forward, extending an orange plate toward the camera with both hands. On the plate is 1 seeded cream-filled pastry or bagel-like sandwich topped with mixed sesame and poppy seeds and a dusting of sugar. The woman has shoulder-length dark brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, a light-colored baseball cap with NYC lettering, and a faded mauve-pink ringer T-shirt with darker trim and partially visible vintage text. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block centered over it. The smartphone camera UI is clearly visible: 1 flash icon at top left, 1 target or focus icon at top right, and along the bottom 5 mode labels reading SLO-MO, VIDEO, PHOTO, PORTRAIT, and PANO, with PHOTO highlighted in yellow; include 1 large white shutter button, 1 small gallery thumbnail at bottom left, and 1 camera-switch icon at bottom right. Outside the phone, add playful floating food-themed stickers around the scene: 1 waffle at the upper left, 1 pink heart sticker reading YUMMY on the left, 1 yellow smiling face emoji on the left, 1 blue speech bubble at the upper right reading {argument name="sticker text" default="Yummy!"}, 1 small yellow smiley on the right, 2 white sparkle stars at the upper right, 1 silver fork at the lower right, and 1 cherry sticker at the lower right. The real cafe background outside the phone is softly blurred with warm wood tones, chairs, tables, large windows, and on the right side of the table 1 red apple and 1 plate of waffles with berries. Emphasize shallow depth of field, natural daylight, glossy phone reflections, realistic skin texture, and a trendy candid social-media food photo aesthetic.
promptEn: A photorealistic close-up of a hand holding a modern black smartphone vertically in a cozy sunlit cafe. The phone screen shows the live camera view in photo mode, with a young woman seated at a table and leaning forward, extending an orange plate toward the camera with both hands. The woman has shoulder-length dark brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, a light-colored baseball cap with NYC lettering, and a faded mauve-pink ringer T-shirt with darker trim and partially visible vintage text. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block centered over it. descriptionZh: 精心制作艺术城市海报,将中国传统书法与现代建筑元素融合在一起,以透明鸟类图案和详细的城市地标为特色。
descriptionEn: A sophisticated prompt for creating artistic city posters that blend traditional Chinese calligraphy with modern architectural elements, featuring a transparent bird motif and detailed urban landmarks.
promptZh: 【背景与骨架线条】 纯黑深邃底色，一条粗壮有力的墨色书法S型曲线自画面一端蜿蜒贯穿至另一端，笔触苍劲，墨迹浓淡有致，如大写意行笔，构成整幅画面的视觉骨架与叙事动线。 【主体：{argument name="主体鸟类" default="画眉鸟"}】 曲线上方，一只展翅飞翔的画眉鸟占据视觉核心；身体呈玻璃透明质感，内部映射传统建筑群叠影，蓝绿色光流在透明羽翼间流转折射，仿佛时间长河与文明记忆凝缩其中；轮廓以极细金线勾边，增强立体感与神圣感。 【中景：古典建筑序列】 燕子下方，沿墨线曲线错落分布{argument name="城市" default="广州"}的各种风景名胜：白云山、陈家祠、双子塔、广州塔、猎德大桥、海珠塔依次浮现；主色调青绿与淡金，建筑细节清晰，琉璃瓦、飞檐翘角、石阶回廊；木棉花簇拥点缀于建筑周围，花瓣随风轻散，静谧而悠远；几朵水墨云朵轻盈飘浮其间，增添空灵层次。 【前景：白鹤与水面】 前景湖畔：数只白鹤或静立水边、或振翅腾飞，姿态各异，优雅从容；浅蓝湖面如镜，倒影荡漾，波光细碎，营造宁静氛围。 【远景：山峦】 远处山峦层叠起伏，青黛色晕染，墨色由浓至淡，朦胧氤氲，富有水墨层次；与前景形成近实远虚的空间纵深。 【构图与光影】 非线性透视构图，墨线曲线为叙事主轴，古今元素沿线嵌入；光源自画面中心向外辐射扩散，形成强烈明暗对比，中心亮、四周渐暗；冷色调主导（深蓝、青绿、银白），暖色点缀（樱花粉、淡金），和谐而神秘；东方美学与现代意象交融，超现实诗意意境。 【技术规格】 8K超高清渲染，极致细节精度，最佳画质，比例 {argument name="比例" default="9:16"}

titleZh: Candid Bar Photo with Four Fingers
titleEn: Candid Bar Photo with Four Fingers
descriptionZh: A photorealistic smartphone-style bar snapshot of a woman holding a nearly full red wine glass and showing four fingers, useful for testing detail accuracy in generative images.
descriptionEn: A photorealistic smartphone-style bar snapshot of a woman holding a nearly full red wine glass and showing four fingers, useful for testing detail accuracy in generative images.
promptZh: A realistic candid smartphone flash photo in a crowded bar, vertical 3:4 composition. Center the shot on an extremely attractive adult woman with long dark brown wavy hair, light tan skin, and a confident casual nightlife presence, wearing a fitted ribbed white tank top. Her face is mostly front-facing and slightly tilted, with a natural candid pose. She is holding up her left hand close to the camera and clearly showing exactly four fingers, thumb tucked in. In her right hand she holds a stemmed wine glass filled with very dark red wine almost completely to the brim, with no visible empty space at the top. The framing is mid-torso portrait, shot at close range like a spontaneous iPhone bar photo with direct flash, realistic skin texture, slight shine, strong foreground illumination, and darker ambient background. Behind her, mount a large round wall clock on a wooden column in the upper right area of the frame, and make the clock clearly read exactly 5:00. The bar environment should look busy and authentic, with warm dim lighting, blurred patrons, liquor signage, and subtle party leftovers on the bar counter. Show exactly 4 types of party remnants: empty glasses, used napkins, metallic confetti pieces, and drink straws. Include a few hanging balloons and streamers in the background, plus a cozy nightlife atmosphere with cluttered surfaces and reflections. Photorealistic smartphone aesthetic, candid nightlife snapshot, slight messiness, true-to-life proportions, accurate hands and fingers, accurate glass shape, accurate clock hands.
promptEn: A realistic candid smartphone flash photo in a crowded bar, vertical 3:4 composition.
