titleZh: 字符关系图海报生成器
descriptionZh: 制作专业人物关系海报的详细提示,将信息可视化与系列的特定艺术风格相结合.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for creating professional character relationship posters that combine information visualization with the specific art style of a series.
promptZh:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="鬼灭之刃"}，生成一张高设计感的人物关系图海报。要求这张图不是普通插画，而是兼具信息可视化、叙事结构、海报设计感和作品风格还原度的人物关系图。

请自动完成以下内容：
- 识别该主题对应的作品及其核心设定
- 提取最具代表性的 6–12 位关键人物，必要时不超过 15 位
- 识别并展示关键人物关系，包括血缘、爱情、友情、联盟、敌对、师徒、主从、操控、背叛、秘密关系等
- 自动按作品特点选择合适的构图方式，如主角中心型、双核心对峙型、阵营分区型、家族谱系型或时间演变型
- 自动提炼作品的风格DNA，包括色彩、世界观符号、材质纹理、情绪氛围、排版语言和代表性元素
- 将这些风格元素转化为人物关系图的整体视觉设计，而不是简单复制某张官方海报
- 用不同颜色、线型、箭头区分不同关系，保证线条清晰、层次分明、不杂乱
- 核心人物最突出，重要人物次之，次级人物弱化，形成明确视觉层级
- 每个人物名称清晰可读，必要时可加入身份或阵营标签

最终成品应满足：
- 一眼看懂人物主次和关键关系
- 具有明显的原作品气质与设定感
- 兼具信息图的清晰度与海报的高级设计感
- 画面统一、精致、完整、适合社交媒体传播或海报展示
- 避免廉价流程图感、避免杂乱堆砌、避免信息过载

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic Android screenshot of the ChatGPT Japanese mobile app displaying a photorealistic nightlife portrait image, useful for social media mockups or UI demonstrations.
promptZh: A realistic smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in Japanese on an Android device, shown full screen in portrait orientation with a clean light theme. The status bar at the top shows the time 19:27, network and battery icons, and 54% battery. The header has a back-style menu icon on the left, a rounded tab labeled ChatGPT, and 2 icons on the right: an edit pencil icon and a vertical three-dot menu. Below it, show the assistant status text "画像が作成されました" and then 1 generated image card with rounded corners. The generated image is a photorealistic night restaurant portrait of a glamorous young Japanese woman seated indoors by a window with Tokyo Tower visible outside, wearing a black spaghetti-strap dress, long wavy brown hair, a delicate necklace, and a bracelet, leaning her face on one hand at a candlelit dinner table with a wine glass in the foreground; the setting feels upscale, dimly lit, and influencer-like, with a mirror behind her reflecting the back of her head and the city view. Blur or mosaic the woman’s face for privacy. Beneath the image, show 5 action icons in a row: copy, thumbs up, thumbs down, share, and more. At the bottom, include the message input bar with a plus icon on the left, placeholder text "ChatGPT に返信する", a microphone icon, and a circular voice button on the right. Also show the Android navigation bar with 3 controls at the very bottom. Keep the overall composition exactly like a casual app screenshot, minimal, spacious, and authentic.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a photorealistic candid street scene of schoolchildren buying snacks at a small Chinese neighborhood shop, ideal for documentary-style lifestyle imagery.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a photorealistic candid street scene of schoolchildren buying snacks at a small Chinese neighborhood shop, ideal for documentary-style lifestyle imagery.
promptZh: A candid, photorealistic street documentary photo of three primary school children buying snacks at a small old-fashioned neighborhood convenience shop in China, shot in soft natural daylight. The scene is framed straight-on at storefront level, with a slightly compressed everyday snapshot feel, realistic textures, and subtle depth. On the left, one schoolgirl stands in profile wearing a light pink zip-up jacket, dark jeans, and a red scarf, her black hair tied in a ponytail with a white headband, looking down at coins or a small item in her hands. In the center, one schoolboy stands with his back to the camera in a bright blue school tracksuit and a navy-and-red backpack featuring a Mickey Mouse graphic, leaning slightly toward the counter. On the right, one younger schoolgirl with two low pigtails tied with pale pink hair ties leans against a large chest freezer, wearing a white long-sleeve top and blue athletic pants, with a pink backpack resting beside her. Behind the counter, inside the dim shop interior, one shopkeeper in a pink top with a cartoon character print stands partially obscured in shadow. The counter is cluttered with packaged snacks, clear plastic bags of candy, colorful biscuit boxes, jars, and small goods; the shelves behind are densely packed with drinks and snacks. A bunch of multicolored balloons hangs near the upper center of the shop entrance. The chest freezer in the foreground is white with a green lid trim and green Chinese branding on the side. The storefront is worn and modest, with peeling beige walls, a posted calendar or notice sheet on the left wall, metal-framed windows, and an open service window. Include authentic Chinese neighborhood shop details, natural messiness, believable lighting, muted urban colors, and an unposed slice-of-life atmosphere. Faces should be softly obscured or turned away, emphasizing realism and privacy rather than portrait detail.

promptZh:
16:9の劇場版アニメ映画ポスター。夜の森の境界領域。前景中央やや左に、10代後半の日本人少女。黒髪ポニーテール、細身、ダークカラーの実用的な防寒アウトドアジャケット、調査用バックパック。背中側を見せた3/4後ろ姿で肩越しに振り向く。落ち着いた緊張感と強い意志。
右上空の森の上に、白青色に発光する巨大な球状超常現象。無数の発光フィラメントと電気的な輪郭線が絡み合うエネルギー球。内部は霧がかった白光、周囲に微細な青白い粒子光。左奥には噴煙を上げる富士山。中景には日本語警告入りの立入禁止テープ、現実的な災害対応スタッフ、左右に救急車両。軍事感は不要。
地面はぬかるんだ山林で、浅い水流と濡れた地表が発光を反射。左右の高い木々が画面を囲む。空は満天の星、富士山麓には微細な街明かり。神秘と災厄が同時に存在する空気感。
少女、巨大光球、富士山の三角構図。やや低めのシネマティック視点。少女と光球を二大主役として大きく明確に見せる。冷たい夜の青を基調に、主光源は巨大光球の白青発光。木々、地面、水面、少女に強いリムライト。副光源として星明かりと遠方の噴火の微かな橙光。少女の顔は暗すぎず表情が読める。高コントラスト。
最新の日本劇場版アニメの高級感あるキービジュアル。映画ポスター級の完成度。高密度で繊細な背景、精密な光表現、空気遠近感、写実寄りで美しく整理されたアニメ作画。全体トーンはダークネイビー、白青発光、微かな火山の橙。荘厳、不穏、神秘的、ドラマ性が高い。
上部中央に小さめの日本語コピー: "{argument name="ポスターのキャッチコピー" default="それは奇跡ではない。彼岸の彼方へつながる災害だった。"}"
下部中央に大きく、白に近い淡い発光の上品な英字セリフ体タイトル: "{argument name="映画のタイトル" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}"
その直下に小さめの日本語サブタイトル: "{argument name="サブタイトル" default="境界の森"}"
文字は正確で高可読。指定以外の文字、ロゴ、透かしは入れない。余計な人物、モンスター、メカ、不要な派手な粒子やノイズは入れない。

descriptionZh: 这个提示产生了一种喜悦的,反面的时尚风格的画像,描绘一个有风光头发的女性,理想的电影美容社论和大气海报图像.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a moody, backlit fashion-style portrait of a woman with windblown hair, ideal for cinematic beauty editorials and atmospheric poster imagery.
promptZh: A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. The background is a dark gray to near-black empty space with 2 clear environmental elements: floating dust-like particles and soft circular bokeh light spots scattered mostly on the left side and around the hair. Overall color grading is low saturation with cool blue-gray shadows and slightly warm skin tones for subtle warm-cool contrast. Add diffused bloom, misty atmosphere, faint film grain, soft vignette, and shallow depth of field. Keep the eyes and lips de-emphasized or hidden in shadow, avoid hard frontal light, avoid bright busy background details, avoid cartoon styling, avoid oversharpening, and avoid plastic skin texture.

She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, long and slightly wavy, gathered into a loose side braid draped over her right shoulder, with soft bangs and warm rim light along the top of her head and hair edges. She wears a cream or light beige sailor-style school uniform with navy trim and a dark blue ribbon bow at the chest. Her pose is quiet and introspective: sitting at a school desk, leaning her cheek into one hand, shoulders slightly curved, looking off to the side with a tired but calm midweek expression. The scene is lit by strong late-afternoon sunlight pouring in from a tall classroom window on the right, creating glowing highlights, dust motes in the air, soft haze, and a nostalgic cinematic mood. In the dimmer left background, include a green classroom chalkboard and 2 small chalkboard erasers or chalk accessories resting on the tray. Use painterly anime realism with rich filmic contrast, delicate facial rendering, textured brushwork, subtle grain, and dramatic poster lighting. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the artwork: on the left side, large vertical white brush lettering reading "真ん中" with smaller handwritten-style vertical text above reading "やっと、"; across the lower middle, large pink calligraphic title text reading "水曜日" diagonally; on the upper right, a vertical tagline reading "週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。" Near the lower right, include 3 stacked gold laurel award emblems with small Japanese text inside each. Along the bottom center, add 2 lines of small Japanese tagline text, then a credits block in small Japanese film-poster typography. In the bottom right corner, place a large release date reading {argument name="release date" default="5.29"} with "ROADSHOW" beneath it. Overall feeling: soft, melancholic, reassuring, like an understated coming-of-age film poster about an ordinary Wednesday becoming quietly special.

On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. The overall effect should fuse ancient Chinese scholar portraiture with space-age technology and AI symbolism, highly detailed, elegant, balanced, and slightly satirical, with the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a humorous single-panel manga-style scene of a bird owner overwhelmed by a massive spilled seed mess, ideal for relatable pet-owner comic posts.
promptZh: A single-panel Japanese comic-style illustration on a light wooden floor, drawn in a soft, detailed, slightly vintage manga-anime style with clean ink outlines and muted warm colors. In the center, a young woman kneels on the floor in a gray cockatiel kigurumi pajama suit with a white belly panel and small gray wings, while wearing an oversized yellow cockatiel hood shaped like a bird’s head with crest, round black eyes, orange cheek patches, and a beak above her forehead. She holds both sides of the hood in shock, her posture frozen and guilty, with a large rectangular censor block covering the center of her face. Across the floor in front of her is a huge mess of spilled birdseed: mixed grains, pellets, shells, and seeds scattered widely in a dense irregular pile. On the left lies 1 overturned white seed cup spilling its contents, and in the lower left corner 1 vacuum cleaner floor head points toward the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. On the right stands 1 real cockatiel, small and curious, with a yellow face, orange cheeks, pale body, gray wings, and a raised crest, looking toward the kneeling woman; next to the bird is 1 small speech bubble containing a question mark. The background is simple indoor flooring with dramatic dark vertical stress lines filling the upper half to heighten panic. The mood is comedic embarrassment and domestic disaster, as if illustrating a relatable bird-owner mistake.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a fully colored multi-panel manga page with a windy romantic-comedy school-date scene, ideal for manga coloring tests and anime comic illustrations.
promptZh: A cleanly colored manga page in a modern romantic-comedy style, presented as a 6-panel comic layout with crisp black panel borders on a white page. The scene takes place outdoors on a bright day with blue sky, soft clouds, leafy green trees, paved walkway, and queue posts with chain barriers. The main subject is a teenage anime girl with a short blond bob haircut, loose windblown strands, large golden-brown eyes, light blush, and a serious slightly embarrassed expression. She wears a floppy dog-ear hat with cream fur and a small blue polka-dot cap detail, a blue school-style cardigan or blazer over a white shirt, and a red patterned necktie, while holding a pink swirled soft-serve ice cream cone. A teenage boy in a dark blue sweater and white collared shirt appears in 3 panels, his face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, also wearing a matching floppy dog-ear hat. The page should have exactly 6 panels: 2 small panels across the top row, 1 large central close-up panel spanning the width, and 3 panels along the bottom row. Top-left panel: the boy faces forward with the girl turning sharply toward him, her hair and hat flaring from motion, outdoor background with a signboard, and hand-drawn manga sound effects in black. Top-right panel: a small chibi-style version of the girl stands near the chain barrier, looking smug and flustered while holding the ice cream, with a speech bubble that says "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." and small floating sound-effect text near her head. Center panel: a dramatic close-up portrait of the girl against open sky, hair blowing across her face, one strand crossing her mouth, dog ears visible, staring forward with a calm, stunned look; include a vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text and a small English sound effect reading "PLOP". Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. Use polished manga coloring over inked line art: soft cel shading, slightly textured watercolor-like fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, fine crosshatching accents, and expressive linework. descriptionZh: This generates a dramatic full-color sports manga page with a tilted stadium soccer scene, inset close-up panels, and bold dialogue, ideal for manga coloring tests or anime-style comic art.
descriptionEn: This generates a dramatic full-color sports manga page with a tilted stadium soccer scene, inset close-up panels, and bold dialogue, ideal for manga coloring tests or anime-style comic art.
promptZh: A full-color manga page in the style of a dramatic sports manga, showing an intense soccer match inside a huge domed stadium packed with a blue-and-white crowd. Use sharp ink lines, dense crosshatching, screentone texture, dynamic speed lines, and vivid anime coloring as if a black-and-white manga page has been professionally colorized. The composition is a single page with 3 panels: 1 large main panel covering most of the page, plus 2 narrow diagonal inset panels stacked along the left side. In the main panel, show a steeply tilted wide-angle view of the penalty area and goal from an elevated sideline perspective, with the green grass stretched by perspective and filled with directional hatching. Count 6 visible players in the main panel: 4 blue-uniform players and 2 white-uniform players, plus 1 goalkeeper in yellow at the goal. The most prominent player is seen from behind in the lower center-right wearing a blue jersey with “HUGO” and the number 9, running toward the play with one arm extended. Near him on the lower right edge, show another player in a white jersey labeled “ISAGI” with the number 11, also running forward. In the midground, show 4 more field players contesting the ball: 3 in blue and 1 in white, with one white-uniform player diving or lunging horizontally from the right toward the center. The goal stands near the top center-left, with the yellow goalkeeper bracing in front of the net. Add 3 speech bubbles in the main panel, large white manga balloons with hand-lettered uppercase English text: “BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”, “...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”, and “...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”. In the left-side inset area, create 2 diagonal panels. The upper inset panel shows a close-up of a dark-haired character in blue, partly obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the center of the face and torso area, with a small speech bubble that says, “YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”. The lower inset panel shows a close-up of a reddish-haired character with a wide blue eye, sweat on the face, and a pale blue background, looking surprised or stunned. Maintain bold black panel borders, dramatic foreshortening, and a high-energy tournament atmosphere. Use a blue, green, white, and yellow palette with strong contrast and authentic manga-page coloring aesthetics.

descriptionZh: A cinematic surreal prompt for generating a towering maze-covered female statue with a doorway in its base, ideal for dark fantasy concept art and atmospheric architectural imagery.
descriptionEn: A cinematic surreal prompt for generating a towering maze-covered female statue with a doorway in its base, ideal for dark fantasy concept art and atmospheric architectural imagery.
promptZh: A surreal dark-fantasy photorealistic scene of a colossal humanoid statue shaped like a woman standing in a rugged mountain landscape, viewed from a dramatic low angle so the figure towers into the sky. The statue’s body forms a massive bell-shaped dress covered entirely in deep carved labyrinth patterns, like an ancient maze sculpted into weathered stone and concrete, with moss, grime, erosion, and age stains across the surface. At the bottom center of the dress, place 1 arched doorway opening into darkness, with a narrow dirt path leading directly into it, making the statue feel like an inhabitable monument. The figure has 2 visible arms hanging straight down at the sides and a slender neck rising above the structure, with a human head turned slightly to the side; use short dark wavy hair and partially obscured facial detail. Surround the monument with scattered rocks, sparse alpine shrubs, and uneven ground. Add 1 steep rocky mountain peak on the right side in the background. Fill the sky with heavy overcast storm clouds in muted gray tones, creating a moody, ominous atmosphere. Color palette: cold gray, charcoal, stone beige, moss green, subdued earth tones. Lighting should be natural, diffuse, cloudy daylight with soft shadows. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, monumental scale, eerie surreal architecture, ancient labyrinth temple fused with a female statue, highly detailed textures, vertical composition.

descriptionZh: A highly structured prompt for generating a six-panel commercial storyboard layout with consistent characters and a narrative progression.
descriptionEn: A highly structured prompt for generating a six-panel commercial storyboard layout with consistent characters and a narrative progression.
promptZh:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics

6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)

- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a pastel hand-drawn horizontal Chinese educational infographic explaining four tokenization methods with a Shiba Inu teacher and a blue token mascot, ideal for social media science posts.
promptZh: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. Beneath the headline, place a rounded dashed text box containing the definition: "分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。" with the word "Token" highlighted in blue. Below that, add a line of explanatory text: "下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：" with "程序员Left" highlighted in light blue and "人工智能" highlighted in pink. The lower half contains exactly 4 rounded pastel panels arranged left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green and titled "1 词级分词". It includes the subtitle "按完整语义划分文本" and exactly 3 token bubbles: "程序员", "Left", "人工智能". At the bottom of this panel, show the Shiba Inu teacher giving a thumbs up with a speech bubble saying "语义完整，容易理解！". Panel 2 is pale yellow and titled "2 字符级分词". It includes the subtitle "逐字切分文本" and exactly 9 circular token bubbles arranged in rows: "程", "序", "员", "L", "e", "f", "t", "人", "工", "智", "能"—visually presented as individual characters from the example text, in a compact grid. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot holding a pencil, with a speech bubble saying "粒度最细，但序列会很长~". Panel 3 is pale pink and titled "3 子词分词". It includes the subtitle "按词根以及前后缀划分" and exactly 5 token bubbles: "程序", "员", "Left", "人工", "智能". At the bottom, show the Shiba Inu teacher thinking with one paw at its mouth and a question mark above the head, with a speech bubble saying "折中方案，效果 often 很好！". Panel 4 is pale blue and titled "4 字节级分词". It includes the subtitle "将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分" and displays exactly 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7", "A8", "8B", "...", "66", "74", "E4", "BA", "BA", "E8", "83", "BD", "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot again, smiling, with a speech bubble saying "适合处理任意文本！" and a tiny light bulb doodle nearby. Across the very bottom, place a rounded banner note that reads: "不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！". Use soft pastel green, yellow, pink, and blue for the four panels, dark brown handwritten text, subtle shadows, rounded shapes, and adorable kawaii expressions throughout. Keep the composition balanced, clean, and friendly, like a polished social-media science explainer poster.

promptZh: A cinematic rear three-quarter tracking shot of a futuristic white Audi supercar racing through a dense neon-lit city at night on a wet street, viewed from a very low angle close to the rear wheel. The car has a sleek widebody coupe silhouette, glossy pearl white body panels, a black rear fascia, and a continuous thin LED taillight strip with segmented red and white light elements stretching across the tail. The glowing Audi four-ring logo is illuminated in white at the center rear, with a stylized glowing model badge beneath it that reads "tron" in a futuristic font. The rear bodywork is partially removed or transparently open to reveal exposed high-performance mechanical components: 1 large rectangular metallic battery or power unit mounted low at the back, 3 visible thick exhaust or cooling pipes spanning across the rear, 1 visible gearbox or motor assembly near the center-right, and a deep black rear diffuser with 2 large fins. The car rides on oversized deep-dish black wheels with ultra-wide rear tires, and the tire sidewalls feature bright white Japanese-style lettering around the circumference. Use strong motion blur in the background and along the road surface to imply high speed, with sharp focus on the car body and exposed machinery. Surround the scene with abstract urban bokeh, streaking neon signage, reflections of red, blue, and white city lights across the wet pavement and glossy bodywork. High contrast, cyberpunk atmosphere, realistic automotive photography, dramatic nighttime lighting, ultra-detailed metal textures, cinematic lens, dynamic composition, speed, power, futuristic engineering.

Five heavily armed tactical soldiers in black futuristic body armor and full helmets stack at a metal door on the far left: 1 soldier is actively breaching the door with one boot raised and bright orange sparks exploding outward, 1 soldier stands just behind aiming into the doorway, 1 soldier crouches low in the center with rifle ready, 1 soldier stands mid-right aiming across the balcony toward the city, and 1 soldier kneels in the right foreground behind the railing. The environment is packed with towering skyscrapers, elevated skybridges, distant traffic lanes, wet reflective metal surfaces, drifting steam, rain haze, and a deep blue-black stormy sky. Neon signage and giant billboards dominate the scene in magenta, cyan, violet, and electric blue, including visible signs reading "POCARI SWEAT" twice, "softsys", "DATA INC", "ROSE", "BARIKI", "2F", "KIROSHI", and multiple vertical Japanese and Chinese-style neon signs. Include 2 hovering flying vehicles in the mid-distance sky and countless illuminated windows receding into the background. descriptionZh: A technical prompt for creating a 3D-rendered dance sequence guide using a reference character for consistent posing across a grid layout.
descriptionEn: A technical prompt for creating a 3D-rendered dance sequence guide using a reference character for consistent posing across a grid layout.
promptZh:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

monochromatic grayscale illustration, 3D rendered character, clean instructional reference sheet,

descriptionZh: A moody AAA-style promotional poster of a lone swordsman in a ruined ancient Chinese city, ideal for dark fantasy game key art and cinematic marketing visuals.
descriptionEn: A moody AAA-style promotional poster of a lone swordsman in a ruined ancient Chinese city, ideal for dark fantasy game key art and cinematic marketing visuals.
promptZh: A dramatic vertical cinematic poster for the dark wuxia action game {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"}, painted in an ultra-detailed gritty concept-art style with realistic textures, moody volumetric fog, and high contrast lighting. The scene shows 1 lone swordsman standing in the lower center foreground, viewed mostly from behind in a three-quarter pose, wearing a wide straw hat and layered black robes shredded into long wind-whipped strips, with pale loose hair streaming out beneath the hat. He holds 1 drawn sword low in his right hand, the blade catching cold silver light. The environment is a ruined ancient Chinese city of towering wooden pagodas and fortress-like buildings rising into steep cliffs, with collapsing architecture, hanging chains, smoke, drifting ash, and rubble. A bright full moon glows near the top center behind dense storm clouds, backlighting the skyline and the warrior. The color palette is almost monochrome charcoal, black, steel gray, and moonlit white, punctuated by sharp crimson slashes and blood-like streaks cutting diagonally across the composition. At the very top, place 4 huge Chinese calligraphy characters in explosive white brushstroke ink reading {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}, spanning nearly the full width. Directly beneath, centered, add the small elegant serif English subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}. At the bottom center, add 1 line of Chinese tagline text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}, with the final character in red, plus 1 smaller line of Chinese promotional text beneath it. Add subtle ornamental divider lines and a tiny red seal-like emblem at the bottom. Composition should feel like an official AAA key art poster: epic, ominous, martial, supernatural, and intensely atmospheric, with dynamic wind, debris, embers, torn fabric, and ink-splatter energy.

promptZh: Create a gritty, darkly comedic advertising image for a bug spray product in a realistic cinematic photo style. The scene is a messy sunlit living room with a wooden floor, soft warm afternoon light coming from tall windows on the left, shallow depth of field, and a low camera angle near floor level. descriptionEn: A very complex prompt for generating a full-page manga featuring specific characters, vertical layouts, and precise multilingual text rendering in Chinese and English.
promptZh:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI researcher, Chen Boyuan"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "God! It learned to 'catch' again!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese "we are working hard to fix it!"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps."

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on Chen Boyuan's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small "Ultra-small Chinese is also clearly readable:" with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with "(This is an ultra-small font size test) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese is finally fixed. Haven't been home for many years, really want to eat hairy crabs!" (ultra small).

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a polished mobile UI concept for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, suitable for app design showcases or product mockups.

promptZh: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

promptZh: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo in a polished editorial style, vertical portrait orientation, showing a beautiful young adult woman walking confidently toward the camera in the middle of a modern financial district at sunset. She is centered full-body, photographed at street level with cinematic depth of field, framed by tall glass office towers on both sides reflecting warm golden evening light. The mood is elegant, urban, powerful, and refined, like an upscale fashion magazine cover about after-work style. The woman has long dark hair styled in a thick side braid over one shoulder, a slim sophisticated silhouette, and a poised runway-like stride. She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater in {argument name="top color" default="burnt orange"} with decorative gold buttons on one shoulder, a high-waisted pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="warm brown"}, a black belt with a gold buckle, and carries a structured black handbag in one hand. Her expression should feel calm, self-assured, and graceful. Use flattering soft golden-hour lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, crisp fashion-photography detail on the outfit, and slightly blurred businesspeople in the background walking through the plaza to suggest a busy city evening. The background should include exactly 4 distant office workers, softly out of focus, spread across the walkway. Add realistic magazine cover typography integrated over the image: a very large elegant serif masthead on the upper left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"}; beneath it on the left, the cover lines "AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING", "MODERN ELEGANCE", "Polished looks for the office and beyond.", "WORK. WALK. Your best look starts here."; in the lower right, the cover line "EVENING ELEVATED" with the smaller text "From desk to dinner plans— effortless style that transitions beautifully."; and a realistic barcode box at the bottom right with "MAY 2024", US and CAN prices, small issue numbers, and barcode lines. Make the overall composition clean, premium, balanced, and convincingly like a real contemporary fashion magazine cover.

promptZh: Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional divorce-law firm, designed like a high-conversion listing ad LP. Use a soft, elegant, feminine legal-brand aesthetic with a white background, blush pink accents, light gray dividers, and subtle botanical line art. The layout is a single wide desktop web hero split into two main columns: text-heavy content on the left and a lifestyle photo on the right. In the upper left, place the law firm logo and name: a delicate scripted monogram “D” with leaf ornament, followed by the Japanese office name and small English subtitle, shown as {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} and “LAW OFFICE D”. At the top right, include 2 rounded contact boxes: the first is a white phone box with a small phone icon and “24h”, short Japanese support text above, and the large phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}; the second is a pink email consultation button with an envelope icon and Japanese text indicating 24-hour reception. Below it, add a short supporting paragraph in Japanese about supporting clients with divorce-related worries and helping find the best solution, with one phrase highlighted in pink. Near her shoulder, place a pale pink circular badge with Japanese text saying that many female lawyers are on staff and consultations can be made with peace of mind. 请根据{argument name="主题" default="动物"}生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 

这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。

请让画面包含：
- 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉
- 若干局部特征放大细节
- 多个圆角模块化信息分区
- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签
- 简洁但丰富的百科内容
- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块

内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合：
基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。

视觉要求：
浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。

请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理 + 模块信息 + 图鉴式展示”的特征。
promptEn:
Please generate a high-quality vertical version of the "Kip encyclopaedia" according to {argument name= "theme"= "animal"}.

This map is not just a poster, nor a mere illustration, but a modular, generalized map with a “magnitude, encyclopaedia, information structure, collection”. The overall style refers to the combination of advanced mapping, modern encyclopaedia pages, lifestyle knowledge cards and high dissemination of information in social media.

Please let the image include:
- A clear and beautiful subject-matter vision.
- Some local characterization details.
- Multiple rounded modular information partitions
- Clear title levels and focus labels
- Simple but rich encyclopedia.
- Visualized scoring, summary of points or Top 5 module

Content columns should be automatically adapted to the theme, and priority should be given to selecting and reasonably combining these directions:
Basic archives, disaggregated information, visual features, habits/ecosystems, formation of institutional/structural composition, conditions of growth or use, conservation or maintenance advice, risk and care, fit for population or applicable scenes, comparison of strengths and weaknesses, rapid scorecards.

Visual requirements:
Light and clean background, soft colour, light shadows, fine icons, round corner information frames, neat layouts, high information density but not crowded, and good reading experience. The whole must be like a Kosovo encyclopaedia that can really be published, read, collected, serialized, rather than advertising.

Please do not act as a general commercial poster. To highlight the features of " knowledge organization + module information + graphic presentation " .

descriptionEn: A vertical fantasy anime splash-art prompt for generating a heroic celestial warrior surrounded by four wolf and fox-themed companions in a magical sky battle scene.
promptZh: A dramatic high-fantasy anime illustration in a vertical poster composition, showing a celestial sky battle scene with 4 distinct subjects surrounded by glowing blue feathers, crystal shards, and swirling clouds. In the center, a heroic male warrior inspired by Norse mythology stands floating in the air, raising one arm toward a radiant circular magic sigil above him. He has long flowing brown hair, a horned gold-and-blue helmet, a dark teal cape billowing behind him, and ornate black, gold, and turquoise armor with angular geometric trim. His chest is partly exposed, with a bright cyan wolf-emblem glow at the center of his torso, and he holds a long spear with a crystal blue trident-like blade in his other hand. At the bottom foreground, the largest creature is a massive wolf-beast lunging forward toward the viewer, with orange fur, cream mane, huge fangs, oversized claws, and blue crystalline armor covering its head, shoulders, back, and limbs; the crystal plates are faceted and luminous, and the beast wears metallic blue-and-gold bands around its legs and tail. On the upper left, include a second wolf-like humanoid companion in a midair attack pose, with golden-orange fur, athletic muscular anatomy, large spread wings made of sharp blue crystal feathers, blue crystal helmet and shoulder armor, and armored gauntlets and boots with glowing cyan accents. On the right, include a small chibi fox mascot floating cheerfully, with bright orange fur, very large ears, a fluffy tail, huge blue eyes, a smiling open mouth, and a blue tunic with cyan geometric trim and a diamond-shaped chest jewel. The entire image should use vivid electric blues and warm orange-golds for strong contrast, with intense rim lighting, sparkling particles, dynamic motion, stylized manga linework, and highly detailed fantasy rendering. The background is a cosmic storm of luminous clouds and deep starry sky, with a glowing circular constellation-like emblem centered above the warrior, suggesting divine summoning power. Make the scene energetic, triumphant, magical, and epic, like premium anime key art or a trading card game splash illustration.

titleZh: 图片概念/电影海报生成器
descriptionZh: 一个庞大的,高度详细的提示,引导AI为基于单一主题的史诗海报自动获得视觉比喻,等级,和电影照明.
descriptionEn: A massive, highly detailed prompt that directs the AI to automatically derive visual metaphors, hierarchy, and cinematic lighting for an epic poster based on a single theme.
promptZh:
GPT-Image-2 提示词请围绕{argument name="主题" default="中国历史上的皇帝排名"}自动生成一张顶级概念海报 / 信息图式电影海报。

要求 AI 根据这个主题，自动推导并统一设计以下全部视觉系统，不需要我额外指定：
- 核心主体（可以自动判断更适合人物、产品、建筑、器物、符号、场景或抽象意象）
- 底部支撑结构
- 上方悬浮符号或精神象征
- 场景包裹元素
- 隐喻系统
- 色彩层级
- 材质对比
- 光影逻辑
- 标题、副标题、辅助文案
- 品牌感与高级感表达方式

最终画面必须是：
一张震撼、精密、统一、电影级、超高细节、可用于高端印刷的概念主视觉海报。

【总风格】
超写实 3D 商业 CGI 渲染，融合电影级布光、奢侈品视觉语言、未来感概念设计与史诗级构图。画面必须具有“唯一主视觉核心”，不能杂乱，不能像拼贴，不能像普通电商海报。

【自动推导规则】
AI 必须依据【主题】自动决定最合适的：
1. 核心视觉隐喻
2. 主体类型与姿态
3. 支撑结构形式
4. 悬浮元素形式
5. 场景外壳与空间氛围
6. 主色、辅色、强调色
7. 材质组合
8. 文字气质与版式风格

【构图规则】
- 绝对高级感
- 强烈中心秩序，整体统一
- 允许中轴对称或接近中轴的史诗级构图
- 视觉重力明确，从上到下形成清晰的层级落点
- 边缘负空间干净、克制、有呼吸感

【视觉质量】
- 超高细节
- 体积光清晰
- 材质真实
- 反射、折射、阴影、雾气、景深自然
- 整体达到高端品牌 campaign key visual / luxury invitation poster / conceptual editorial poster 水准

【排版系统】
- 整体为 90% 视觉，10% 文字
- AI 根据【主题】自动生成最匹配的主标题和副标题
- 标题必须简洁、锋利、有气势
- 文字必须尽量少而准，不要堆字

【署名要求】
在画面底部角落自然加入作者署名：
@a9quant

titleZh: Epic 东方奇幻人物概念
descriptionZh: 全面催生出高端,电影风格的东方幻想人物CG,其特点是详细描述照明,服装,以及神话元素.

promptZh: 请创作一幅{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}使用{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}的东方幻想人物概念插画。整体风格融合国风仙侠、神话圣像感与电影级CG概念原画质感，画面具有强烈的东方幻想美学、高级审美与史诗感。人物为主视觉核心，气质空灵、神圣、优雅、清冷或威严，根据{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}自动匹配最合适的神态、服饰、发型、配饰与身份设定。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是乐器，则人物呈现演奏、拨弦、吹奏、执乐而立等充满仪式感与流动感的姿态，强调音乐能量、灵气流动、音波化作光纹、云气、星辉或法阵。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是武器，则人物呈现持械、蓄势、对峙、施法或战斗前一瞬的姿态，强调力量感、压迫感、气场与能量汇聚。构图以人物居中或偏中心为主，整体平衡、庄严、具有海报级主视觉效果；人物背后可带有月轮、法环、神性光晕、古老纹阵或圣像式圆形结构。服装采用东方幻想风格，材质轻盈华美，带轻纱、飘带、层叠衣摆、金属饰件、玉饰或冠饰，发丝与布料在风中流动，形成强烈的动态美感。背景根据角色气质自动匹配为星空神域、云海天界、月下圣境、竹林仙山、冰雪秘境、幽夜神坛、古风遗迹等东方幻想场景，环境带有薄雾、流光、粒子、神秘能量与空间纵深。色彩以统一且高级的主色调控制画面，可根据角色和道具自动选择冰蓝、月白、青绿、幽紫、赤金、墨黑、银灰等配色，并用少量淡金或冷光进行神性点缀。整体要求：唯美、梦幻、空灵、神秘、超脱、神圣、精致，具有电影级光影、体积光、空气感、超细节CG插画质感，避免俗艳、避免廉价古风写真感、避免网红脸、避免杂乱背景、避免塑料质感。

promptZh: Create a dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration for a fantasy mecha isekai story. Vertical poster composition with a huge heroic humanoid robot dominating the center foreground, viewed from a slightly low angle to make it monumental. The robot is sleek and ornate, with white and silver armor, rich gold trim, glowing cyan energy lines, a radiant emerald-green core in the chest, a crown-like crest on the helmet, and a long royal blue cape with gold edging. The setting is an epic ruined sci-fi fantasy world with towering gothic spires, broken city structures, drifting smoke, dramatic clouds, and a sky filled with stars, planets, streaks of lightning, and 8 small flying warships scattered in the distance. Highly polished anime key visual style, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, intense contrast, blue-green-gold color palette, heroic atmosphere, intricate mechanical rendering, fantasy worldbuilding, premium game or novel cover finish. promptZh:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、安乐国），是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛土，核心特点是无有众苦、但受诸乐，与我们这个 “堪忍”（婆婆）世界形成鲜明对比。
在我们世界的西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（《阿弥陀经》）。

佛主：教主阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常住说法；左右胁侍为观世音菩萨、大势至菩萨，合称 “西方三圣”。

国土环境：七宝庄严，完美无瑕
大地：黄金为地，平坦柔软、光明洁净，无山川沟壑、荆棘土石。
七宝池与八功德水：
遍地七宝池（金、银、琉璃、玻璃、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。
池水具八功德：甘、冷、软、轻、清、香、饮时、饮已，能除烦恼、润身悦心。
池底金沙，阶道七宝，池中莲花大如车轮，青、黄、赤、白，各放光明。
建筑：七宝楼阁、宫殿、讲堂，浮空而起、随心大小，光明通透，胜过天界无数倍。
宝树与天乐：
七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆四宝所成。
风吹宝树罗网，出微妙法音，如百千乐同时俱作，闻者自然生念佛、念法、念僧之心。
气候与天雨：无寒暑、无风雨，永远温和舒适；昼夜六时，天雨曼陀罗花，缤纷铺落，香气芬芳。
奇禽：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆佛变化所作，出和雅音，宣说佛法，令众生常生善念。

众生：无苦唯乐，寿命无量
往生方式：众生由七宝池莲花化生，非父母胎生，无生老病死之苦。
身形：紫磨金色身，相好庄严，与阿弥陀佛相似；具天眼、天耳、他心、宿命、神足五通，自在无碍。
寿命：无量无边阿僧祇劫，几乎永恒，无夭折衰老。
心性：皆是诸上善人，无贪嗔痴、无嫉妒争斗，人人慈悲平等、智慧清净，常闻佛法、不退菩提。
生活：衣食自然化现，不需劳作；清晨可赴他方十万亿佛土供养诸佛，食时即返，自在无碍。

时间与空间：无限永恒
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒安乐，世界无 “成住坏空” 之变。
空间：广大无边，十方众生尽往亦不拥挤；一微尘可纳三千大千世界，事事无碍。

promptZh: Create a dramatic vertical food advertisement on a pure black background, styled like a premium ingredient breakdown poster for a hearty Chinese chicken mushroom vermicelli stew. Use a clean top-to-bottom exploded composition with floating ingredients suspended in midair above the finished dish, each group clearly separated and lit with glossy commercial food-photography lighting. At the top, show a cluster of mixed brown shiitake and other savory mushrooms. Below that, show 2 grouped aromatics: a pile of red goji berries and a small bundle of green scallions with 2 thick ginger slices. Below that, show 2 grouped main items: several raw chopped bone-in chicken pieces with skin on, and 1 bundled nest of dry vermicelli noodles. Below that, show 2 grouped vegetables: peeled potato cubes and thick carrot slices. Include subtle steam rising from the final stew and 1 bright star-like sparkle highlight on the right rim of the casserole. descriptionZh: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime-style fantasy key visual poster for a two-character adventure story, ideal for film-pamphlet covers, main visuals, or promotional worldbuilding art.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime-style fantasy key visual poster for a two-character adventure story, ideal for film-pamphlet covers, main visuals, or promotional worldbuilding art.
promptZh: A cinematic fantasy anime poster in a tall vertical composition, showing two childlike adventurer characters standing in a vast magical library-cathedral with impossibly high gothic arches, towering bookshelves on both sides, floating pages, glowing dust, and a grand staircase rising in the center toward a radiant portal-like window filled with intricate celestial magic-circle patterns. The viewpoint is low and dramatic, looking slightly upward, with both characters reaching one hand toward the viewer in an inviting gesture. On the left is a slightly taller child with short silver-white hair, soft bangs, and large green leaf-like ear ornaments or animal-like ears, wearing a navy hooded jacket over a warm orange top, dark pants, sturdy boots, and a black crossbody satchel; keep the face partially obscured by framing or angle. On the right is a shorter child with a matching design language, short silver-white bob hair with green-tinted ends, large teal-green eyes, and the same green leaf-like ear features, wearing a navy hooded jacket, orange inner layer, short dark bottoms, boots, and a mauve-purple shoulder bag decorated with small charms including a star. Between their outstretched hands, create a bright burst of magical light where two energies meet: luminous cyan-blue streams curling around the left character and warm pink-gold streams curling around the right character, with spark particles and ribbon-like trails. Split the lighting mood into cool blue on the left side and warm golden-magenta on the right side, blending at the center into a brilliant white flare. Add dense atmospheric detail: glowing motes, magical filaments, floating sheets of paper, layered architecture, and a sense of wonder and discovery. At the top, include centered Japanese tagline text in elegant white serif style: "わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。" At the bottom, place a very large luminous gold serif title reading "{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}" with ornate cinematic poster typography. High-detail, polished key visual, fantasy adventure film poster, richly textured, radiant, emotional, awe-inspiring, premium illustrated promotional art.

promptZh: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

descriptionZh: 这个提示产生了一个现实的闪光摄影恐怖场景,两名妇女在一个黑暗的安全办公室里,一个邪恶的兔子幻象潜伏在门口,对模拟式的惊悚器或吉祥物激流图像来说是理想的.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic flash-photo horror scene of two women in a dark security office with a sinister rabbit animatronic lurking in the doorway, ideal for analog-style thriller or mascot-horror imagery.
promptZh: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.

descriptionEn: A cinematic prompt that creates a seamless transition of the four seasons across a single hyper-realistic panorama of a specific scene.
promptZh: Hyper-realistic digital illustration of {argument name="scene" default="the historic Shanghai Bund waterfront looking across the Huangpu River to the futuristic Lujiazui district"}, presented as a single continuous composition showcasing the cycle of seasons. The scene flows seamlessly from left to right in a natural progression: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Autumn. The left side features cold snowy winter elements, gradually thawing into the fresh green buds and blooms of spring, then morphing into the lush vibrant vegetation and bright sunlight of summer, and finally transitioning into the golden, orange, and red hues of autumn on the far right. There are no visible dividing lines between seasons; the weather, lighting, and vegetation blend smoothly to create a unified and harmonious panorama. Rich in detail, symbolic of the passage of time, cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed textures. --ar 4:3

descriptionEn: A retro comic poster showing a smug orange cat ruining a simple home repair in three Spanish-labeled steps, ideal for memes, social posts, and humorous DIY content.
promptZh: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.

promptZh: A cinematic vertical poster of {argument name="subject name" default="Sam Altman"} styled like a futuristic football superstar campaign image, waist-up portrait, centered, arms crossed, wearing a plain dark navy or black crewneck sweater, confident and calm posture, looking slightly off-camera. Place him inside a dramatic high-tech stadium or arena at night with bright floodlights glowing from the upper left, dark steel architecture overhead, and a cool blue sci-fi atmosphere. Add floating particles and light debris in the air for energy and motion. Surround the subject with futuristic AI interface graphics: 1 glowing wireframe cube icon on the left side, 1 luminous digital brain or neural-network globe on the right side, and multiple transparent holographic dashboard screens with charts and data panels behind him. Use a deep blue, black, and white color palette with sharp contrast, glossy highlights, subtle lens glow, and premium blockbuster poster lighting. Behind them is a dense, worn urban skyline of low rooftops and distant modern skyscrapers fading into haze, under a heavy overcast sky with thick gray storm clouds. descriptionEn: Generates a realistic, gritty mugshot of a heavily tattooed woman holding a blurred placard against a height chart background.
promptZh: A realistic, slightly grainy, low-lighting mugshot of a young woman with long, messy black hair, prominent cheekbones, and full lips. She has a small tattoo near her right eye and extensive, intricate mandala-style tattoos covering her neck, chest, and both hands/arms. She is wearing a simple black sleeveless top. She is holding up a rectangular white placard with blurred-out text, held with both hands showing long, manicured nails. The background is a plain white cinderblock wall with a height chart on the right side, showing numbers like 150, 160, and 170 in black stencil font. The overall aesthetic is gritty and raw, resembling a genuine police booking photograph.
promptEn: A realistic, slightly grainy, low-lighting mugshot of a young woman with long, messy black hair, prominent cheekbones, and full lips. She has a small tattoo near her right eye and extensive, intricate mandala-style tattoos covering her neck, chest, and both hands/arms. She is wearing a simple black sleeveless top. She is holding up a rectangular white placard with blurred-out text, held with both hands showing long, manicured nails. The background is a plain white cinderblock wall with a height chart on the right side, showing numbers like 150, 160, and 170 in black stencil font. The overall aesthetic is gritty and raw, resembling a genuine police booking photograph.

promptZh: Create a hyper-realistic open-world crime video game screenshot in the style of a modern Miami-inspired beach club mission scene, captured in bright midday sunlight with a clear blue sky. Place him large in frame, off-center left, with natural relaxed body posture. Behind him, depict an upscale beachfront club with exactly 3 white cabanas with flowing curtains visible across the sand, multiple tall palm trees, turquoise ocean water on the left, and an art-deco hotel strip on the right with pastel facades and neon accents. Populate the beach with a lively crowd of exactly 12 background people in swimwear: some standing and chatting, some walking near the shoreline, and exactly 2 seated at a dining table on the right with food and drinks. Include white lounge furniture, umbrellas, and a polished social party atmosphere. Add a convincing video game HUD overlay: a square mini-map in the bottom-left labeled {argument name="map label" default="GPS Route"}, weapon and control icons in the bottom-right, and a money counter in the top-right reading {argument name="money amount" default="$45,670"}. The overall feel should resemble a next-gen Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay screenshot, cinematic but clearly in-game, with sharp environmental detail, realistic shadows, vibrant coastal color grading, and subtle satirical luxury-beach energy in {argument name="city setting" default="Vice City"}.

descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for a watercolor and colored pencil style illustrated map of Chengdu's famous food locations.
promptZh: 一张手绘风格的城市美食地图，以{argument name="城市" default="成都"}为主题。画面以鸟瞰视角的手绘简化城市地图为底，标注主要道路和地标但不追求精确比例而是追求可爱的手绘感。地图上分布着 12 个美食地点的精致手绘小插画：{argument name="地标" default="春熙路的串串香"}（一把竹签插着各种食材冒着热气）、宽窄巷子的三大炮（三个糯米团子飞向铜盘）、建设路的蛋烘糕（金黄酥脆正在翻面）、玉林路的火锅（九宫格锅翻滚冒泡）等，每个插画约占地图的 5% 面积，旁边用手写体标注店名和一句推荐语"凌晨两点还在排队的那家"。地图边缘用手绘藤蔓和辣椒装饰形成边框。右下角有一个手绘指南针和图例说明。左上角标题"{argument name="标题" default="成都·吃货暴走地图"}"使用胖圆的手绘美术字配辣椒装饰。整体画风为水彩+彩铅混合的手绘质感，颜色以暖色系（辣椒红、姜黄、翠绿）为主，图片比例 1:1。
promptEn: A hand-drawn-style map of the city's cuisine, with the theme {argument name= "city"= "Sundu". The image is based on hand-drawing from a bird's-eye perspective to simplify urban maps, indicating the main roads and landmarks, but not the exact proportions, but rather the lovely hand-drawing. The map contains fine hand-painted illustrations of 12 good eating sites: {argument name= "George"= "Swiss of Spring Hee Road"} (a piece of bamboo with all kinds of food in heat), three cannons in a narrow alley (three knobs flying towards copper), egg cakes for road construction (gold beaks turning over), fire pots on Oklim Road (the nine-mong pan rolls) and so forth, each of which represents about 5 per cent of the map, with hand-written shop names and a reference "the house in line at two o'clock." The edges of the map are bordered by hand-painted vines and peppers. There is a hand-drawing compass and illustration at the bottom right corner. The top left corner title, "Argument name" = "title" default = "Sundu Eating Battered Maps" = "Use a chubby hand-drawing word with chili decorations." The overall wind is a mixed hand-painting sense of water colour + lead, the colour of which is dominated by a warm colour system (cream, ginger yellow, green) with a scale of 1:1.

卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。

卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。

主题是：“{argument name="主题内容" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}”
promptEn:
Created a hand-drawn-style information card at 9:16 vertical. The card theme is clear, with a background of paper-based membrane or white, and the overall design reflects a simple, friendly hand-drawn beauty.

The top of the card highlights the headlines in a contrasted, big, big-blank text to attract visual focus. The text is divided into two to four distinct subsections, each of which expresses the core points in a short and refined Chinese phrase. The fonts maintain a fluent rhythm of grass and books, which is clear-readable and artistic.

A simple, interesting hand-drawing illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbols, have been inserted in the cards to enhance the visual appeal and to stimulate the reader to think and resonate. The overall layout is sensitive to the visual balance, leaving enough space to ensure that the picture is simple, clear, easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name= "The Subject Content" default=" doing IP is long-term compounding, insisting on a daily stand-up and doing it on an ongoing basis, which will certainly bear fruit, because 99% of them cannot hold. "}"

descriptionZh: 制作类似孩子的手绘旅行日记插画,
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for creating a child-like, hand-drawn travel journal illustration with customizable city names, landmarks, and routes.
promptZh:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）手绘风格的《{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行手账插画》，画风仿佛由一位充满好奇心的孩子用蜡笔创作，整体使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色、绿色等明亮色调，营造温馨、童趣、满满旅行气息的氛围。

一、主画面：手账式旅行路线

在插画中央绘制一条“蜿蜒曲折的旅行路线”，路线用箭头 + 虚线连接多个地点，由 {argument name="天数" default="1"} 日行程自动生成推荐景点：

示例格式（自动替换为{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}相关）：

- “第 1 站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 2 站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 3 站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- …
- “最终站：{当地招牌美食/纪念品 + 温馨结束语}”

> 旅程站点数量随天数自动生成：
> 若用户未输入天数，则按默认 1 日 / 精华线路生成。

---

二、周围趣味元素（全部根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围加入大量充满童趣的小元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：
  “拿着当地特色小吃的小朋友”、
  “背着旅行包的冒险小孩”等。

- 当地标志性建筑的童趣 Q 版手绘：
  如 “{城市地标1}”、“{城市地标2}”、“{城市地标3}”。

- 有趣的提示牌：
  “小心迷路！”、“注意人流！”、“前方好吃的！”（可根据城市语境调整）。

- 贴纸式小标语：
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行记忆已解锁！”
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}美食大冒险！”
  “下一站去哪儿？”

- 当地美食的可爱小图标：
  如 “{城市美食1}”、“{城市美食2}”、“{城市美食3}”。

- 感叹句（保持童真风）：
  “原来{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}这么好玩！”
  “我要再来一次！”

---

三、整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩鲜艳、构图饱满但温暖
- 强调旅行的欢乐与探索感
- 所有文字采用可爱的手写字体
- 让整个画面像一本童趣满满的旅行手账页面

promptZh: A cinematic dark fantasy photograph of a weathered marble-like woman seen from behind in a ruined garden at sunset, framed from mid-back upward. She has an antique Greco-Roman appearance with pale stone-textured skin, hair pinned into a loose classical updo, and a draped one-shoulder gown in aged ivory fabric that looks cracked, dusty, and partially fused to her body like an eroded sculpture. descriptionEn: This prompt restores a black-and-white wartime reference photo into a realistic, historically accurate colorized image for archival, editorial, or educational use.
promptZh: Using the provided reference image, colorize the original black-and-white WWII paratrooper photo into a realistic, historically accurate color restoration. Preserve the exact composition, pose, gear, weapon, cropped face block, background, and photographic framing. Add natural period-appropriate colors: khaki/tan uniform and jump gear, olive drab pack, brown leather boots and straps, wood-toned rifle stock, dark metal gun body, muted earth tones for the dirt road and building, green trees, and a soft pale blue sky. Make the 82nd Airborne shoulder patch historically correct with 1 visible patch in red, white, and blue. Keep the result looking like a faithful documentary-era restoration rather than a modern stylized repaint.

promptZh: A hyper-detailed premium collectible trading card illustration of {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider Decade"} in the center foreground, posed in a ruined futuristic city battlefield under a dramatic cosmic night sky. The armored hero wears a glossy magenta, black, and white suit with a segmented helmet and large luminous green compound eyes, facing the viewer in a powerful stance. One arm is thrust forward toward the camera, holding up a character card between black gloved fingers so the card is clearly visible in forced perspective; the other hand gives a confident thumbs-up. The belt device is prominent at the waist. Surrounding the hero are exactly 8 secondary figures and monsters scattered through the rubble and midair battle scene: 1 blue-and-red armored rider crouching in the bottom left foreground, 1 red-and-gold armored rider on the right midground, 2 small rider figures in the distant center background, 2 flying figures in the upper background, and 2 monstrous enemy creatures on the right side, one mid-right and one bottom-right. At the top center, large embossed title text reads {argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER DECADE"}, with smaller text above reading "MASKED RIDER". Behind him is a chaotic apocalyptic city battle scene at night with ruined buildings, smoke, sparks, streaking explosions, and a star-filled cosmic sky. The art style is gritty, painterly, metallic, and cinematic, with dense glitter particles, rainbow foil reflections, gold filigree linework, and prism-like holographic highlights across the entire image. At the bottom center place the text "KAMEN RIDER 1" with "仮面ライダー1号" below it, and a barcode-like strip with the text "RIDER LEGEND 1971". In the bottom right add a large gold cursive autograph reading "{argument name="signature" default="NickZag"}". descriptionZh: A detailed prompt for creating a cinematic, photorealistic poster that blends reality with surreal concepts, featuring deep customization for branding and visual elements.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for creating a cinematic, photorealistic poster that blends reality with surreal concepts, featuring deep customization for branding and visual elements.
promptZh:
ジャンル：{argument name="ジャンル" default="ハンバーガー"}
ブランド名：{argument name="ブランド名" default="かし子"}

この画像をベースに、世界中のどこにも存在しない、発想が常識を完全に逸脱したフォトリアルなポスター画像を生成してください。

単なる延長ではなく、「意味は通じるが解釈が狂っている」レベルまで発想を飛躍させること。

【絶対条件】
・フォトリアル表現（実写のような質感、空気感、光の粒子まで再現）
・言語はすべて日本語

【誇張・ブーストする要素】
■フォントデザイン
・文字そのものが物体化・現象化している
・フォントがテーマと物理的に相互作用している

■文字の配置
・通常のレイアウトを無視し、空間そのものに配置
・視線誘導が異常に強い配置

■構図
・非現実的なパース、極端な広角、歪み、スケール破壊
・手前・中景・奥のレイヤーが明確で、情報密度が異常に高い
・一瞬で目を引く中心要素＋細部に無数の違和感

■ライティング
・映画レベルのシネマティック照明
・強烈な逆光、リムライト、ネオン、粒子光、ボリュームライト
・光自体が意味を持つ（導線や強調として機能）

■キャッチコピー
・短く、強烈で、意味が分かるのに理解が追いつかない日本語
・状況とズレているのに妙にハマるコピー

【追加演出】
・現実と非現実が同時に成立している違和感
・一部が物理法則を無視している
・広告として成立しているクオリティ（プロレベル）

最終的に「理解できるのに理解が追いつかない」「二度見する」ポスターにすること。
参考画像がキャラクターの場合、そのブランドを身につけている・使用している・食べようとしている、等の動作等を適用する。
実在のブランドロゴ・会社名・人名等は一切使用せず、完全オリジナルにする。最終仕上げ時に実在のものが含まれていないか確認すること。
過度な描き込みによるノイズやバランスの崩れを抑制し、画面全体の統一感と洗練された印象を維持する。

■文字の配置
・通常のレイアウトを無視し、空間そのものに配置
・視線誘導が異常に強い配置

■構図
・非現実的なパース、極端な広角、歪み、スケール破壊
・手前・中景・奥のレイヤーが明確で、情報密度が異常に高い
・一瞬で目を引く中心要素＋細部に無数の違和感

■ライティング
・映画レベルのシネマティック照明
・強烈な逆光、リムライト、ネオン、粒子光、ボリュームライト
・光自体が意味を持つ（導線や強調として機能）

■キャッチコピー
・短く、強烈で、意味が分かるのに理解が追いつかない日本語
・状況とズレているのに妙にハマるコピー

【追加演出】
・現実と非現実が同時に成立している違和感
・一部が物理法則を無視している
・広告として成立しているクオリティ（プロレベル）

最終的に「理解できるのに理解が追いつかない」「二度見する」ポスターにすること。
参考画像がキャラクターの場合、そのブランドを身につけている・使用している・食べようとしている、等の動作等を適用する。
実在のブランドロゴ・会社名・人名等は一切使用せず、完全オリジナルにする。最終仕上げ時に実在のものが含まれていないか確認すること。
過度な描き込みによるノイズやバランスの崩れを抑制し、画面全体の統一感と洗練された印象を維持する。

The jersey should include a white sponsor wordmark across the chest, a small white swoosh-style logo, the round club crest, and a tricolor shield patch. Behind the player, place a huge glowing circular Inter-style emblem graphic as a backdrop. Add 3 visible club logos total: 1 small logo at the top right, 1 large fabric flag logo at the bottom left, and 1 crest on the shirt. At the bottom center, include a night view of a modern football stadium with bright floodlights, blending into painterly blue smoke and brush-stroke effects. Across the center, place the player surname in huge rough hand-painted lettering, partially obscured by the figure, plus a large handwritten-style number 9 on the right. Add 8 text elements around the design: top center small text “INTER MILAN”; upper left stacked name text with the player name and a blue “9”; left-middle slogan “NATO PER SEGNARE”; right side vertical text “I M INTER”; right-middle slogan “FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”; lower right city text “SAN SIRO”; lower right small text “MILANO ITALIA”; bottom center small text “1908” and “LA BENEAMATA”. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. descriptionZh: A professional and highly detailed instruction prompt for generating isometric, cross-section views of miniature thematic worlds with high information density.
descriptionEn: A professional and highly detailed instruction prompt for generating isometric, cross-section views of miniature thematic worlds with high information density.
promptZh:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「微缩世界剖面馆 / Isometric Micro-World Archive」视觉图。

这不是普通房间插画，也不是单纯的建筑图，而是一张结合“等距轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景设定集感”的主题空间总览图。画面需要像一个被剖开的微缩世界、经营模拟游戏场景、玩具屋模型或世界观设定图，让观者可以一眼看懂整体结构，又能反复观察其中的小细节。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药剂工坊 / AI自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站】
空间名称 / 品牌名：【品牌名或空间名称，可为空】
世界观方向：【现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 末日 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 经营模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态】
建筑类型：【小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 商店 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 飞船 / 多层工作室】
核心功能：【这个空间主要用来做什么，例如研究、生产、展示、生活、训练、交易、学习、维修、种植】

titleZh: Isometric 像素艺术进化博物馆
descriptionZh: 详细提示创建一个同位素像素艺术时间表插图,以博物馆画廊格式描绘一个主题如西方艺术的发展.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for creating an isometric pixel art timeline illustration that depicts the evolution of a subject, such as Western Art, in a museum gallery format.
promptZh:
创作一张超高细节等距像素艺术时间线插画（3:4，4K），融合细节密度、象征性与隐喻。用户指定的主题为【{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}】。

首先，围绕{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}进行推理，确定：主题的中英文标题、涵盖的最早与最近历史时期、起始阶段标签与结束阶段标签，以及3-5个关键演进阶段及其各自的象征性元素与色彩方案。

然后构建一个以"{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}"为主题的等距"演进博物馆"，每个展馆区域代表一个演进阶段，空间推进即代表时间演变。采用标准等距视角（2:1），丰富的层次深度与流畅过渡。每个阶段分配3-5个与主题强烈关联的象征元素，并用差异化色彩暗示时间流动。在场景中融入双语像素字体标题：中文"[主题中文]演进史"与英文"EVOLUTION OF {argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}"，加上起止阶段的双语副标题及关键时间节点标记。整体风格专业且具视觉张力，适合学术分析与对比可视化，直接出图。
