descriptionZh: This prompt generates a polished four-panel isometric science infographic with miniature 3D dioramas for biology, physics, chemistry, and astronomy, ideal for concept visualization or educational social posts.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a polished four-panel isometric science infographic with miniature 3D dioramas for biology, physics, chemistry, and astronomy, ideal for concept visualization or educational social posts.
promptZh: A clean 2x2 conceptual entity model infographic on a soft light background, showing four separate floating isometric diorama tiles that personify branches of {argument name="theme" default="science"} in a polished 3D illustration style with pastel gradients, glossy materials, soft ambient lighting, subtle shadows, rounded futuristic forms, and high detail. Top left: BIOLOGY, a lush bio-lab island with a large central DNA double helix tower, curved glass greenhouse architecture, spiral stairways, layered organic pathways, greenery, plant beds, and fluid biomorphic structures; the word "BIOLOGY" is integrated on the front edge of the platform. Surrounding this tile are 4 small biology-related icons: a microscope, a DNA symbol, a sprouting plant, and a circular cell or petri-dish symbol. Top right: PHYSICS, a high-tech energy laboratory tile in cool blue tones with a central glowing platform, circular accelerator rings, copper-like electromagnetic coils, stairs leading up to the core, a monitor screen with waveform graphics, and a futuristic industrial base labeled "PHYSICS"; add 4 surrounding physics-themed icons: an atom, a horseshoe magnet, a lightning bolt, and a line graph waveform. Bottom left: CHEMISTRY, a modular molecular research structure in purple and silver, built from spheres-and-rods lattice frameworks, lab columns, beakers, flasks, and a glowing crystalline core; the platform prominently reads "CHEMISTRY" on two visible sides. Surrounding this tile are 4 chemistry-related icons: two molecular diagrams, a pair of lab test tubes or flasks, and a small burner. Bottom right: ASTRONOMY, a rocky lunar observatory island with cratered terrain, a dome observatory, a telescope, stairs carved into the rock, and a circular cosmic starfield backdrop behind it; the front edge reads "ASTRONOMY". Surrounding this tile are 4 astronomy-themed icons: a ringed planet, spark-like stars, a small rocket, and a crescent moon. Keep all 4 tiles evenly spaced in a quadrant layout, each with its own muted geometric backdrop shape, cohesive pastel palette tuned per discipline, and a premium gpt-image-2 style that makes each concept feel like a collectible miniature world. In the center, place the largest panel: a luminous blue-framed desktop editing interface showing a vivid futuristic cityscape at sunrise, viewed from above with a river, greenery, sleek skyscrapers, warm orange sunlight, and a right-side vertical toolbar including sliders and a color wheel. Surround this centerpiece with 5 smaller glowing panels connected by curved gold arrows pointing outward from the center. Top left panel: a thumbnail example with a futuristic city image and Japanese text reading "未来を、いま創る。", smaller subtext "AI × Innovation" and "時代のソリューション", and a bright cyan label below the panel reading "サムネイル". Top right panel: a banner example with an abstract blue digital globe or network image and Japanese text reading "AIで、未来をデザインする。" with smaller subtext "テクノロジーで、社会にインパクトを。", and a cyan label below reading "バナー". Bottom left panel: a slide/document example with a business infographic style, title text "AIでビジネスを加速", three circular icon areas, an upward graph on the right, and a cyan label below reading "資料・スライド". Bottom center panel: an SNS post example showing a person standing on a mountain peak at sunrise with bold Japanese text "挑戦が、未来を変える。", small social media engagement icons and counts along the bottom bar, and a cyan label below reading "SNS画像". Bottom right panel: a flyer example with a dark blue event poster layout, title text "AI活用セミナー", smaller line "ビジネスの可能性を広げる", large date "6.15", time "10:00–17:00", a yellow circular badge reading "参加費無料", and a cyan label below reading "チラシ・パンフレット". On the right side of the overall composition, place a young woman presenter from waist up, facing forward, lightly smiling, raising her right index finger near her face as if making a key point. promptZh:
Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional premium consumer tech product brand called {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"}. The page should look like a modern beauty-tech and food-safety product website, in a soft warm beige and ivory palette with elegant editorial styling, lots of whitespace, and subtle luxury cosmetics branding. Use a wide desktop web layout screenshot with a top navigation bar, a large left-aligned headline block, and a right-side lifestyle product photo composition.

The top header contains 8 visible navigation elements in a single row: the brand logo text "DOKUMI" at far left, then "ABOUT", "PRODUCT", "FEATURE", "INGREDIENT", "VOICE", "Q&A", then a small user account icon, and a rounded red call-to-action button labeled "今すぐ購入する" at the far right. Beneath the button area on the upper right, add a vertical red ribbon badge with white Japanese text reading exactly 4 stacked text groups: "発売記念", "限定", "20%", "OFF", plus small "CAMPAIGN" text below.

The hero section is split into two main columns. On the left, place a very large Japanese headline in elegant Mincho-style serif typography over three lines: "一口目は、", then "AIが先に。" with dramatic scale and generous spacing. Below it, add a smaller two-line Japanese subheading describing AI-based detection of food toxins, foreign substances, and allergens before eating, in a refined gray tone. Under that, place 2 horizontal CTA buttons: a filled red rounded button labeled "今すぐ始める" with a right arrow, and a white outlined rounded button labeled "詳しく見る" with a right arrow.

Below the buttons, add a row of 3 rounded white feature cards with thin borders and simple black line icons. The 3 cards are: 1) shield icon with title "AI画像解析" and a smaller subtitle about detecting toxins with high precision, 2) clock icon with title "3秒判定" and a smaller subtitle about instant results just by holding it up, 3) smartphone icon with title "スマホ連携" and a smaller subtitle about automatic history saving in the app.

At the bottom of the hero, add a row of 3 statistic cards with rounded corners and thin borders. The 3 cards read: 1) "累計販売台数※1" with large number "23,500" and smaller "台突破", 2) "満足度※2" with large number "94.3%", 3) "リピート率※2" with large number "81.2%". To the right of these cards, place 2 small footnote lines in Japanese: "※1 2026年4月時点 自社調べ" and "※2 2026年3月調査 N=180".

On the right side, create a soft, glamorous lifestyle photo scene. Show a stylish young woman with shoulder-length softly curled brown hair, fair skin, and a large red polka-dot bow headband. She wears an off-shoulder white ruffled blouse and rests her face lightly on one hand at a glossy tabletop. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular skin-tone privacy block. In front of her on the table sits a sleek white handheld scanner device with a rounded vertical body and a small dark lens opening near the top rim accented in red. Next to the device is a realistic glossy red apple. Near the device, overlay a dark blue circular callout badge with white Japanese text reading "毒性チェック" and "わずか3秒", with a small plus sign beneath.

Use soft natural window light from the left, faint diagonal light streaks on the background wall, gentle shadows, realistic product rendering, and a premium e-commerce LP aesthetic. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and slightly playful, like a startup landing page for an unusual AI gadget. Include all visible Japanese text exactly where specified.

promptZh: A soft, airy studio photograph on a warm off-white background with a minimalist Japanese greeting-card aesthetic. Show a small child, about toddler to preschool age, running joyfully toward the camera from left-center, with one arm raised high holding a tall pole with 2 carp streamers attached: 1 large blue koinobori on top and 1 smaller red koinobori below. The child wears a simple handmade samurai helmet folded from paper, a loose long-sleeve ivory shirt, light beige pants with rolled cuffs, and white sneakers. Keep the face unobtrusive and generic, with the focus on motion, innocence, and seasonal atmosphere. Surround the child with delicate hand-drawn doodle illustrations in thin gray pencil-like lines and faint pastel accents: 2 puffy clouds, 1 flying bird, 1 small origami crane near the text, 4 drifting leaves, 2 curved wind-line clusters, 1 small house, 2 tall trees, 2 purple iris flowers with grass at the bottom left, and sparse grass marks along the ground. descriptionZh: This prompt generates a polished Japanese-style promotional poster for a sustainability or community project, suitable for flyers, campaign visuals, and nonprofit branding.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a polished Japanese-style promotional poster for a sustainability or community project, suitable for flyers, campaign visuals, and nonprofit branding.
promptZh: A polished Japanese promotional poster for a community and sustainability project called {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}, designed like a premium eco-lifestyle campaign flyer. Vertical layout, clean and elegant, with a soft cream paper background and a luminous, aspirational mood. The top half is dominated by a giant translucent globe centered in the composition, glowing with warm sunrise light from the upper right. Inside the globe is a breathtaking aerial landscape of a green mountain valley opening to a calm blue bay or lake, with tiny villages and fields below, cinematic and utopian. Over the globe, place a smaller Japanese slogan line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"} and beneath it the large main title in bold dark navy Japanese calligraphic lettering: {argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}. Around the globe, create a collage of exactly 8 candid lifestyle photos fading into the edges: 1) top left, two people in conversation outdoors under trees; 2) upper left-mid, several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) left middle, a circle gathering inside a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) lower left, two portrait-style figures in nature; 5) top right, a group sharing a meal at a long table in warm indoor light; 6) right middle, a person tending plants or crops; 7) right lower-mid, a line of people holding hands on a ridge at sunset; 8) lower right, a close portrait of a person eating or holding food. The photographic style should feel human, communal, slightly idealized, with soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden-hour highlights, and smooth ad-poster compositing. The bottom half contains 3 evenly spaced feature cards on a light cream background, separated by subtle vertical dividers. Card 1 on the left has the heading "セカイムラ 新月会" in dark blue, a circular photo of a nighttime campfire circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 2 in the center has the heading "セカイムラ 満月会" in warm gold, a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, decorative radiating sunburst lines around the circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 3 on the right has the heading "セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し" in green, small rice plant illustrations near the title, a circular photo of a wooden bowl of white rice, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Under these cards, add a centered Japanese statement line in dark blue: {argument name="footer slogan" default="人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。"}. Beneath that, place 4 small icon-and-text items in a horizontal row, each with a simple thin-line icon and two-line Japanese label: 1) people icon with "つながる 仲間と出会える"; 2) house icon with "まなぶ 暮らしを学べる"; 3) sprout icon with "つくる 未来を共につくる"; 4) globe icon with "ひろがる 世界にひろげる". At the very bottom center, include a circular logo mark followed by the project name in Japanese, and underneath a website URL: {argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"}. Add a small QR code at the bottom right with tiny Japanese text indicating details are on the website. Use a refined palette of deep navy, forest green, gold, cream, and sky blue. Overall style: high-end Japanese nonprofit poster, eco-community branding, inspirational, harmonious, photoreal collage with subtle graphic design elements, balanced typography, soft glows, and magazine-quality print finish.

Keep the curry recognizable as the same dish, but restyle it as a premium food photograph served in a rustic ceramic bowl on a wooden tabletop, with richer gloss, deeper color contrast, and more appetizing texture. Create a full editorial layout with 3 main content areas: 1) a large hero section at the top featuring the plated curry on the right and Japanese promotional copy on the left, including a small top banner label and a large headline; 2) a bottom-left chef profile area with 1 portrait of a chef in dark workwear and apron, arms crossed in a restaurant kitchen, plus vertical Japanese copy and a handwritten-style name caption; 3) a bottom-right information area containing 1 quote block and 1 framed “secret of deliciousness” panel with exactly 3 numbered steps, each paired with a food or cooking image. Add warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, spices and garlic props around the hero dish, and an upscale traditional restaurant branding feel. Include Japanese text throughout, with the main headline emphasizing slow-cooked, exquisite curry, and use elegant Mincho-style typography in brown, cream, and gold tones. The final composition should look like a high-end restaurant feature article or promotional brochure page.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a realistic nostalgic group portrait of 6 Japanese schoolgirls in uniform posing with peace signs at a cherry-blossom-lined school graduation entrance.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic nostalgic group portrait of 6 Japanese schoolgirls in uniform posing with peace signs at a cherry-blossom-lined school graduation entrance.
promptZh: A soft, realistic Japanese graduation-day photo in the style of vintage film photography, showing 6 teenage schoolgirls standing together outdoors in front of a school gate under full-bloom cherry blossoms. They wear matching Japanese high school uniforms: navy blazers, white shirts, burgundy ribbon bows, gray-blue plaid pleated skirts, navy knee-high socks, and black loafers, each carrying a large navy school bag. The group stands close together on the road at the entrance, with relaxed celebratory body language and a candid class-photo feel. At least 5 of the girls are making peace signs near their faces, and one girl on the far right raises her hand in a playful salute-like pose. Emphasize natural, flattering leg shapes, neat straight dark hair with soft bangs, youthful styling, and believable proportions. The composition is front-facing and full-body, with the students centered slightly left and the school gate on the right. Include a tall black gate pillar with vertical gold Japanese text reading "桜花女子高等学校" and a white ceremonial signboard beside it with large Japanese text reading "卒業証書授与式" and smaller school-name text below. Background filled with pale pink sakura trees in bloom, shallow depth of field, soft pastel tones, gentle spring haze, overcast bright daylight, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and an understated nostalgic atmosphere like an old-fashioned commemorative photograph.

descriptionEn: This generates a photorealistic Japanese izakaya promotional poster featuring a woman holding a highball, bold pricing text, and four featured dishes for restaurant advertising or nightlife-themed visuals.
promptZh: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. promptZh:

The masthead is enormous across the top in elegant soft pink serif letters reading "L’Allure", with small Japanese text above it and a bracketed Japanese subtitle at the top right. The issue information appears on the upper left as a large black "5" with smaller stacked text beside and below it indicating May 2026, No.156, and a May 2026 issue line. The cover features two adult East Asian women standing side by side from about mid-thigh upward, posed like a luxury editorial cover. The woman on the left wears a navy blouse with dramatic koi-scale sleeves in navy, white, and silver, styled with a bow or scarf-like neckline, tucked into a long flowing off-white skirt with a wide waistband. She carries 1 fish-shaped handbag: a navy and cream koi-inspired purse with a round eye detail, scale pattern, tail fin silhouette, gold hardware, and a thin chain strap hanging from her hand. Her hair is dark brown to black, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands framing her face. Her pose is elegant and slightly angled, one hand near her chin.

Her dark hair is tied back in a low ponytail. She stands facing slightly left with relaxed hands and a calm editorial expression implied by pose.

The palette is soft sky blue, blush pink, navy, white, cream, and coral red. Fabrics appear smooth, elegant, and lightly flowing, with printed or embroidered scale patterns. The overall mood is graceful, feminine, seasonal, and upscale, balancing tradition with modern fashion.

Add multiple Japanese cover lines in a realistic editorial layout. Near the lower left, place 1 circular pink badge with white and cream Japanese text about a special walking guide supplement. Across the lower center, place a large dramatic Japanese main headline in pink and black serif and brush-style type, spanning most of the width.

descriptionZh: A polished product-poster prompt for generating a fictional anime mecha schoolgirl plastic model kit advertisement with a hero figure and five labeled detail panels.
descriptionEn: A polished product-poster prompt for generating a fictional anime mecha schoolgirl plastic model kit advertisement with a hero figure and five labeled detail panels.
promptZh:
Create a premium Japanese plastic model kit product-poster layout on a clean white studio background with subtle gray gradients and a glossy floor reflection. The main subject is a highly detailed anime mecha schoolgirl figure posed dynamically in the center-left, in a wide combat stance, holding a katana horizontally across the frame with one robotic hand gripping the hilt and the other making a peace sign near her face. The character has a blurred face area, short dark navy-blue hair in a tousled bob with small side strands, and gold horn-like mechanical hair ornaments. Her outfit is a fusion of a Japanese high school sailor uniform and hard-surface sci-fi armor: white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, bulky white armored thighs and shins, red and blue accent parts, gold circular joint details, a dark blue waist ribbon or back cloth, and red mechanical backpack-like attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana has a dark blade and a blue-and-gold wrapped handle. Render the figure like a professionally photographed collectible model or action plastic kit, with sharp material definition, realistic molded plastic surfaces, slight satin sheen, and commercial product-shot lighting.

Design the page as a figure advertisement/spec sheet with exactly 1 large hero image and 5 smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The 5 right-side panels must show: 1) close-up of the head and hair ornaments, 2) upper-body torso detail with sailor scarf and chest armor, 3) weapon and articulated hand close-up with the sword near the face, 4) waist attachment and skirt/hip armor detail, 5) leg detail close-up showing joints and armor construction. Include thin blue divider accents around the right-side panel area.

At the top left, place a large Japanese title in bold serif-like characters reading "女子甲生", with the middle character in dark red and the others in dark navy. Beneath it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line: "— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —". On the upper right, place a sleek logo and brand name reading "{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}" with small Japanese text beneath it. Add a vertical Japanese slogan block on the left side of the hero figure reading "鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。" with the middle phrase in red. Add Japanese captions beneath each of the 5 right-side detail panels: "表情造形", "上半身ディテール", "武装・可動手", "腰部アタッチメント", "脚部ディテール". In the lower left, include a boxed scale label reading "{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}" and nearby English product text reading "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT". Add two small bullet lines in Japanese beneath that: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". descriptionZh: A highly detailed prompt for a Japanese movie poster aesthetic, focusing on composition, natural lighting, and emotional distance inspired by classic romance films.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed prompt for a Japanese movie poster aesthetic, focusing on composition, natural lighting, and emotional distance inspired by classic romance films.
promptZh: Japanese realistic romance movie poster style, inspired by 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet', a pair of young Japanese couple in their twenties standing in a daily urban scene (street or intersection), maintaining a subtle and realistic distance from each other, no physical contact, like a moment of gradual estrangement in a relationship. The mood is quiet and restrained, with unuttered emotions and a sense of time passing. The composition is the main visual of a movie, characters located at the bottom or to one side, retaining a large area of white space to emphasize space and atmosphere. Light is natural (overcast or dusk), low-saturation gray-blue, beige, and warm gray tones, realistic photography texture. The image has fine film grain and a slight sense of daily life, not intentionally aesthetic, not over-decorated, like a frame from a real movie. A small amount of natural floral materials can be added at the edges or foreground as a metaphor (restrained, not excessive, not decorative). Add the title '花束みたいな恋をした' in the white space area, thin Mincho font, simple and sparse layout; add 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet' in a smaller font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese movie poster texture, artistic, restrained, everyday life, emphasizing relationships over romantic symbols, avoiding sugary romance, avoiding flower piles, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding crowded compositions, avoiding the 'exquisite but hollow' AI feel. Negative prompt: AI feel, over-aesthetic, sea of flowers, romantic filters, excessive lighting effects, high saturation, neon lights, intimate couple embrace, posed feel, photobooth composition, internet celebrity style, illustration feel, 3D rendering, cluttered elements. Japanese minimalist artistic movie poster style, inspired by 'Love Letter', winter snow scene, a close-up of a young woman's face, face close to or semi-buried in the snow, tiny snowflakes falling naturally. The composition is a restrained close-up side profile or slightly tilted face, with the person occupying a large proportion of the screen but not overly sharp, edges slightly softened or slightly out of focus. Expression is calmness after sadness, with tears or tear marks in the eyes, emotions introverted and restrained, like having just cried and slowly returning to silence, eyes not looking at the camera, with a sense of memory and void. Light is winter natural scattered light or overcast soft light, cool white, light gray, pale blue tones, low saturation, low contrast, no strong shadows, no dramatic lighting effects. The snow and air form a clean background. The image texture is between real photography and film, with fine grain, slight mist, slightly white or slightly overexposed, like an old photo faded by time or a movie still. Skin not overly detailed, no skin smoothing, no sharpening, no retouching. Asymmetric composition, face can be partially cropped, minimalist background, retaining appropriate white space. Add the minimalist title 'Love Letter' or 'ラヴレター' in the white space area, thin Mincho or thin serif font, wide character spacing, sparse layout, color light gray; add 'Love Letter' in a tiny font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese artistic movie poster texture, quiet, subtle, restrained, like a memory covered by snow, avoiding photo studio feel, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding refined filters, avoiding lighting effects, avoiding high contrast and high saturation, avoiding sharp digital feel, avoiding theatrical emotions, avoiding 'pretty but hollow'. Negative prompt: AI feel, skin smoothing, sharpening, HDR, high contrast, high saturation, dreamy light effects, lens flare, filter feel, photo studio style, internet celebrity face, posing, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated emotions, 3D rendering, illustration style, complex background.
promptEn: 日系现实主义爱情电影海报风格，灵感来自《花束般的恋爱》，一对二十岁左右的日本年轻情侣站在城市日常场景中（街头或路口），彼此之间保持微妙而真实的距离，没有肢体接触，像关系逐渐疏远的瞬间。情绪安静克制，带未说出口的情感与时间流逝感。构图为电影主视觉，人物位于画面下方或一侧，画面保留大面积留白，强调空间与空气感。光线为自然光（阴天或黄昏），低饱和灰蓝、米色与暖灰色调，真实摄影质感。画面带细腻胶片颗粒与轻微生活感，不刻意唯美，不过度修饰，像真实电影中的一帧。可在画面边缘或前景加入少量自然花材作为隐喻（克制、不过度、不装饰化）。在留白区域加入标题「花束みたいな恋をした」，细明朝体，排版简洁疏朗；下方小字号加入《花束般的恋爱》。整体要求：真实日本电影海报质感，文艺、克制、生活化，强调关系而不是浪漫符号，避免甜腻爱情表现，避免花朵堆砌，避免网红唯美，避免构图拥挤，避免“精致但空洞”的AI感。AI感，过度唯美，花海，浪漫滤镜，光效泛滥，高饱和，霓虹灯，情侣亲密拥抱，摆拍感，大头贴构图，网红风，插画感，3D渲染，元素堆砌。日系极简文艺电影海报风格，灵感来自《情书》，冬季雪地场景，一位年轻女子的脸部特写，面部贴近雪地或半埋在雪中，细小雪花自然落下。构图为克制的近距离侧脸或微偏角度面部，人物占画面较大比例但不过度清晰锐利，边缘轻微柔化或轻微失焦。表情为伤心之后的平静，眼中带泪或泪痕，情绪内敛、克制、像刚刚哭过又慢慢恢复安静，眼神不看镜头，带回忆与空白感。光线为冬日自然散射光或阴天柔光，冷白、浅灰、淡蓝色调，低饱和、低对比，无强阴影、无戏剧光效。雪地与空气形成干净背景。画面质感为真实摄影与胶片之间，带轻微颗粒、轻微雾感、略微泛白或轻微过曝，像一张被时间冲淡的旧照片或电影静帧。皮肤不过度细节，不磨皮、不锐化、不精修。构图不对称，可局部裁切面部，背景极简，保留适当留白。在留白区域加入极简标题「Love Letter」或「ラヴレター」，细明朝体或细衬线字体，字距拉开、排版疏朗，颜色为浅灰；下方极小字号加入《情书》。整体要求：真实日本文艺电影海报质感，安静、含蓄、克制，像一段被雪覆盖的记忆，避免写真感、避免网红审美、避免精致滤镜、避免光效、避免高对比高饱和、避免锐利数码感、避免情绪表演化、避免“好看但空洞”。AI感，磨皮，锐化，HDR，高对比，高饱和，梦幻光效，光斑，滤镜感，写真风，网红脸，摆拍，直视镜头，情绪夸张，3D渲染，插画风，复杂背景。

Large, elegant vertical Japanese text in a Mincho serif font dominates the right and left sides of the arch, reading {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}. In the top left corner, smaller horizontal text reads {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}. The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink belly band. The band features a prominent horizontal catchphrase reading {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}, with smaller text above it separated by a dotted line mentioning work, relationships, love, and future anxiety. On the right side of the band is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and text reading {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}. The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, a placeholder for the author's name, and a placeholder for the publisher.

promptZh: A high-end Japanese skincare advertisement for a moisturizing lotion, shot in a luminous soft-white studio with a clean airy beauty aesthetic. On the right half of the image, a close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with flawless dewy skin, natural glossy lips, subtle peach-toned makeup, dark brown eyes, and dark hair loosely tied back with a few wispy strands across her forehead. She smiles gently at the camera and rests one hand against her cheek, wearing a simple white sleeveless top. On the left half, place 1 tall transparent frosted bottle of lotion standing upright on a reflective water surface, with tiny water droplets on the bottle and a shiny silver cap. The bottle label reads "SUIREN" and "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Surround the bottle with 3 pale pink cherry blossoms: 2 clustered at the lower left corner and 1 floating near the bottom center-right. Use a pastel palette of white, pearl, blush pink, and very light blue-gray, with diffused daylight, silky skin retouching, shallow depth of field, and a premium cosmetic campaign look. Include Japanese ad copy on the left in elegant black Mincho-style typography: a large 2-line headline reading "触れたくなる、" and "透明感。"; beneath it, 2 smaller lines reading "うるおい満ちて、" and "澄みわたる素肌へ。"; a thin outlined circle containing 2 stacked phrases with an × between them, "高保湿" and "透明感". In the lower right, add small Japanese text "うるおいが、私を輝かせる。" above the brand name "SUIREN" and the subtitle "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Composition should feel balanced and luxurious, like a magazine-ready spring skincare poster.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a realistic Japanese variety-show broadcast frame with two uniformed female idols, detailed studio graphics, and multiple readable on-screen text overlays for TV mockups or media demos.

promptZh: A brightly lit Japanese television variety show set with two young female idols standing side by side behind a small white podium, framed in a medium shot from about waist-up. Both wear matching light gray school-uniform-style blazers with silver buttons, white dress shirts, gray striped ribbon ties, and coordinated name tags pinned to their left chest, with subtle lace detail visible at the waistline. The woman on the left has dark brown to black hair styled in a side braid draped over her right shoulder, hands clasped together in front of her chest, and a slightly angled body posture facing right. The woman on the right has long dark wavy hair falling over both shoulders and rests both hands lightly on the top of the podium. Their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. The background is a colorful, dense TV studio design: on the left, a tall pink glitter panel filled with repeating white icons including hearts, triangles, snowflake-like flowers, and tree silhouettes, bordered by ornate gold trim; in the center, a vivid red-orange vertical panel with partial white lettering behind the presenters; on the right, a yellow wall with metallic geometric decorations and a large curved brown mosaic arch studded with small reflective squares. Include 3 visible on-screen text areas: a top-left show logo in Japanese reading {argument name="show logo text" default="日向坂で会いましょう"} in a playful blue-and-white badge, a top-right headline banner in Japanese with two lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="ガッツリ褒められ隊を攻略せよ！『褒め褒めストラックアウト』"} in bold white and blue outlined text, and a lower-left black placard with red border containing Japanese text and a large score reading {argument name="score value" default="9 pt"}. The left name tag reads 1 member name in Japanese, {argument name="left name tag" default="高瀬 愛奈"}, and the right name tag reads 1 member name in Japanese, {argument name="right name tag" default="小坂 菜緒"}. Render it as a crisp broadcast screenshot with vivid studio lighting, saturated colors, realistic fabric texture, authentic Japanese TV graphics, and a polished entertainment-program look.

descriptionZh: A polished anime-style gal game advertisement poster combining a dramatic key visual with a synopsis panel, feature icons, and stacked screenshot previews for visual novel marketing.
descriptionEn: A polished anime-style gal game advertisement poster combining a dramatic key visual with a synopsis panel, feature icons, and stacked screenshot previews for visual novel marketing.
promptZh:
Create a Japanese bishoujo game promotional poster in the style of a premium visual novel box cover and store page composite. The image is split into three vertical areas. The left two-thirds is a dramatic illustrated key visual at sunset: a dreamy spring sky filled with pink and violet clouds, glowing rim light, drifting petals, and a reflective wet road or riverside path. Show 4 anime girls in school uniforms, all with soft emotional expressions and highly detailed hair moving in the wind. The largest girl is centered upper-left, shown from the chest up in profile or three-quarter view, with long dark hair and a small flower hair ornament, looking wistful. A second girl stands at lower-left with very light silver hair and a ribbon accessory, turned slightly away. A third girl is at lower center, smaller, with mauve or reddish-brown hair and a bowed, melancholy pose. A fourth girl is at mid-right, blonde or light brown-haired, facing upward with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the key art, show 2 tiny full-body silhouettes of a boy and girl holding hands in the glowing distance, reflected in the wet ground. Add a white feather near the upper-left and scattered cherry blossom petals throughout. Overlay elegant Japanese title typography in large white brush-like serif lettering near the bottom-left to center: 「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」, with a smaller subtitle line beneath it. Along the far left edge, place 3 vertical lines of small Japanese catchphrase text in white. In the bottom-left corner, add 2 stacked black product labels with white text like a PC game package badge, one reading Windows compatible and one reading all ages.

The center is a narrow dark indigo vertical band separating the art from the info panel. On this band, place the game title again vertically in large white Japanese characters, with a smaller vertical tagline beneath it. Keep this band clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box.

The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a gentle paper texture. At top-left of this panel, add a bold Japanese heading in brackets: 「【あらすじ】」 followed by several lines of Japanese synopsis text laid out like a visual novel description page. Below that, add a dotted or dashed divider line. Then add a second bracketed heading: 「【特徴】」 with 4 feature bullets, each preceded by a simple icon. The 4 features are: branching choices, full voice support, tearjerking emotional story, and many beautiful CGs. Use small dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another divider line, then a third bracketed heading: 「【プレイヤーへ】」 followed by 2 short lines of Japanese message text.

On the far right side of the cream panel, stack 4 rounded-rectangle screenshot thumbnails vertically, each with thin white borders. Thumbnail 1: the dark-haired heroine by a seaside railing at sunset. Thumbnail 2: a pale-haired heroine with windblown hair against a bright blue ocean. Thumbnail 3: a girl indoors by a sunlit classroom or café window, warm and contemplative. Thumbnail 4: a girl surrounded by cherry blossoms in soft pink light. At the bottom of the cream panel, place a wide rounded lavender feature bar containing 4 large icons with short Japanese labels beneath or beside them: an open book, a microphone, an image/photo symbol, and a branching path/share-like icon. The overall mood should be nostalgic, romantic, cinematic, and emotionally overwhelming, like a high-budget Japanese gal game advertisement from the 2000s to 2010s. Use polished anime illustration, luminous backlighting, rich pastel sunset colors, glossy reflections, detailed typography, and authentic visual novel promo design.

descriptionZh: A comprehensive template for creating professional, museum-style 'landscape archive models' that combine 2D maps with 3D terrain and professional annotations.
descriptionEn: A comprehensive template for creating professional, museum-style 'landscape archive models' that combine 2D maps with 3D terrain and professional annotations.
promptZh:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="中国长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 上海外滩 / 广州珠江"}创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a photorealistic biblical group portrait of Jesus and the 12 disciples taking a modern smartphone selfie, ideal for humorous cinematic concept art.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a photorealistic biblical group portrait of Jesus and the 12 disciples taking a modern smartphone selfie, ideal for humorous cinematic concept art.
promptZh: A cinematic, photorealistic reimagining of the Last Supper as a modern anachronistic selfie scene inside a dim ancient stone room. Show {argument name="central figure" default="Jesus"} seated at the center front of a long rustic wooden table, wearing dark earth-toned biblical robes, extending one arm toward the camera and holding a modern black smartphone to take a group selfie. Surround him with exactly 12 disciples crowded closely around the table, making 13 people total, all dressed in simple first-century robes in beige, brown, taupe, muted blue, and cream. The composition should feel intimate and slightly humorous but still believable, with everyone leaning inward toward the phone as if posing for the photo. Use warm candlelight and soft firelit illumination, with several visible candles on the table and wall niches, creating amber highlights, deep shadows, and a sacred old-world atmosphere. Include rustic pottery, clay cups, wooden bowls, torn flatbread, and simple food on the table. The background should feature rough plastered stone walls, hanging cloth drapes, wooden pegs, and sparse historical decor. Frame it as a medium-wide group portrait from the phone camera’s point of view, with shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, detailed fabric textures, natural skin tones, and a rich warm brown color palette.
promptEn: A cinematic, photorealistic reimagining of the Last Supper as a modern anachronistic selfie scene inside a dim ancient stone room. descriptionZh: This prompt generates a cinematic LEGO-style architectural scene of Plaza de España in Seville, ideal for travel-themed concept art, social media visuals, or playful photoreal landmark renders.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a cinematic LEGO-style architectural scene of Plaza de España in Seville, ideal for travel-themed concept art, social media visuals, or playful photoreal landmark renders.
promptZh: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO interpretation of {argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"}, shown as a grand golden-hour architectural scene from canal level. The image is vertical and cinematic, with the viewer looking straight down a narrow curved canal toward an ornate Spanish Renaissance Revival palace facade built entirely from LEGO bricks. The warm terracotta building fills the upper half of the frame, with multiple towers, arched colonnades, balconies, decorative cornices, and intricate brick-built ornamentation. A small Spanish flag flies from the central tower. In the foreground, a LEGO rowboat with 2 minifigures is seen from behind, drifting along the canal; one has reddish-brown hair and the other light brown hair, both rowing with long brown oars. In the mid-distance, there is a second small rowboat with 2 minifigures under or near an elegant arched bridge. Count 2 boats total and 4 rowing passengers total. Along the right-side promenade, count 4 visible standing minifigures placed at intervals beside the tiled railing. The canal is lined with detailed blue, white, and yellow ceramic-style LEGO mosaic balustrades and brick parapets, with black vintage street lamps; count 7 visible lamp posts total. On the left edge, include 2 rounded pink flowering shrubs in planters. The bridge crossing the canal has ornate blue-and-white LEGO tile patterns and a graceful single arch. The water should look realistic yet made from small glossy LEGO-like tiles, with dark teal reflections of the building and sky. Lighting is soft sunset light with a glowing amber sky, scattered clouds, long highlights, and rich warm shadows. Emphasize realism, fine texture, playful scale illusion, and the convincing blend of real architectural grandeur with unmistakable LEGO construction.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a cinematic historical scene of Leonardo da Vinci painting the Mona Lisa from a live model, ideal for dramatic fine-art and Renaissance-themed visuals.
promptZh: A cinematic Renaissance art studio interior lit by soft warm window light, showing an elderly Leonardo da Vinci-like painter in left profile, seated at an easel and painting the Mona Lisa from a live model. In the center foreground stands a large canvas on a wooden easel displaying the Mona Lisa composition, while on the right a live female sitter poses in the same iconic posture with folded hands, wearing a dark Renaissance dress and veil-like drapery. The mood is intimate, quiet, and painterly, with rich brown and amber tones, dramatic chiaroscuro, aged plaster walls, a leaded-glass window on the left, and a wooden table in the back holding brushes and studies. Include 2 portrait sketches pinned or propped in the background behind the model. In the lower right foreground, show a cluttered painter’s worktable with 1 paint palette, multiple small paint dabs, several brushes in a cup, and a few shallow bowls. Compose the scene as a realistic historical photograph of the moment the masterpiece is being created, medium-wide shot, slightly over-the-shoulder from behind the artist, extremely detailed textures, old master atmosphere, soft focus falloff, no modern objects.

promptZh: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. descriptionZh: An extremely detailed professional prompt for a high-end luxury skincare advertisement, combining Eastern aesthetics with high-tech vibes.
descriptionEn: An extremely detailed professional prompt for a high-end luxury skincare advertisement, combining Eastern aesthetics with high-tech vibes.
promptZh:
极简东方高级广告风格，高端护肤品牌KV海报，品牌名“BRAND”，整体气质纯净、克制、科技感与东方美学融合

画面中心为一款高端精华产品，玻璃瓶身，通透渐变质感（上部透明→下部冷调青绿色），底部带液体光感，搭配香槟金金属瓶盖，产品放置于圆形高光底座之上，材质为抛光石材与金属结合，细节精致清晰，作为视觉绝对中心

产品周围环绕细腻金色能量光环与流动光带，形成轻微S型动线，象征修护与再生能量，光线从产品向外扩散，强化“功效视觉化”

一位东方女性位于画面后方偏右位置，半身回眸侧脸，气质冷静优雅，五官精致自然，冷白细腻肌肤呈现通透光泽（强调护肤效果），低饱和橘粉妆容，带微弱金色高光

黑色长发随风流动，发丝中融合金色光粒与微弱光带，整体干净克制不过度装饰，与产品光效形成呼应关系

身穿半透明丝绸服装与披肩，轻盈流动，材质通透，带细腻鎏金纹理与柔和反光，呈现高级质感

光影系统为干净暖金色主光源（侧后方），产品为主光聚焦点，人物为辅助受光，边缘光柔和，体积光轻微存在，空气中漂浮细小金色光粒，整体光线通透不过曝

背景为极简浅色渐变（米白+暖金过渡），大面积留白，画面干净无杂质，具备广告排版空间

画面下方加入冷调青绿色水面或矿物质质感元素（象征纯净科技与成分来源），增强品牌“纯净科技感”

色彩体系严格控制：主色为金色+米白，点缀冷调青绿色与香槟金，整体低饱和高级色调

构图为稳定中心构图+轻微S型动线，视觉聚焦明确，层级清晰（产品 > 光 > 人物）

整体风格：高端、纯净、修护再生、抗老科技感，国际大牌护肤广告质感（类似La Mer / SK-II级别）

超精细，8K质感，商业摄影级光影，真实材质表现

负面：产品变形，文字错误，过多装饰，画面拥挤，廉价金色，光影混乱，过曝，低清晰度

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a photorealistic vertical travel-campaign poster of a romantic Spanish seaside village at sunset, ideal for tourism ads, lifestyle branding, and social media marketing.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a photorealistic vertical travel-campaign poster of a romantic Spanish seaside village at sunset, ideal for tourism ads, lifestyle branding, and social media marketing.
promptZh: A romantic high-fashion travel campaign image set in a sunlit Spanish coastal village at golden hour, viewed down a narrow cobblestone stair street descending toward the sea. Whitewashed Mediterranean houses line both sides of the alley, with textured stucco walls, terracotta roof tiles, black wrought-iron balconies, wall-mounted lanterns, and many potted plants and flowers. On the right side, show 2 wrought-iron balconies, 2 wall lanterns, 1 vivid deep-blue door, and at least 8 terracotta pots with green plants mounted or placed along the facade. On the left edge, frame the scene with bright pink bougainvillea blossoms in the foreground. In the distance, the calm ocean reflects the warm sunset, with a rocky coastline and glowing horizon under a soft peach-and-gold sky. In the lower middle of the street, place 1 couple walking away hand in hand: a woman in a flowing light summer dress and a man in a pale shirt and shorts, small in scale to emphasize the environment. Composition is vertical editorial poster style, luxurious, serene, cinematic, aspirational, with warm golden sunlight casting long shadows and making the white walls glow. Add elegant overlay typography on the upper left in a refined serif font, warm brown color: the large line reads {argument name="headline text" default="España,"}, below it in italic serif reads {argument name="quote" default="siempre en mi corazón."}, with a thin ornamental flourish beneath the text. Include a subtle white {argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the upper right corner. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, premium tourism advertising aesthetic, soft atmospheric haze, natural depth, magazine-cover quality.

descriptionEn: A high-end editorial prompt for generating a premium luxury sportswear campaign poster featuring a female athlete in a studio setting with bold typography.
promptZh: Create a premium luxury {argument name="sportswear type" default="sportswear"} campaign poster featuring a confident {argument name="athlete" default="female athlete"} in a modern studio environment. Full body pose with strong fashion attitude, standing tall while holding a {argument name="prop" default="basketball"} at her side, chin raised slightly, direct powerful expression. Athletic toned physique, sleek pulled back hair, clean glowing skin, sharp editorial posture. Outfit includes an oversized cropped varsity jacket, fitted sports bra, tailored biker shorts, white crew socks, and modern high top sneakers. Neutral monochrome styling with subtle premium branding. Background is a clean light gray studio wall with giant bold condensed black typography reading “POWER” stretched vertically across the backdrop behind the model. Text should feel oversized and dominant, framing the athlete in the center. Floor is glossy reflective studio surface with subtle court markings and soft reflections. descriptionZh: A bright fantasy anime cafe scene centered on a chibi mascot character, ideal for promotional art, greeting posts, or whimsical cafe branding.
descriptionEn: A bright fantasy anime cafe scene centered on a chibi mascot character, ideal for promotional art, greeting posts, or whimsical cafe branding.
promptZh: A highly detailed, whimsical anime cafe illustration in a vertical composition, featuring a chibi girl mascot standing at the center of a cozy fantasy coffee shop during golden sunrise. She has extremely long, voluminous hair with a vivid rainbow gradient that begins as {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue at the crown"} and flows through cyan, green, yellow, orange, pink, and purple at the tips, with glossy highlights and thick bangs framing large sparkling blue eyes. She wears oversized silver headphones with green four-leaf clover emblems on both earcups, a red leather jacket, a white T-shirt with a yellow smiley face, fitted blue jeans, and white high-top sneakers with red accents. She smiles warmly and holds a white coffee mug decorated with a green clover symbol. Add a speech bubble near her head containing Japanese text: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="おはよう。今日も、ひとくち目の幸せから。"}. The cafe interior is richly decorated with dark polished wood, hanging banners, shelves filled with glass bottles and jars, trailing green plants, glowing crystal ornaments, and warm amber lighting. On the left upper area, hang a blackboard menu sign labeled {argument name="cafe name" default="AriteAL Cafe Menu"} with Japanese handwritten menu items and small coffee doodles. In the right background, place tall arched windows showing a dreamy pastel sunrise sky and storybook castle-like towers outside. Include exactly 2 mascot creatures: 1 small blue penguin barista on the left beside stacked clover mugs, and 1 small black cat-like creature with tiny bat wings and a red bow tie near a chalkboard sign on the lower right. In the foreground on a round table, show exactly 4 featured food and drink items: 1 thick slice of toast topped with a green clover garnish, 1 cup of latte art coffee in a clover cup, 1 glass jar of honey, and 1 tall rainbow parfait layered with colorful jelly, whipped cream, berries, strawberry slices, and crystal-like candy shards. Also place a teapot and additional clover-pattern cups on side tables in the midground. Add a small standing chalkboard sign on the lower right with Japanese welcome text and the cafe name. The whole image should feel magical, cheerful, polished, and richly rendered, with soft sparkles, warm morning light, saturated colors, intricate decorative details, and premium gpt-image-2 anime illustration quality.

promptZh: A vibrant Japanese comic-style cover illustration with two anime characters standing side by side against a split pink-and-blue pop graphic background filled with stars, dots, music notes, hearts, spark lines, and playful doodles. At the top, place a huge bold Japanese title in thick black and brown kanji with white outline and pink shadow reading 夜坂さんと茶藤くん, arranged in an energetic layered composition inside a fluffy cloud-like title shape. The left half of the background is pink and the right half is light blue, with a diagonal dividing rhythm and decorative manga-cover accents. Show exactly 2 characters from about mid-thigh up. On the left is a rebellious teenage girl with a straight black bob haircut and blunt bangs, pale skin, punk-rock fashion, and a slightly annoyed withdrawn pose with one hand near her mouth. She wears an oversized black zip hoodie over a red-and-black horizontal striped shirt, a red plaid pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a black heart-shaped choker. She holds a black electric bass guitar vertically across her body, with visible tuning pegs, strings, pickups, and chrome hardware. On the right is a cheerful teenage boy with messy light brown hair, fair skin, and a friendly expressive pose. He wears a white button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a fitted black vest with a small emblem on the chest, and black slacks. He holds a stylus pen near his face in one hand and a dark drawing tablet tucked in the other arm. Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech balloons: on the left, うるさいのはキライ。 in a pink outlined balloon; on the right, そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです… in a blue outlined balloon. Include small floating icons between and around them: exactly 2 black music notes, 2 pink hearts, 2 blue stars, and a few curved arrows and spark marks suggesting lively chemistry. The overall style is polished modern manga cover art, clean linework, glossy shading, expressive character design, bright pastel pop palette, high detail, commercial light novel or comic serialization cover aesthetic.

descriptionZh: A cinematic two-angle medieval countershot scene for demonstrating over-the-shoulder framing and shot-reverse-shot composition.
descriptionEn: A cinematic two-angle medieval countershot scene for demonstrating over-the-shoulder framing and shot-reverse-shot composition.
promptZh: A cinematic medieval shot-reverse-shot pair presented as a gritty historical film still in an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, overcast natural light, muted earth tones, damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong foreground shoulder framing. Set the scene on a rutted muddy country road running through a rural valley with rough wooden wattle fences on both sides, low rolling hills covered with sparse trees in the distance, open fields, and a small pale stone farmhouse or chapel on the far right hillside. The two characters face each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant man in a dirty brown tunic and cap, average build, carrying a wood-handled axe resting on his shoulder with a leather strap across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler in dark weathered chainmail and a worn hooded surcoat, standing still with a guarded posture. Create this as a grammar-of-cinema countershot demonstration: first frame shows the {argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"} from behind in the right foreground, his shoulder and back occupying the near right side of the frame, while the {argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"} stands full figure in the left midground facing camera on the muddy road; second frame reverses the angle and shows the knight’s shoulder and hooded back blurred in the left foreground while the peasant stands in the right midground holding the axe on his shoulder. Keep both shots consistent in location, weather, costume continuity, lens feel, and character spacing, with subdued dramatic realism and a tense conversational standoff.

promptZh: A black-and-white manga two-page spread with a cinematic, melancholic tone, drawn in highly detailed seinen style with realistic lighting, wet pavement reflections, dense overhead power lines, and a star-filled night sky over a quiet Japanese residential street. The composition is divided into 4 panels total across the spread. On the left page, the top panel is a wide establishing shot of an empty suburban street at night, lined with low houses, walls, utility poles, glowing streetlights, and a slightly reflective road stretching into the distance. The bottom panel on the left page shows 1 teenage boy from behind, walking alone down the same street, wearing a dark school blazer, white shirt, loosened striped necktie, slim trousers, and carrying 1 shoulder bag slung across his back; his posture is tired and conflicted. Include 1 vertical oval Japanese speech balloon in this panel with the text 「やっぱり俺には」. On the right page, the top panel is a close-up of the boy’s hand gripping the front of his blazer or shirt near the chest in a tense gesture, with 1 hand-drawn sound effect in Japanese reading 「ギュッ…」. descriptionZh: 这一提示产生了一个溢价静态营销广告,其特色是开发商的时数发票,强力的编辑打字以及SaaS登陆页或付费社会创意的手绘说明.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a premium static marketing ad featuring a developer-hours invoice, strong editorial typography, and hand-drawn annotations for SaaS landing pages or paid social creatives.
promptZh: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.

Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.

descriptionZh: A dramatic vertical football transfer poster for Mirassol FC, ideal for club announcements, athlete promo art, and social media sports graphics.
descriptionEn: A dramatic vertical football transfer poster for Mirassol FC, ideal for club announcements, athlete promo art, and social media sports graphics.
promptZh: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. descriptionEn: This prompt generates a detailed black-and-white manga page of a high school girl playing electric guitar in a night studio, ideal for dramatic AI manga storytelling scenes.
promptZh: A black-and-white manga page spread with 5 panels on a clean white background and thin black gutters, drawn in highly detailed modern seinen/shoujo hybrid line art with soft screentones, reflective highlights, and a quiet melancholic mood. The setting is a nighttime music studio classroom with large windows showing a city skyline full of lit buildings against a dark sky. Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the large upper-left panel, show her in three-quarter view holding the guitar across her lap, left hand on the fretboard and right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment including 1 drum kit in the back left, 2 stacked guitar amplifiers on the right, and a wall sign reading "Beat Box" near the door. In the narrow upper-right panel, show a close-up of the guitar neck and her fretting hand, with the small vertical Japanese sound effect text "トン…". In the tall middle-right panel, show a close side-profile close-up of the girl looking down at the instrument with a pensive, almost disappointed expression, with the night city lights blurred through the window behind her. In the lower-left panel, show 1 teenage boy in a school blazer and loosened tie, seated indoors and turned slightly to the side; his face is obscured by a large soft gray rectangular censor block, and beside him is 1 vertical speech balloon containing the Japanese text "……やっぱり違う". descriptionZh: 为文物或历史服饰制作博物馆式技术分解图的全面提示。
descriptionEn: A comprehensive prompt for generating museum-style technical breakdown infographics for artifacts or historical clothing.
promptZh:
请根据 {argument name="题材" default="清代皇帝龙袍"} 自动生成一张“博物馆图鉴式中文拆解信息图”。

要求整张图兼具真实写实主视觉、结构拆解、中文标注、材质说明、纹样寓意、色彩含义和核心特征总结。你需要根据【清代皇帝龙袍】自动判断最合适的主体对象、服饰体系、器物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、颜色方案与版式结构，用户无需再提供其他信息。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展板、历史服饰图鉴、文博专题信息图，而不是普通海报、古风写真、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景采用米白、绢纸白、浅茶色等纸张质感，整体高级、克制、专业、可收藏。

版式固定为：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 导语
- 左侧：结构拆解区，中文引线标注关键部件，并配局部特写
- 右上：材质 / 工艺 / 质感区，展示真实纹理小样并附说明
- 右中：纹样 / 色彩 / 寓意区，展示主色板、纹样样本和文化解释
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

若主题适合人物展示，则以真实人物全身站姿为中央主体；若更适合器物或单体结构，则改为中心主体拆解图，但整体仍保持完整中文信息图形式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、规整、可读，不要乱码、错字、英文或拼音。重点突出真实结构、材质差异、文化说明与图鉴气质。

避免：海报感、影楼感、电商感、动漫感、cosplay感、乱标注、错结构、糊字、假材质、过度装饰。

descriptionZh: A high-end prompt for generating a centered, circular dome ceiling mural of a dragon, inspired by traditional Japanese shrine art with sacred lighting.
descriptionEn: A high-end prompt for generating a centered, circular dome ceiling mural of a dragon, inspired by traditional Japanese shrine art with sacred lighting.
promptZh:
A {argument name="style" default="museum-grade, high-end mural"} inspired by the “Crying Dragon” of {argument name="location" default="Nikko Toshogu Shrine"}, painted on a circular dome ceiling. The composition is strictly centered, viewed from a worm’s-eye perspective, creating a powerful sense of sacred architectural depth.

A dragon of overwhelming presence emerges from the exact center of the dome, its head directed downward toward the viewer. Its body, claws, and surrounding clouds radiate outward in a swirling motion, forming a dynamic circular explosion from the center.

The entire scene is enveloped within the dome structure, with subtle architectural curvature and faint boundary cues that further emphasize the immersive sensation of looking up into an overhead space.

Lighting: a soft, sacred glow emanates from the center, gradually fading into darkness toward the edges. Mist, cloud voids, and delicate negative space create a breathable, atmospheric sense of depth.

The entire scene is enveloped within the dome structure, with subtle architectural curvature and faint boundary cues that further emphasize the immersive sensation of looking up into an overhead space.

Lighting: a soft, sacred glow emanates from the center, gradually fading into darkness toward the edges. Mist, cloud voids, and delicate negative space create a breathable, atmospheric sense of depth.

To his left stands a teenage or young adult male with a backpack beside a dark parked SUV partially visible at the edge of the frame. To his right stands an adult woman in a dark hooded winter jacket, holding a flashlight that casts a warm cone of light onto the snow and the barrier. All faces should be mostly in shadow, unreadable, emphasizing mystery and danger. Place exactly 2 man-made warning elements in the foreground: 1 red-and-white striped gate blocking the path and 1 weathered warning sign on a wooden post showing a deer silhouette inside a red prohibition circle and slash. In the far distance, show a rugged snow-streaked mountain under a star-filled sky. From behind the mountain, a single narrow vertical blue beam of light rises straight into the sky, acting as the focal point. Composition should be vertical, dramatic, and poster-like, suitable for a thriller or survival graphic novel cover for {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"}. promptZh: Create a minimalist vertical art poster featuring a single man in clean side profile facing left, shown from about mid-thigh upward, wearing a tailored dark suit jacket, crisp white shirt, and a vintage 1940s-style black fedora with a ribbon band. Render the figure in a refined monochrome photographic style with crisp editorial detail, rich tonal contrast, and dramatic Rembrandt-inspired lighting that sculpts the cheek, ear, jawline, hat brim, and shoulder with deep shadow. Place 1 bold perfectly round red disc directly behind the head and upper torso, centered like a halo or rising sun, creating a stark graphic focal point. The background should be a clean off-white or cream paper-textured surface with subtle grain and generous negative space around the subject. The lower half of the figure should dissolve into elongated black ink drips: count 12 distinct major dripping trails of varying thickness, hanging from the jacket hem and lower body, some long and straight, some tapering, with a few small splatters, as if the body is bleeding into the canvas. Keep the color palette strictly limited to black, red, and warm off-white. The overall mood should be moody, contemplative, elegant, slightly ominous, and modernist, like a high-end gallery poster blending film noir portraiture with surreal ink-paint abstraction.

<テーマ> 
・深夜の繁華街 
・路上のベンチ — 缶チューハイで乾杯 
・真夜中の公園 
・ゲームセンター前 — UFOキャッチャーの景品を見せびらかす 
・プリクラ機の中 
・ゲーセンのダンスゲーム 
・クレーンゲーム 
・居酒屋の座敷 — ピースサインで乾杯ショット 
・カラオケボックス — マイク片手に熱唱＆タンバリン ・ファミレス（ガスト/デニーズ）深夜 
・屋台のラーメン — 〆のラーメンをすする 
・クラブのVIPブース 
・バーのカウンター — カクテル片手にケータイ通話
・牛丼屋（吉野家/すき家） — 夜明け前の腹ごしらえ ・終電の地下鉄 
・タクシーの後部座席 
・終電間際の駅ホーム — 厚底ブーツで走る 
・始発待ちのマンガ喫茶 — ブランケットにくるまる 
・改造車（VIPカー）の助手席 — ファーのダッシュボードとLED 
・タクシー乗り場 
・観覧車 — 夜景をバックにゴンドラ内ショット 
・レインボーブリッジの夜景 — 海沿いの柵にもたれて ・ラブホテル街の看板 — ネオンピンクに照らされた路地 
・屋上駐車場 — 夜景を見下ろしながらおしゃべり 
・公園のブランコ — 深夜に揺れながらケータイ光る
・海辺（湘南/お台場） — 夜の砂浜で花火 
・神社の境内 — 深夜の肝試し ・ガラケーで自撮り 
・プリクラ帳（手帳）交換 — デコりまくったプリ帳を見せ合う 
・路上でパラパラ練習 — 街灯の下で振り付け合わせ 
・ボウリング場 — レーンの照明に照らされたハイタッチ 
・朝帰りの始発電車 — 疲れ果てて寝落ち、膝にはプリクラ袋 
・エレベーター内 
・ルーズソックスを直しながら座る — 駅の階段に腰掛けて 
・ビデオ（DVD）レンタルショップ — 深夜にホラー映画を選んでる
・着うたをガラケーで流す 
・朝日の渋谷スクランブル

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a painterly retro-anime commemorative poster with a double-exposure child profile, fantasy montage scenes, and elegant Japanese typography for franchise tribute art or collector-style prints.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a painterly retro-anime commemorative poster with a double-exposure child profile, fantasy montage scenes, and elegant Japanese typography for franchise tribute art or collector-style prints.
promptZh: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster on textured off-white paper, composed as a vertical double-exposure illustration inspired by late-1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. Keep the composition airy and elegant, with a refined modern poster-design sensibility and almost no generic AI gloss. Add vertical Japanese text on the right side reading あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。 and place a Japanese title logo at the lower left reading デジモンアドベンチャー, with a small English subtitle “DIGIMON ADVENTURE” and the date line “1999 - 永遠の冒険”.

promptZh: A nostalgic collage of 16 candid youth snapshots arranged in a clean 4x4 photo grid, square format, styled like nonexistent memories from a Japanese coming-of-age film. The composition should feel quiet, gothic, feminine, and introspective, with flat graphic shapes, crisp linework, little shading, and a modern decorative poster aesthetic.

promptZh: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {argument name="sport name" default="スカートバウト"}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. descriptionZh: 催促最小化的新中国风格墨水风景海报,以雾山为特色,镜形湖,小船有红衣图案.
descriptionEn: A prompt for a minimalist New Chinese style ink wash landscape poster featuring misty mountains, a mirror-like lake, and a small boat with a red-clothed figure.
promptZh:
新中式水墨山水海报，竖版9:16构图，东方极简美学风格，
大面积留白，整体色调为春日清晨氛围（青绿色、雾蓝、淡灰、浅墨），低饱和、清透柔和，高级质感。
画面主体为奇峻巍峨的群山，从中间平静湖面的两侧拔地而起，占据左右两侧画面，
山体以水墨晕染表现，浓淡干湿变化丰富，局部融入淡青绿色渲染，体现春意生机。
山峰被湿润轻柔的晨雾包裹，雾气层层递进，与浅青蓝天空自然融合，形成空气透视与空间纵深。

湖面如镜面般平静，呈现微青绿色调，倒映山体与天空，反射略带柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强春日湿润与梦幻氛围。
中景一艘带弧形篷顶的小木舟缓慢漂浮，船桨轻触水面形成细腻涟漪，水纹自然扩散，整体保持极静状态。

船上为一位红衣渔女，体量较小（远景比例），人物简化处理为水墨剪影 + 轻微设色，
身着低饱和朱砂红传统服饰（非鲜艳红），颜色略被雾气柔化，
人物面部不刻画细节，仅保留轮廓与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨），
红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，作为画面唯一暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀疏林与春季新生植被，采用淡墨 + 淡青绿点染，虚实结合，增强节奏与生命气息。

少量飞鸟在远空掠过，轻盈疏散分布，增强空间层次与灵动感。

画面顶部居中竖排书法：“{argument name="标题" default="东方美学"}”，采用传统手写行书或行草风格（王羲之笔意），
笔触自然起伏、提按分明，带飞白与墨韵扩散效果，避免字体感。
书法颜色为深墨青或柔和墨黑，与整体画面统一。
整体风格：水墨 + 现代极简设计融合，春日禅意、空灵湿润、宁静氛围，
冷暖对比克制，电影感光影，高级艺术海报质感，8K超清细节。
