promptZh: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". promptZh: A highly detailed anime illustration of a seated young woman in an elegant Japanese-inspired fantasy kimono composition, centered on a clean warm off-white background. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black with deep blue-violet undertones"} hair with blunt bangs and very long flowing side lengths, with red and blue ribbon strands woven through the hair. Her eyes are large and luminous {argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"}, and her expression is calm, soft, and slightly wistful. She wears an ornate floral hairpiece on the right side of her head made of 4 major blossoms in red, white, pale blue, and blue, with dangling gold ornaments and tassels. Her outfit is a richly patterned kimono in {argument name="kimono colors" default="red, black, pale blue, cream, and touches of purple"}, covered in cherry blossoms, stylized flowers, butterflies, cords, bows, and hanging tassel decorations. The sleeves are oversized and flowing, with visible red cord knots and floral appliqué details. She sits in a graceful curled pose with one hand near her face, bare legs prominently visible, wearing white tabi-like socks and elaborate red-and-black platform sandals with bows. Surrounding her are exactly 4 cats: 1 black cat sitting on a branch at left looking upward, and 3 white cats placed around her lower left, mid-right, and lower center-right. Include exactly 2 birds: 1 blue bird perched on the left branch and 1 small red-and-blue bird nestled among flowers at the lower right. Include exactly 3 butterflies: 2 near the upper left and 1 near the lower center by her legs. Frame the composition with plum blossom branches, hanging Japanese ornaments, tassels, diamond charms, and long fabric streamers. Add a large circular decorative motif behind her upper body and a tall vertical banner-like ornament on the right side. The overall palette should balance vermilion red, black, ivory, pale cyan, sky blue, and lavender. descriptionZh: 制作专业手绘风格产品包装设计建议书和概念情绪板的非常详细的提示.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed prompt for creating professional hand-drawn style product packaging design proposals and conceptual mood boards.
promptZh:
请为【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】生成一张“手绘包装提案板风格”的产品介绍海报。 

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动搭配自然合理的主色、辅助色和背景色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是普通电商详情页，也不是单纯棚拍海报，而是一张融合“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意提案板。整体呈现为高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，像设计师正在展示一个包装概念方案。

画面要求：
- 竖版构图
- 使用统一且有品牌感的主色调背景，背景颜色根据产品本身自然决定，不固定为某一种颜色
- 配色应与产品属性协调：如果有参考图，优先继承参考图的主色和品牌色；如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的色彩方案
- 画面中央放置一个最完整、最吸睛的产品主视觉，具有真实质感、立体光影和商业成品效果
- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

风格关键词：
包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：
- 如果有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不要偏离产品本身
- 如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，并保持整体风格统一
- 画面重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”
- 不要做成普通电商详情页，不要做成促销海报，不要过度整齐呆板，不要缺少草图和手写批注，不要廉价感，不要低幼卡通感

- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：

promptZh: 一幅令人叹为观止、极其复杂的「{argument name="主题" default="儒释道根本区别"}」概念世界构建信息图杰作，整体被设计成一部底蕴深厚的东方古典神话传说手稿。背景：纯白色复古纹理画布，浅米黄做旧牛皮纸底色，轻微毛边与水渍感。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的「竖版蛋形分层结构」，从上到下依次为释、道、儒三层。边缘边角料：四个角落点缀精细微观插图，主题为古代观测手记、法器与符文。色彩：低饱和鼠尾草绿、浅金、米白为主色调，整体清淡柔和，无刺眼高饱和色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水皴法、莲花纹路、云气层次清晰可见，纤毫毕现。无缝融合：三层之间通过云雾与水流自然过渡，释的佛光、道的太极云气、儒的书卷气息无缝衔接。风格：{argument name="艺术风格" default="古典墨水线稿+低饱和数字水彩"}，清淡国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯正繁体汉字，采用斑驳古风宋体，每个标注含短标题+一行诗意描述，由暗金色发丝引线连接对应细节，无重复指向。画幅比例：3:4竖版独立完整标题区（顶部）：`儒釋道·根本區別`中心分层标注：顶层「釋」：`釋`，`人與自己的關係`，`無我·治心·放得下`中层「道」：`道`，`人與萬物的關係`，`無為·治身·想得開`底层「儒」：`儒`，`人與人的關係`，`無己·治世·拿得起`左右辅助标注：左侧：`淨`，`清淨明心，斷除煩惱`；`靜`，`順應自然，回歸本心`；`敬`，`敬畏責任，積極入世`右侧：`60歲+修心`，`看淡得失，回歸內心`；`35-55歲做人`，`張弛有度，順應規律`；`7-35歲做事`，`銳意進取，建功立业`底部总结文字：`入世與出世之間的平衡，是高級的生活智慧`

descriptionZh: 这个瞬间产生了一个令人不安的全身科幻恐怖肖像,描绘一个现实的人形外星人在一片凄凉的岩石峡谷中,对电影概念艺术和生物设计的理想.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a disturbing full-body sci-fi horror portrait of a realistic humanoid alien in a bleak rocky canyon, ideal for cinematic concept art and creature design.
promptZh: A full-body cinematic portrait of a deeply unsettling humanoid alien standing alone in a dark rocky ravine, centered in the frame and facing forward in a neutral upright pose with both arms hanging low at its sides. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, narrow shoulders, a sunken torso, visible rib-like structures, taut sinewy anatomy, long forearms, oversized hands with long thin fingers, and long digitigrade-looking feet planted on wet black ground. Its skin is hairless, slick, pale gray-beige with brownish fleshy undertones, semi-organic and biomechanical in appearance, with glossy damp highlights, leathery textures, stretched membranes, tendons, grooves, and subtle vein-like striations. The neck and upper chest are fused into a disturbing organic structure, with tendril-like folds and open channels running from the clavicle area upward into the head. The head is broad and mushroom- or hammer-shaped with a ridged crown and flared side lobes, giving a nonhuman silhouette; the face should feel unreadable and alien rather than cute or familiar. Place the figure in a narrow canyon of dark eroded stone, with 2 large foreground rock masses framing the subject on the left and right, and a misty cliff wall receding behind it. Use cold desaturated lighting, soft fog, damp surfaces, shallow atmospheric haze, and a grim monochrome palette of charcoal, slate, ash gray, and muted flesh tones. The mood should be uncanny, realistic, oppressive, and biologically plausible, like a high-end sci-fi horror still. Ultra-detailed photorealism, sharp texture on the creature, subtle depth of field, dramatic natural backlight from above, no clothing, no tools, no background creatures, no gore, no text.

Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

descriptionZh: A comprehensive professional template for generating high-density 16-bit pixel art asset sheets for game development, including characters, animations, and environments.
descriptionEn: A comprehensive professional template for generating high-density 16-bit pixel art asset sheets for game development, including characters, animations, and environments.
promptZh:
请根据【游戏主题：{argument name="游戏主题" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「像素世界资产图鉴 / Pixel World Asset Atlas」。

这不是普通像素插画，也不是单张游戏场景图，而是一张面向游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计和视觉提案的“2D像素游戏资产总览图”。画面需要像一张完整的游戏素材说明板，把一个【游戏类型：{argument name="游戏类型" default="横版动作"}】所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss和装饰元素系统化整理在同一张图中，形成清晰、专业、可复用的游戏资产图鉴。

【基础设定】
主题世界观：【游戏主题】
游戏类型：【游戏类型】
时代背景：【时代背景】
主角身份：【主角身份】
敌人类型：【敌人类型】
主要场景：【主要场景环境】
整体风格：【风格方向，例如{argument name="风格" default="16-bit复古街机像素风"}】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
点缀色：【点缀色】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，横版4:3】
如没有填写，自动按照游戏主题最优方案进行匹配。

【整体画面要求】
画面采用横版大画布，浅色或低干扰背景，整体像一张游戏开发资产表、像素设定集展开页、说明书式资源目录。所有元素都应为统一像素密度的2D pixel art sprite，具有清晰黑色或深色描边、有限色阶、复古游戏质感。不要生成真实摄影风、3D渲染风、厚涂插画风或电影海报风。重点是“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富、可开发感强”。

【版式结构】
整张图采用模块化网格排版，用细线分割不同资源区域。每个区域需要有编号标题和简短分类标签，整体阅读路径为从左到右、从上到下。版式应具有说明书、游戏开发文档、素材图鉴、设定板的秩序感。信息密度要高，但不能混乱；每个模块内部的元素应等距排列，保持清晰可读。

【必须包含的模块】
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等。动作帧应横向排列，像游戏sprite sheet。
2. 敌人单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重装、精英单位等。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投掷物、特效、拾取物等。
4. 基础地形砖块模块：展示地面、墙体、平台、转角、不同材质地块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、石头、障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙、梯子、营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖、洞口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门、设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型Boss、特殊载具、巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、指示牌、开关、机关。

【视觉细节要求】
所有资源需要保持统一的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观一致性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形砖块可拼接；道具和机关有功能识别度；Boss元素需有压迫感。

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a nostalgic realistic instant-film photograph of a Japanese high school class group portrait, ideal for school memory, graduation, or retro snapshot visuals.
promptZh: A realistic instant film Polaroid photo lying flat on a light wooden tabletop, photographed from directly above. Inside the photo, about 35 graduating students in dark school uniforms are gathered in 4 loose rows in front of a green chalkboard, posing casually and tightly packed together. Most are teenage boys in black gakuran-style jackets or dark blazers with white shirts and ties, and several teenage girls wear dark blazers with blue plaid skirts. Many students hold up peace signs, some crouch in front, and a few sit or recline on the wooden floor in the front row. On the chalkboard, hand-drawn Japanese graduation messages in chalk include large central text reading "3年B組" and celebratory doodles and writing around it such as graduation-themed congratulations. The classroom has white walls, a round wall clock above the chalkboard, a fluorescent ceiling light fixture, and subdued indoor lighting. The image should feel like a slightly dim early-2000s or 2010s snapshot with mild grain, soft focus, authentic flash photography, and natural color fading, emphasizing a sentimental end-of-school memory preserved as a physical instant print.

descriptionEn: A highly detailed structural prompt for transforming any input image into a white-line mannequin pose and lighting analysis sheet.
promptZh:
[CORE TASK]
Transform the provided input image into a pose-and-light analysis sheet.

This is NOT a finished character illustration.
This is NOT a clothing sheet.
This is NOT a beauty-preserving redraw.

This is a white-line rough mannequin conversion.

[PRIMARY GOAL]
Extract and visualize only:
- pose structure
- body balance
- camera angle
- body line flow
- inferred light source placement
- illuminated areas and light intensity

[INPUT ROLE]
Use the provided image as the strict anchor for:
- pose
- camera angle
- body tilt
- weight distribution
- approximate lighting situation

Do NOT preserve:
- face rendering
- hairstyle rendering
- clothing detail
- accessories
- weapon detail
- background architecture
- character identity
- emotional expression

[FIGURE CONVERSION]
single rough mannequin-like human figure
white body contour lines
white internal construction lines
simple mannequin head
no face
no eyes
no mouth
no eyelashes
no personality
no individual identity

human figure should look like:
- rough pose mannequin
- anatomy proxy
- line-based body guide
- structural sketch
- white-line rough dummy

keep:
- pose readability
- silhouette flow
- head tilt
- torso direction
- pelvis direction
- limb placement

[BACKGROUND]
pure black background
negative-style dark field
no scenery
no props
no architecture
no environmental storytelling

[LINE STYLE]
rough white line drawing
clean but sketch-like
construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible
joint flow visible
body contour emphasized
no polished illustration finish

[LIGHT ESTIMATION]
predict the likely light source positions from the input image
visualize the light sources and illuminated areas using green glow only

use green light intensity with variation:
- strongest green where the light directly hits
- medium green for wrap light
- soft green for reflected or fading light

mark the estimated light sources with labels and arrows such as:
- Main Light
- Rim Light
- Fill Light
- Floor Bounce
- Back Light
only if appropriate

IMPORTANT:
do not invent random lights
infer lighting from the original input image
if the lighting is ambiguous, keep the annotations simple and plausible

[GREEN LIGHT VISUALIZATION]
show green glow on:
- head / skull plane
- neck
- shoulders
- chest plane
- ribcage direction
- pelvis edge
- thigh planes
- knee contact points
- floor contact bounce if applicable

use green light not as decoration,
but as lighting analysis information

[POSE PRIORITY]
1. preserve pose structure
2. preserve camera angle
3. preserve body balance
4. preserve head-torso relationship
5. visualize likely light direction
6. show illuminated areas with readable green intensity variation

[NEGATIVE]
finished person,
cute girl,
detailed face,
hair rendering,
clothing rendering,
weapon emphasis,
beautiful anatomy

descriptionZh: A highly detailed prompt for generating a professional 9-panel anime storyboard, featuring complex character actions, camera directions, and a Makoto Shinkai-inspired aesthetic.
descriptionEn: A highly detailed prompt for generating a professional 9-panel anime storyboard, featuring complex character actions, camera directions, and a Makoto Shinkai-inspired aesthetic.
promptZh: 一份专业的动漫院线分镜头（16：9），标题为《{argument name="标题" default="天空之击"}》，副标题为“{argument name="副标题" default="战士与圣石"}”。干净的浅米色背景，圆角矩形面板排列成三列网格，共 9 个场景。每个场景面板显示：橙色“场景 XX”标签、时间码、场景标题，然后是两个并排的画面，分别标有“开始帧”→“结束帧”，通过白色箭头连接，下面有注释（镜头/对白/特效/动作）。艺术风格：清晰的卡通渲染 {argument name="画风" default="新海诚的×工作室机智，×进击的巨人"}——柔和的画风光线、立体云朵、温暖的金色阳光、电影般的广角镜头、动态动作姿势、浓郁的天蓝和翡翠绿调，搭配黄铜和铜色点缀。需要描绘的场景：1. 广角景——一艘雄伟的蒸汽朋克飞艇，黄铜螺旋桨和飘扬的帆，在高空穿透积云海洋（慢速无人机推入）2.低角度特写一名女战士的靴子和交叉的双腿悬挂在飞艇木制栏杆上，风中头发飘动（静电→微微向上倾斜） 3.鸟瞰视角俯瞰栏杆下方：广阔的翡翠山谷，蜿蜒的河流和远处一个茅草屋顶的小中世纪村庄（眩晕变焦）4.飞艇桥内部——海盗船长戴着三角帽和长大衣，举着一块比蛋稍大、发着蓝光的圣石，脸上有耀眼的青色光（中→石头放大）5.甲板上的船员发现入侵者——一名满脸胡渣的海盗举起一把黄铜中世纪左轮手枪对准她，其他人震惊地转身（两枪→跟着瞄准）6.子弹飞行中极近距离，旋转穿过空中，伴随着运动模糊和烟雾轨迹，朝栏杆方向飞去（子弹时间追踪镜头）7.栏杆——空的。 她被放置的地方什么都没有，子弹穿过空气（快速剪辑，杂音）8。女战士在空中优雅地做月面翻身，背景是明亮的天空，头发和斗篷在动作中拖曳（慢动作，宽→近）9。着陆镜头——她悄无声息地在射手身后降落，低蹲着，手放在剑柄上，海盗转身半空震惊僵住（低角度→对峙） 底部部分包括：“关键角色”一行，有 4 个角色肖像（女战士、海盗船长、射手海盗、一名船员）;一个“音调与方向”盒子（动态动作、风和云粒子，吉卜力风格的奇观与武士的强烈情感）;“音乐与特效计划”时间线（环境风→紧张弦乐→子弹→→沉默）;以及“技术规格”盒装（30 秒，16：9 1920×1080,24 帧，全彩，mp4 H.264）。布局：简洁的信息图，细边框，粉彩色格，每帧内高度细致的动漫关键视觉，专业制作文档美学。

descriptionZh: A comprehensive, high-aesthetic prompt for creating a complete brand packaging system display with commercial photography quality.
descriptionEn: A comprehensive, high-aesthetic prompt for creating a complete brand packaging system display with commercial photography quality.
promptZh:
请为品牌【{argument name="品牌名称" default="品牌名称"}】、类目为【{argument name="品牌类目" default="品牌类目"}】创作一张高审美、高完成度的「品牌包装系统展示图」。这不是普通电商白底图，也不是单一产品图，而是一张具有品牌提案感、视觉识别系统感和商业摄影质感的包装家族陈列效果图。画面需要体现“同一品牌在多个包装载体上的统一落地”，呈现一个成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

【画幅要求】整体必须为固定 4:5 的竖版海报构图，画面方向明确为纵向，禁止生成横版构图、宽幅桌面陈列或过于分散的横向展示。整体构图需符合海报阅读逻辑：上方保留呼吸感，中部为品牌包装系统的主要视觉焦点，下方安排辅助包装、标签和产品本体，整体重心集中，适合直接作为品牌展示海报发布。

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

promptZh: A polished studio head-and-shoulders LinkedIn profile portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="man"} centered in frame, facing straight toward the camera with a neutral, confident expression, cropped from the upper chest to just above the head. He has short {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a slightly textured top, visible ears, and light stubble beard along the jaw and chin. He wears 2 clothing layers: a dark charcoal tailored blazer over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt. The background is a deep black seamless studio backdrop with a subtle soft vignette and no visible props. Use professional corporate portrait photography styling, soft directional key light from above and slightly to one side, gentle rim separation on the shoulders and hair, realistic skin texture, sharp focus on clothing and neck, shallow depth of field, high contrast, clean premium retouching, natural color grading, and a modern executive-yet-approachable look suitable for a {argument name="platform" default="LinkedIn"} profile photo. Compose it symmetrically, minimal and elegant, with the subject isolated against the dark background, photographed as if with an 85mm lens in a high-end studio.

descriptionZh: A gritty punk-collage event poster prompt for creating rebellious promotional artwork for tech sprints, hack nights, or underground creative events.
descriptionEn: A gritty punk-collage event poster prompt for creating rebellious promotional artwork for tech sprints, hack nights, or underground creative events.
promptZh: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.

descriptionEn: Generates a nostalgic 12-panel collage of intimate candid couple moments in Tokyo, ideal for moodboards, social-media aesthetic visuals, or romantic lifestyle imagery.
promptZh: A moody 4-by-3 photo collage made of 12 candid smartphone-style snapshots of a young couple during summer nights in Tokyo, shot with a nostalgic film look, soft grain, muted colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim ambient street lighting, and intimate casual framing. The overall tone is romantic, youthful, private, and documentary-like, with a warm gray-brown palette and a slightly desaturated teal-orange night city atmosphere. The man has messy dark hair, a slim build, and wears a dark overshirt or lightweight jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long dark brown hair, a slim build, and wears a white sleeveless top with thin black shoulder straps from a bag. In every panel, both faces are intentionally obscured by large soft-edged blur blocks for anonymity. Include exactly 12 images arranged in a tight seamless grid: top row panel 1, an extreme close-up side profile of the man at night; panel 2, the woman taking a mirror or phone selfie while standing beside the man outdoors at night; panel 3, the couple pressed close together near a street sign with Japanese text; panel 4, the couple kissing at a busy crosswalk in the city. Middle row panel 5, a pavement shadow photo of two people, one making a peace sign; panel 6, the couple standing close on a sidewalk in an urban shopping street; panel 7, a sunset skyline over water with Tokyo Tower visible, no people; panel 8, a high-angle shot looking down on the woman and the man close together on stairs or a walkway. Bottom row panel 9, a tight intimate close-up of the couple touching faces or kissing; panel 10, the man adjusting or touching the woman's hair on a city street; panel 11, the couple riding together on a scooter or motorcycle, both wearing helmets, captured in motion blur; panel 12, the couple embracing against a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. Backgrounds should include Japanese city streets, storefronts, crosswalks, signage, buildings, night traffic, and urban evening ambience. Keep the composition casual and imperfect like real memories, with varied crops, soft focus, motion blur, and authentic handheld phone photography.

In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. promptZh: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. Use a humorous, critical, social-media infographic tone, balanced composition, crisp typography, high readability, and polished modern vector illustration aesthetics.

descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic parody sports newspaper cover in Spanish, ideal for humorous football transfer mockups and tabloid-style editorial images.
promptZh: A satirical Spanish sports newspaper front page designed like a tabloid cover, full-frame and perfectly frontal, on slightly aged off-white newsprint with subtle paper texture, faint stains, and narrow black border lines. The masthead is a huge red SPORT logo across the top on a bright yellow banner. In the upper right, include 1 small interview promo box with a headshot of a footballer and the text block in Spanish: “ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”. Under the masthead, add a yellow strip with bold black text “EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL” and a small red lightning bolt. The main headline dominates the page in gigantic black condensed uppercase letters over 2 lines: “LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”. Beneath it, add the subheadline in italic black Spanish text: “El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”. The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle of the page: a young footballer seen mostly from the back wearing a Barcelona home jersey in blue and garnet stripes, with the name “LAMILE” and the number “10” in large yellow lettering, standing in a celebratory stadium scene with confetti, bright lights, blurred fans, and people around him. He is holding or presenting a large bingo card board with the word “BINGO” at the top and “BINGO!” at the bottom. On the right side, create a vertical sidebar with 4 stacked content blocks: first, a photo of a calamari sandwich on a plate with the caption “El motivo del fichaje”; second, a red info box listing 3 humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text, exactly “EDAD: muy joven”, “FICHAJE: 4 cartones”, and “CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”; third, a quotes column with 3 stacked mini-items, each with a small portrait and Spanish caption: “XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”, “LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”, and “EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”; fourth, a small motorsport teaser at the bottom with a driver image and the text “FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”. Along the bottom strip, include 3 small teaser panels: 1 woman footballer holding a trophy with the text “CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”, 1 basketball panel with two Barça players and the text “BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”, and the Formula 1 teaser panel already integrated at the right edge. Add tiny newspaper metadata below the masthead on the left in Spanish, including issue number, date, and price, such as “Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”. descriptionEn: A cinematic anime poster prompt for generating an epic crossover battle visual between Japanese Sengoku warlords and Chinese Three Kingdoms heroes.
promptZh:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.

descriptionZh: A professional and highly detailed template for creating cinematic posters with narrative depth and complex character arrangements.
descriptionEn: A professional and highly detailed template for creating cinematic posters with narrative depth and complex character arrangements.
promptZh: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。

titleZh: Shan Hai Jing Vintage Comic Page
titleEn: Shan Hai Jing Vintage Comic Page
descriptionZh: This prompt transforms a reference antique comic layout into a new retro Chinese mythology page, useful for generating alternate educational storybook spreads with the same structure and print aesthetic.
descriptionEn: This prompt transforms a reference antique comic layout into a new retro Chinese mythology page, useful for generating alternate educational storybook spreads with the same structure and print aesthetic.
promptZh: Using the provided reference image as a layout and style guide, recreate it as a vintage Chinese mythological illustrated story page instead of the Monkey King page. Keep the aged textbook/comic print look, yellowed paper texture, retro ink-and-watercolor rendering, and boxed multi-panel composition. Replace the original content with a 山海经-themed page. Preserve the vertical title block on the left, but change the main title to {argument name="title text" default="山海经"}. Build a total of 8 content panels: 1 large title/hero panel at the top left featuring a mythic figure and a red sun, 5 medium boxed narrative panels in the middle rows with different ancient myth scenes, and 2 wide horizontal panels across the bottom row. Add dense Chinese explanatory captions under each panel in the same old-print style, with small numbered labels for panels 2 through 8 and a small red seal-like tag near the title. The overall result should feel like an antique Chinese serialized picture-book page from a retro children’s mythology encyclopedia.

descriptionZh: A cinematic Japanese poster featuring a business-suited Shiba Inu, self-help books, and a surreal path from office burnout to space-bound dreams, ideal for inspirational social media art or parody account posters.
descriptionEn: A cinematic Japanese poster featuring a business-suited Shiba Inu, self-help books, and a surreal path from office burnout to space-bound dreams, ideal for inspirational social media art or parody account posters.
promptZh: A dramatic Japanese motivational movie-poster style illustration set at dusk, mixing corporate burnout and hopeful space-dream fantasy. In the center foreground, an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu with warm tan fur smiles confidently at the viewer, wearing a sharp navy business suit, white dress shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in the left paw with the screen text “kindle” and a black-and-gold fountain pen in the right paw. Behind the character, the background is split into two thematic halves that blend together: on the left, a dense Tokyo-like city skyline at sunset with Tokyo Tower glowing orange, dark office buildings, and exhausted salary workers at desks under a stressful atmosphere; on the right, a deep starry cosmos with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upward, 3 airplanes, a winding glowing golden trajectory line, 1 small planet, 2 floating paw prints, 2 packaged breads labeled “カンパン,” and 1 round biscuit labeled “南部せんべい.” Near the right lower background, show a family of 4 from behind walking toward the bright horizon with a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. Add 3 black signboards floating in the left midground with the Japanese words “残業,” “プレッシャー,” and “会議 満員電車.” In the foreground on a wooden desk, place exactly 3 prominently displayed books standing upright: book 1 on the left is white and blue with the title “忙しい社会人のやり直し英語勉強法” and a small illustrated author portrait; book 2 in the center is dark blue and gold with the large title “『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最強の生存戦略である”; book 3 on the right is white and blue with the title “『すぐやる』は最速の仕事術” and a large “5” plus a circular “5 MIN” icon. Also on the desk, include 1 black coffee mug with the text “未来は 5分で変わる,” 1 spiral notebook opened flat with a handwritten to-do list in Japanese reading “今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）” plus a paw-print doodle, 1 black fountain pen lying beside it, 1 globe on a stand at the far right, 1 plate of crackers, 1 extra packaged “カンパン,” and small framed photos at the lower left edge. At the top, large luxurious gold Japanese headline text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}” with a smaller gold subtitle beneath: “〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜”. Below that, centered white copy reads “忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、夢は本気で掴んだ。” At the bottom center, add a cinematic English tagline: “Based on a true story of たかお柴犬” and beneath it “A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”. Use ultra-detailed glossy poster rendering, warm orange sunset versus cool blue space contrast, inspirational commercial key art, sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, whimsical but sincere tone, highly polished social-media poster composition, vertical format.

descriptionZh: A high-contrast editorial infographic poster about the hidden cognitive cost of short-form media, suitable for awareness campaigns, social commentary, or magazine-style design.
descriptionEn: A high-contrast editorial infographic poster about the hidden cognitive cost of short-form media, suitable for awareness campaigns, social commentary, or magazine-style design.
promptZh:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. titleZh: Social Media Profile News Broadcast Transformation
titleEn: Social Media Profile News Broadcast Transformation
descriptionZh: A detailed prompt that analyzes a user's X (Twitter) profile screenshot and generates a realistic Japanese TV breaking news screen featuring the user.
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt that analyzes a user's X (Twitter) profile screenshot and generates a realistic Japanese TV breaking news screen featuring the user.
promptZh: Analyze the uploaded X (Twitter) profile screenshot. First, extract my profile picture, display name, and bio text. Then, based on my bio and overall vibe, generate a realistic Japanese TV breaking news broadcast screen image featuring me. The character should closely resemble the person in the profile picture, shown as if being interviewed live on camera. Design it to look like a Japanese news program (similar to NHK News or News Zero style). All text must be in Japanese. Include the following elements: 1. A red "速報" banner at the top of the screen. 2. A large headline in Japanese summarizing who I am based on my bio (e.g., "AI時代の案内人 ○○氏 独占取材"). 3. A profile data box on the side of the screen (like Japanese news info panels) containing: - "人物像" section: 3 short bullet points about my personality or profession based on my bio - "注目ポイント" section: 3 small items representing my interests or skills inferred from my profile 4. A news ticker at the bottom with 2-3 humorous short updates derived from my bio and interests, written in Japanese. 5. A fictional Japanese news channel logo in the corner (e.g., "プロフィールTV" or "X速報チャンネル"). 6. A "生中継" or "LIVE" indicator in red in the upper corner. The overall look should be a photorealistic Japanese TV news broadcast screen with clean, modern Japanese typography. Ensure all Japanese text is perfectly legible and accurately reflects my profile information.

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a stylish close-up anime portrait of a wistful young woman, ideal for profile art, character illustrations, or elegant social media visuals.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a stylish close-up anime portrait of a wistful young woman, ideal for profile art, character illustrations, or elegant social media visuals.
promptZh: A soft, airy anime portrait of a delicate young woman in a minimalist off-white background, shown from the chest up in a close three-quarter view. She has long, slightly wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with ash-gray highlights"} hair with wispy strands and straight-cut bangs, tied on one side with a large black ribbon bow. Her eyes are large, glossy, and pale gray with detailed lashes and a dreamy, distant expression. She rests her cheek against one hand, with slender fingers partly covering her face and muted gray nail polish visible. She wears a white off-shoulder blouse with voluminous sleeves, soft ruffles, gathered fabric, and thin black ribbon ties on the sleeves, creating a gentle monochrome contrast. Add a single long, elegant gold drop earring with a small pearl on the visible ear. Use a clean manga-inspired illustration style with light linework, subtle blush tones, soft cel shading, and painterly highlights in the hair. The mood is quiet, wistful, and feminine, with a refined fashion-illustration feel and a very limited palette of white, black, taupe, and gray.
promptEn: A soft, airy anime portrait of a delicate young woman in a minimalist off-white background, shown from the chest up in a close three-quarter view. descriptionEn: A complex prompt designed to generate a seamless horizontal split-screen image blending historical and modern eras within a single scene.
promptZh: A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of {argument name="scene" default="Times Square, New York"}, seamlessly blending two different eras: {argument name="first era" default="1920s"} on the left and {argument name="second era" default="present day"} on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day). On the left side: show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from the era, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands. The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate. On the right side: show the same scene in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology. People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting. In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new. Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling. Aspect Ratio: 4:3

descriptionZh: This prompt generates a highly detailed vertical cyberpunk-style cityscape illustration for posters, concept art, or atmospheric editorial visuals about dense urban loneliness.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a highly detailed vertical cyberpunk-style cityscape illustration for posters, concept art, or atmospheric editorial visuals about dense urban loneliness.
promptZh: A hyper-detailed ultra-high-resolution vertical illustration of a surreal Japanese futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a very high, steep downward angle through a cramped canyon of buildings, as if standing on a dark hillside alley or rooftop overlook. Keep the composition 9:16 and dramatic, with a deep plunging perspective into an immense glowing urban basin packed with tightly layered low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated walkways, and towering skyscrapers fading into the distance. Frame the scene with dense foreground architecture on both sides: on the upper left, a large glowing red paper lantern sign with bold black Japanese characters hanging from an old wooden eave; on the right, a tall building facade with many lit windows and several vertical neon signs; across the image, tangled overhead utility wires and poles cut through the view. The city below should feel overcrowded yet mesmerizing, blending retro Showa-era alleyway aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism. Use a rich, graphic painterly style with strong black inky linework, bold cel-shaded shapes, and luminous neon accents, preserving a Midjourney-like cinematic beauty while adding much finer environmental detail. Dominant colors are blazing orange and amber window light, saturated crimson and scarlet signage, deep violet night sky, hot magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. Populate the lower city with countless tiny readable micro-scenes implied through silhouettes and lit windows: festival processions in the streets, nightlife crowds, exhausted salary workers, hidden gang figures in side alleys, dancers in entertainment lanes, students studying in apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers at glowing screens, and many other small human stories embedded throughout the architecture. descriptionZh: This prompt generates a realistic candid photo of a woman eating traditional breakfast foods inside a bustling Taiwanese diner, ideal for lifestyle, food-travel, or street photography visuals.
descriptionEn: This prompt generates a realistic candid photo of a woman eating traditional breakfast foods inside a bustling Taiwanese diner, ideal for lifestyle, food-travel, or street photography visuals.
promptZh: A candid smartphone photo of a young East Asian woman seated at a small round table inside a busy old-fashioned Taiwanese breakfast shop. She is the main subject, framed from mid-thigh upward, facing the camera in a casual seated pose. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with a center part, small gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a tiny heart pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim cutoff shorts with light distressing. In one hand she holds a piece of fried cruller near her mouth, and in the other hand she holds another broken piece over the table. On the table are 4 visible food and drink items: a plate with fried cruller pieces, a wrapped scallion pancake with black sesame seeds, a white foam takeout tray containing 2 pancakes including one covered with dark soy-based sauce and chopped scallions, and a large takeaway cup of soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese logo. The restaurant interior is compact and brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, terrazzo-style flooring, and tightly packed diners in the background. Behind her are large windows and wall signage with bold red traditional Chinese characters, including breakfast items such as soy milk, youtiao, rice rolls, shaobing, and egg pancake. There are several seated customers eating, staff working behind a metal counter, a small wall-mounted television showing a female news anchor, and a hanging menu board with red Chinese text and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, lively local atmosphere, slight wide-angle phone camera perspective, documentary food-travel aesthetic.

promptZh: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

descriptionZh: A comedic realistic game-style screenshot showing two rival fan groups battling for the front row at Tokyo DisneySea, useful for parody arcade fighting game visuals.
descriptionEn: A comedic realistic game-style screenshot showing two rival fan groups battling for the front row at Tokyo DisneySea, useful for parody arcade fighting game visuals.
promptZh:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". At the lower right, add a quest panel titled "クエスト" with the mission text "ショー開始までに最前列を死守しろ！" and condition text "条件：ライバルグループを全員後ろに押し戻せ！" and countdown text "ショー開始まで：02:30". Beside it, add a mini-map titled "ミッキー広場MAP" showing red and blue dots for both teams in the plaza. Along the very bottom edge, include small controller prompts in Japanese for actions such as skill use, item use, grab/push, and dash.

Use dramatic, saturated lighting, crisp detail, realistic clothing folds, authentic plaza stone pavement, and a high-end Japanese game screenshot look. The image should feel like a ridiculous but believable crossover between a real Tokyo DisneySea crowd photo and a competitive arcade battle game interface.

promptZh: A hyper-realistic full-body studio portrait of a disturbing humanoid alien standing alone against a dark, smoky blue-black backdrop. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, a narrow waist, long thin fingers, and oversized bare feet planted on a dim studio floor. Its skin is smooth but leathery and subtly wrinkled, colored deep charcoal blue with cold gray highlights, showing sharply defined ribs, sternum, collarbones, tendons, and stringy musculature across the chest, abdomen, shoulders, and neck. The torso is hairless and gaunt, with an eerie anatomical realism that feels biologically plausible but unsettling. The head is bald, enlarged, and slightly bulbous with a classic extraterrestrial silhouette, attached to an unnaturally long neck; keep the face obscure, unreadable, and deeply uncanny rather than expressive. Pose the alien front-facing with a slight three-quarter angle, arms hanging loosely at its sides, posture upright but subtly predatory, centered in frame from head to feet. Use low-key cinematic lighting with a faint cool rim light and soft overhead illumination that sculpts every crease and contour while keeping the overall scene dark, moody, and oppressive. Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster about {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, designed as a Chinese-language illustrated tourist guide page on warm aged paper lying on a wooden tabletop. At the top center, place large bold black Chinese calligraphy for {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, with the English word {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} underneath in loose blue brush script. Photo 2: the Great Wall winding across green mountains under a bright sky, captioned about Great Wall of China landscape and green mountains. promptZh: A vintage socialist propaganda poster in a mid-20th-century Chinese style, printed on aged paper with a warm sepia tint, distressed texture, faded ink, and slightly worn edges. The composition is vertical and heroic. On the right half of the poster, show a large waist-up portrait of a male worker or revolutionary figure wearing a dark cap and a dark utilitarian jacket, facing slightly to the left with a stoic, determined expression. On the left-center, a white reusable rocket rises upward with bright engine flame, depicted like an aspirational symbol of technological progress; the rocket has the word "SPACEX" written vertically on its body and visible landing legs near the base. Behind the rocket, fill the sky with dramatic cream-colored sunburst rays spreading outward across a muted blue background. descriptionEn: This prompt generates a retro-style Kyoto tourism poster, ideal for travel art prints, editorial covers, or destination-themed wall decor.
promptZh: A vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"} in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

descriptionZh: A nostalgic illustrated postcard layout combining The Little Prince and a modern rocket launch, ideal for editorial art, themed prints, or brand-crossover concept visuals.
descriptionEn: A nostalgic illustrated postcard layout combining The Little Prince and a modern rocket launch, ideal for editorial art, themed prints, or brand-crossover concept visuals.
promptZh: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

promptZh: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. The page contains exactly 5 panels arranged in a classic comic layout: 1 wide top panel, 2 middle panels side by side, and 2 bottom panels side by side. In the top panel, show a sunny coastal boulevard in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, with turquoise water on the left, a sailboat offshore, pastel Art Deco buildings in the distance, tall palm trees, and a pink classic convertible driving along the waterfront. A stylish couple sits in the car, and large dramatic comic title lettering reads “ART IN MIAMI!” with a small caption box at the top saying “MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”. Add two speech balloons: “READY TO SEE SOME ART?” and “ALWAYS!”. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. In the fourth panel, place the couple inside a gallery viewing large abstract paintings in bright pastel blocks and shapes, with a small sculpture on a pedestal nearby; add a caption box reading “INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.” and speech balloons saying “I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.” and “IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. descriptionEn: This prompt generates a tall museum-style botanical infographic poster showing the full life cycle, anatomy, and growth systems of a pomegranate plant for educational or decorative science-art use.
promptZh:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

descriptionEn: A complex collage prompt for a magazine page that blends various scientific, artistic, and technical diagrams to celebrate visual culture.
promptZh: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.

descriptionZh: This prompt turns a character reference sheet into a dramatic, text-heavy VTuber debut promotional poster for social thumbnails and announcement art.
