titleZh: 电商主图 - 高端时尚编辑风格宣传海报
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - High-End Fashion Editorial Campaign Poster
descriptionZh: 一款专为产品发布设计的专业编辑风格时尚海报提示词，具备细腻的质感、摄影棚灯光效果及品牌元素。
descriptionEn: A professional editorial fashion poster prompt designed for product launches, featuring detailed textures, studio lighting, and branding elements.
promptZh: 创作一张 4:5 比例的高端时尚产品广告海报，采用简洁的极简编辑风格，并使用参考产品图。背景为 {argument name="background" default="暖米白色至浅卡其色渐变摄影棚设置"}，极简、柔和、通透，带有微妙的暖色调。主体产品：一件 {argument name="apparel" default="橄榄军绿色超大廓形华夫格长袖圆领衫"}，悬挂在银色金属衣架上，右上角可见夹子。衬衫自然下垂，略带褶皱，正面朝向。胸部中央包含 {argument name="branding text" default="白色立体刺绣文字：“SVG”"}。右侧下摆接缝处添加一个小巧的深海军蓝编织标签，领口处可见深海军蓝领标。排版：顶部中央为橄榄绿色简洁无衬线字体品牌 Logo “SVG STUDIOS”，左上角为斜体草书 “Field”，下方配有一个深橄榄色小矩形徽章，内含白色 “edition” 字样；衬衫后方放置巨大的超紧凑橄榄绿色文字 “WAFFLE TEE”，被产品部分遮挡并切断，延伸至画面边缘。左下角包含手写体 “SVG” 和大型草书 “Studios”，均为橄榄色调。底部区域设有三条对角线细节带：微距华夫格纹理、特写立体刺绣针脚以及深海军蓝领标特写，均采用暖色调摄影棚灯光。条带间包含小字 “Built for movement, designed for unity. The SVG Studios WIP Waffle Longsleeve — SS26 Collection”。页脚包含左下角的 4 个小条形码、居中的橄榄色调间距大写文字 “• WWW. SVGSTUDIOS. COM • • •”，以及小字 “MADE IN MALAYSIA • SS26 COLLECTION”。配色方案仅限橄榄军绿、暖奶油色和深海军蓝。整体风格为简洁的编辑风格时尚 Lookbook，军事风街头服饰宣传，柔和漫射光，高对比度产品聚焦，照片级真实感，超高细节，8K 画质。
promptEn: Create a high-end fashion product advertisement poster in portrait 4:5 ratio, clean minimal editorial style using a reference product image. Background is a {argument name="background" default="warm off-white to light khaki gradient studio setup"}, very minimal, soft, airy, with subtle warm tones. Main product: an {argument name="apparel" default="olive army green oversized waffle-knit long sleeve crewneck shirt"}, ghost-hung on a silver metal clothing rack stand with a visible clamp at the top-right. The shirt hangs naturally with slight drape, front-facing. On the center chest, include {argument name="branding text" default="white puff embroidery text: “SVG”"}. Add a small dark navy woven label patch on the right hem side seam and a visible dark navy neck tag at the collar. Typography: top center minimal brand logo “SVG STUDIOS” in olive green clean sans-serif, top-left italic cursive “Field” with a small dark olive rectangle badge below reading “edition” in white, behind the shirt place massive ultra-condensed olive green text “WAFFLE TEE” partially hidden and cut by the product, bleeding off edges. lower-left include handwritten “SVG” and large cursive “Studios” in olive tone. Bottom section features three diagonal detail strips: macro waffle-knit texture, closeup puff embroidery stitching, and closeup dark navy neck label, all with warm studio lighting. Between strips include small text “Built for movement, designed for unity. The SVG Studios WIP Waffle Longsleeve — SS26 Collection” Footer includes 4 small barcode at bottom-left, centered text “• WWW. SVGSTUDIOS. COM • • •” in spaced caps olive tone, and small text “MADE IN MALAYSIA • SS26 COLLECTION”. Color palette is olive army green, warm cream, and dark navy only. Overall style is clean editorial fashion lookbook, military-inspired streetwear campaign, soft diffused lighting, high contrast product focus, photorealistic, ultra detailed, 8K quality.

titleZh: 电商主图 - 奢华珠宝金库展览
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - Luxury Jewelry Vault Exhibition
descriptionZh: 用于创作高端珠宝或腕表广告视觉效果的提示词，将其置于建筑级博物馆金库场景中展示。
descriptionEn: A prompt for creating high end campaign visuals of jewelry or watches displayed in an architectural, museum grade vault setting.
promptZh: 超豪华广告视觉效果，展示 {argument name="luxury item" default="珠宝 / 腕表 / 配饰"}，置于建筑风格的金库式构图中，仿佛属于不对外公开的私人收藏。主体物品应高置于雕塑感底座上，或悬浮于受控的展示龛内，周围环绕着分层隔间、托盘、滑动面板、抛光表面以及精心挑选的辅助工艺品。布局概念：画面应呈现出秘密收藏室在完美瞬间开启的感觉。采用正面或微侧的构图，具有强烈的对称性或近乎对称的视觉效果。在主体周围布置 {argument name="gem details" default="宝石细节"}、[工艺元素]、[档案记录]、[材质样本] 以及 [定制工具或支架]，所有元素均以极致的精度排列。奢华细节：包含天鹅绒内衬的凹槽、烟熏玻璃面板、拉丝黄铜镶嵌、漆木、抛光石材、深色镜面、精致的雕刻编号以及博物馆级的展示硬件。一切都应围绕主体物品进行定制设计。视觉风格：高级珠宝广告与私人博物馆展览及野兽派奢华产品陈列的结合。精致、干练、内敛、昂贵，具有完美的空间把控力。构图指南：主体物品占据绝对主导地位。辅助隔间必须提升吸引力，而非喧宾夺主。场景应保持足够的留白以体现独特性，同时具备足够的层次感以供细细品味。利用形状和线条的有意重复来营造奢华的节奏感。光影与背景：在珍贵材质上运用精准的镜面高光、柔和的阴影过渡、戏剧性的边缘光、天鹅绒般的深黑色以及温暖的金属反射色调。背景或外壳采用 {argument name="vault palette" default="金库色调"}。超清晰的编辑级广告质感，无水印。
promptEn: ultra-luxury campaign visual for {argument name="luxury item" default="jewel / watch / accessory"}, displayed inside an architectural vault-like composition as if it belongs to a private collection unavailable to the public. the hero item should sit elevated on a sculptural pedestal or suspended in a controlled showcase niche, surrounded by layered compartments, trays, sliding panels, polished surfaces, and curated supporting artifacts. layout concept: the image should feel like a secret collector’s chamber opened at the perfect moment. use a front-facing or slightly angled composition with strong symmetry or near-symmetry. surround the hero piece with micro-arrangements of {argument name="gem details" default="gem details"}, [craft elements], [archival notes], [material samples], and [custom tooling or stands], all arranged with extreme precision. luxury details: include velvet-lined cavities, smoked glass panels, brushed brass inlays, lacquered wood, polished stone, dark mirror surfaces, subtle engraved numbering, and museum-grade display hardware. everything should feel custom-built around the hero object. visual style: high-jewelry campaign meets private museum exhibition meets brutalist-luxury product staging. refined, crisp, reserved, expensive, with immaculate spatial control. composition guidelines: hero object is unquestionably dominant. supporting compartments must enhance desirability, not distract. keep the scene sparse enough to feel exclusive, but layered enough to reward inspection. use intentional repetition of shapes and lines to create luxury rhythm. lighting & background: pinpoint specular highlights on precious materials, soft shadow falloff, dramatic edge light, velvet-deep blacks, and warm reflected metallic tones. background or housing in {argument name="vault palette" default="vault palette"}. ultra-crisp, editorial campaign finish, no watermark.

titleZh: 电商主图 - 极简火柴盒日光摄影
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - Minimal Matchbox Sunlight Study
descriptionZh: 生成一张宽幅编辑类产品照片，展示混凝土上极简风格的火柴盒，呈现建筑阴影与折射的彩虹光影。
descriptionEn: Generates a wide editorial product photo of a minimalist matchbox on concrete with architectural shadows and refracted rainbow light.
promptZh: 创作一张 3:1 超宽幅电影感产品摄影，展示一个白色小火柴盒斜放在平滑的灰色混凝土底面上，背景为午后强烈的阳光。火柴盒右侧微微开启，露出盒内整齐排列的 5 根木质火柴，火柴杆色泽浅淡，火柴头呈深色。盒盖顶部印有极简风格的黑色小写字母 {argument name="matchbox text" default="maison de l'architecture et de la ville"}，文字在盖面上稀疏排布，呈现现代感；盒身侧下缘可见一条纤细的暗红橙色摩擦条。强烈的建筑阴影投射在场景中，包括从右上角延伸出的一大片深色矩形阴影，以及盒后另一道柔和的对角线阴影。在火柴盒上方及周围添加一道精致的弧形彩虹色焦散光晕，左下角混凝土表面呈现出微妙的闪烁光斑，仿佛阳光透过玻璃折射而成。保持构图极简、静谧且具有编辑感，留出大量负空间，强调真实质感、柔和胶片颗粒、高动态范围、自然色彩，焦点清晰地落在火柴盒上，呈现出精致的当代建筑杂志美学。
promptEn: Create an ultra-wide 3:1 cinematic product photograph of a small white matchbox lying diagonally on a smooth gray concrete floor in hard late-afternoon sunlight. The matchbox is partly open on the right, revealing exactly 5 wooden matches with pale sticks and dark tips, neatly aligned inside the tray. The top of the box has minimalist black lowercase typography reading {argument name="matchbox text" default="maison de l'architecture et de la ville"}, spaced across the lid in a sparse modern layout, with a thin muted red-orange striker strip visible along the lower side edge. Strong architectural shadows fall across the scene, including one large dark rectangular shadow stretching from the upper right and another softer diagonal shadow passing behind the box. Add a delicate curved rainbow-like caustic light flare arcing above and around the matchbox, with subtle shimmering light patterns on the concrete near the lower left, as if sunlight is refracting through glass. Keep the composition minimal, quiet, and editorial, with lots of negative space, realistic texture, soft film grain, high dynamic range, natural color, sharp focus on the matchbox, and a refined contemporary architecture-magazine aesthetic.

titleZh: 电商主图 - Pop Mart Hirono 风格定制人偶提示词
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - Pop Mart Hirono Style Custom Figure Prompt
descriptionZh: 一份详细的提示词，旨在将用户照片转化为具有 Pop Mart Hirono 美学风格的潮流设计师玩具人偶，在保留人物特征的同时，呈现出忧郁、高端的艺术玩具质感。
descriptionEn: A detailed prompt for transforming a person's photo into a stylized collectible designer vinyl figure in the Pop Mart Hirono aesthetic, focusing on preserving identity while applying a melancholic, high end toy look.
promptZh: 请仅使用用户上传的 1 张真实人物照片作为唯一的身份参考，将该人物延展为 {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} 美学风格的潮流设计师玩具人偶，并输出一张高完成度的单体人偶产品场景图。严格保留真实人物的辨识度，包括脸型、五官比例、发型轮廓、年龄感、性别特征、肤色倾向、整体气质，以及原图中可识别的服装和配饰特征，确保最终的人偶能被清晰地识别为照片中的本人。整体风格必须明确倾向于 POP MART / Hirono 设计师玩具美学：安静、柔和、克制、带有一丝忧郁和沉思感，呈现出高端 Pop Mart 潮流玩具的质感，而非普通的可爱毛绒玩具。人偶应采用大头小身的比例，头部约为身体的 2.5 到 3 倍大，身体短小圆润，四肢简化，鞋袜略大，整体具有扎实的雕塑感和重量感。姿态应保持平静，略微前倾或低头，带有一定的情绪感，避免夸张的动作。面部必须保留原图特征，但要转化为 Hirono 的氛围：半睁或微垂的睡眼、较厚的涂装睫毛、小巧克制的微嘟嘴、极简的鼻子、圆润的脸型、淡淡的腮红或少量雀斑，表情呈现出些许迷茫、厌世或忧郁——严禁出现灿烂的笑容或闪亮的动漫眼。发型应保留原图轮廓，但需处理成实心、圆润、成束、具有切面感的纯手工雕塑结构，而非真实发丝，发色使用低饱和度的自然色，如 {argument name="hair color" default="柔棕色、灰棕色或柔黑色"}，并进行哑光处理。服装应保留原图的穿搭气质，但简化为厚实、圆润、玩具般的雕塑感色块，可略微超大，带有少量玩具质感的缝线、补丁或轻微的磨损细节，避免真实的织物纹理。原图中可识别的配饰（如咖啡杯、小包、花朵、冰棒、书籍或小玩偶）可以保留，但必须转化为比例略微夸张的哑光玩具配件。材质必须呈现高端哑光搪胶 / 哑光树脂 / 哑光陶瓷质感，带有轻微的手工雕塑痕迹和手绘纹理，避免光泽感、镜面高光、玻璃感、真实皮肤、真实毛发或可见的贴图纹理。场景应输出一张单体全身人偶产品图，而非网格图、系列展示、包装海报或盲盒全套。将人偶置于精致、立体、统一的微缩主题场景中，如同品牌潮流玩具的产品海报。场景可选自 {argument name="scene theme" default="日常咖啡、花园角落、云端白日梦、安静书房、月下发呆或动物陪伴"}，要求场景立体、精致、具有摄影感，且不过于复杂。灯光应使用柔和的漫反射产品摄影光，配合干净的高光、柔和的阴影和中性的曝光，使整体画面看起来像一张高端的 Pop Mart 新品宣传照。严格避免普通的 Q 版插画、2D 动漫感、韩漫风格、芭比娃娃感、写实 3D 毛绒感或复杂杂乱的背景。
promptEn: Please use only 1 real person's photo uploaded by the user as the sole identity reference to originally extend the person into a collectible designer vinyl figure in the {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} aesthetic, and output a high-completion single figure product scene image. Strictly preserve the real person's recognizability, including face shape, facial features relationship, hairstyle outline, sense of age, gender characteristics, skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and recognizable clothing identity and accessory features from the original photo, so that the final figure can clearly be identified as the same person from the uploaded photo. The overall style must clearly lean towards POP MART / Hirono designer vinyl aesthetics: quiet, soft, restrained, slightly melancholic, and pensive, like high-end Pop Mart collectible trendy toys rather than an ordinary cute plush. The figure should use big-head-small-body proportions, with the head about 2.5 to 3 times the size of the body, a short and rounded body, simplified limbs, and slightly larger shoes/socks, overall possessing a real sense of solid sculpture and weight. The posture should be calm, slightly leaning forward or slightly bowing the head, carrying a bit of character emotion without exaggerated movements. Faces must retain the original features but transform them into the Hirono vibe: half-open or slightly drooping sleepy eyes, thicker painted eyelashes, a small and restrained slightly pouty mouth, minimalist nose, rounded face shape, very faint blush or a few freckles, with expressions being slightly dazed, slightly world-weary, or slightly melancholic—no bright smiles or shiny anime eyes. Hair should retain the outline of the original photo but must be made into a solid, rounded, bundled, faceted handmade sculptural structure, not real hair strands, with hair colors using low-saturation natural colors like {argument name="hair color" default="soft brown, grey-brown, or soft black"} and matte treatment. Clothing should retain the original outfit's temperament but be simplified into thick, rounded, toy-like sculptural clothing blocks, potentially slightly oversized, with a few toy-like stitches, patches, or slight wear-and-tear details, avoiding real fabric textures. Recognizable accessories from the original photo like coffee cups, small bags, flowers, popsicles, books, or small dolls can be kept but must be transformed into slightly exaggeratedly proportioned matte figure accessories. The material must be high-end matte vinyl / matte resin / matte ceramic feel, with slight handmade sculpture marks and hand-painted texture, avoiding glossy, mirror highlights, glass feel, real skin, real hair, or visible texture maps. The scene should output a single full-body figure product image, not a grid, series display, packaging poster, or full blind box set. Place the figure in an exquisite, three-dimensional, unified miniature theme scene like a brand trendy toy product poster. The scene can be one of {argument name="scene theme" default="daily coffee, garden corner, cloud daydreaming, quiet study, moonlit daze, or animal companionship"}, requiring it to be three-dimensional, exquisite, photographic, and not overly complex. Lighting should use soft diffused product photography light with clean highlights, soft shadows, and neutral exposure, making the overall image look like a high-end Pop Mart new product shot. Strictly avoid ordinary Q-version illustrations, 2D anime feel, Korean webtoon style, Barbie doll look, realistic 3D plush feel, or complex cluttered backgrounds.

titleZh: 电商主图 - 写实高端美甲生成器
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - Realistic High-End Nail Art Generator
descriptionZh: 一个专门用于根据可定制的主题灵感，生成专业、杂志级美甲特写图像的提示词。
descriptionEn: A specialized prompt for generating professional, magazine quality close ups of manicured hands based on customizable thematic inspiration.
promptZh:
请生成一张写实的美甲特写图像，主题灵感为：{argument name="theme" default="水母"}。

主体为一只精心护理的女性手部特写。指甲采用高端凝胶设计，围绕 {argument name="theme" default="水母"} 展开，呈现出时尚杂志所特有的优雅、干净、精致的视觉效果。请强调美甲的细节、光泽质感以及与主题氛围的一致性。

构图与主体要求：
聚焦于手部和指甲特写。手指姿态自然优雅，传达出奢华感。每枚指甲均围绕主题进行设计，结合手绘元素、纯色底色搭配闪粉/箔片装饰，风格多变且协调。设计应包含优质底胶、精致彩绘以及亮片或金属箔等配套装饰。风格必须专业且高级，避免廉价或幼稚感。

光影与摄影：
柔和的自然光，无生硬阴影，浅景深，焦点清晰地落在指甲细节和光泽上。高端美容编辑风格，专业商业摄影，真实的皮肤纹理，4K 超高清画质。

背景：
柔和的虚化背景，呼应 {argument name="theme" default="水母"} 主题，且不会喧宾夺主。

整体风格：
照片级写实，光泽凝胶质感，优雅且干净。避免卡通/插画风格、手指变形或低质量纹理。

长宽比：{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}
promptEn:
Please generate a realistic close-up of hand nail art, with the theme inspiration: {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"}.

The main subject is a close-up of a meticulously cared-for female hand. The nails feature high-end gel designs, centered around {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"}, presenting an elegant, clean, refined visual effect characteristic of fashion magazines. Emphasize the detail of the nail art, the glossy texture, and the consistency with the theme's atmosphere.

Composition and Subject Requirements:
The focus is on the hand and nail close-up. Finger gestures are natural and elegant, conveying a sense of luxury. Each nail is designed around the theme, using combinations like hand-painted elements, solid bases with glitter/foil accents, and varied but cohesive styles. Designs should include premium base gel, delicate painting, and matching decorations like sequins or metallic foil. The style must be professional and sophisticated, not cheap or juvenile.

Lighting and Photography:
Soft natural light, no harsh shadows, shallow depth of field, and sharp focus on nail details and gloss. High-end beauty editorial style, professional commercial photography, realistic skin textures, and 4K ultra HD clarity.

Background:
A soft, blurred background that echoes the {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"} without distracting from the main subject.

Overall Style:
Photorealistic, glossy gel finish, elegant, and clean. Avoid cartoon/illustration styles, distorted fingers, or low-quality textures.

Aspect Ratio: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}

titleZh: 电商主图 - UV 树脂城市景观球
titleEn: E-commerce Main Image - UV Resin Cityscape Orb
descriptionZh: 生成一张包含微缩城市景观的透明树脂球超写实微距图像，适用于 UV 树脂艺术创作和梦幻产品展示。
descriptionEn: Generates a photorealistic macro image of a clear resin sphere containing a miniature city landscape, useful for UV resin art and magical product mockups.
promptZh: 创作一张超写实的产品风格微距图像，展示一个放置在光亮深色木质桌面上的透明 UV 树脂艺术球。在透明球体内部，封装一个微缩全景 {argument name="embedded scene" default="蓝天白云下，绿地旁现代化的城市天际线"}，包含高耸的玻璃摩天大楼、低矮的城市地平线、前景中翠绿的草地，以及右侧一个独特的弧形圆顶建筑结构。球体应呈现出抛光树脂或玻璃的质感，具有强烈的折射效果、镜头畸变、放大的内部景观，球体内悬浮着细小的金色闪粉和微小气泡，边缘处带有闪烁的高光。使用 {argument name="lighting mode" default="开启灯光"}：温暖的室内照明，带有明亮的镜面反射，球体左侧边缘有发光高光，并点缀着闪烁的金色斑点。将球体置于画面偏下方，放置在纹理丰富、带有可见划痕、反射和温暖琥珀色调的漆面木桌上。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现舒适的深棕色室内环境，包括左侧失焦的装饰容器和右侧的一个小型圆形金属物体，营造出浅景深和焦外成像效果。构图采用写实微距摄影风格，4:3 画幅，高细节，球体清晰，背景虚化，展现奢华的手工树脂工艺美学，仿佛一个被困在水晶球中的梦幻微缩世界。
promptEn: Create a photorealistic close-up product-style image of a perfectly clear spherical UV resin art orb sitting on a glossy dark wooden tabletop. Inside the transparent sphere, encapsulate a miniature panoramic {argument name="embedded scene" default="modern city skyline beside a green park under a vivid blue sky"}, with tall glass skyscrapers, a low urban horizon, bright grass in the foreground, and a distinctive curved dome-like architectural structure on the right. The sphere should look like polished resin or glass, with strong refraction, lens distortion, magnified internal scenery, tiny suspended gold glitter and micro-bubbles throughout, and sparkling highlights around the rim. Use {argument name="lighting mode" default="lighting on"}: warm indoor illumination with bright specular reflections, a glowing highlight on the left edge of the orb, and shimmering gold flecks. Place the orb centered slightly low in the frame on a richly grained varnished wooden table with visible scratches, reflections, and warm amber tones. The background should be softly blurred with cozy dark-brown interior objects, including an out-of-focus decorative container on the left and a small round metallic object on the right, creating shallow depth of field and bokeh. Compose as a realistic macro photograph, 4:3 aspect ratio, high detail, crisp sphere, blurred background, luxurious handmade resin craft aesthetic, magical miniature world trapped inside a crystal ball.

descriptionZh: 生成一个动态的动漫风格动作场景，展示两个角色在传统道场中伴随元素光环进行战斗。
descriptionEn: Generates a dynamic, high impact anime illustration of two female characters fighting in a traditional dojo with elemental energy effects.
promptZh: 一幅极具动态感的动漫插画，描绘了两名少女在传统木质道场内进行激烈武术对决的场景。在前景中，一名留着 {argument name="character 1 hair" default="黑色高丸子头配红色丝带"} 的少女摆出强有力的低位武术架势，正奋力挥拳。她身穿 {argument name="character 1 outfit" default="带有红色流苏的白色中式上衣和红色宽松长裤"}，强烈的红色能量斩击环绕着她挥动的四肢。在右侧半空中，一名留着 {argument name="character 2 hair" default="浅紫色双丸子头"} 的少女优雅地跃起，自信地微笑着，身穿 {argument name="character 2 outfit" default="带有金色刺绣的深绿色连衣裙和黑色紧身裤"}，伴随着扫过的蓝色水流状能量轨迹。背景是质朴的木质寺庙内部，上方悬挂着一块写有“{argument name="sign text" default="武術会"}”的醒目招牌。场景充满了爆发性的动作感，飞扬的尘土、破碎的木质地板、发光的彩色粒子特效，以及将角色与精细背景完美区分开来的戏剧性低角度光影。
promptEn: An anime-style illustration of a {argument name="action type" default="high-impact martial arts battle"} between two young female fighters in a {argument name="setting" default="traditional wooden martial arts dojo"}. In the foreground, a girl with black hair in a high bun wears a {argument name="character 1 color theme" default="red and white"} Chinese-style martial arts outfit with baggy pants. She is in a dynamic, low, forward-thrusting stance, surrounded by swirling red energy and water splashes. In the background to the right, a girl with light purple hair in twin buns wears a {argument name="character 2 color theme" default="green and purple"} Chinese dress with gold embroidery and black tights. She is leaping through the air in a flying kick pose, surrounded by swirling blue energy. The wooden floorboards are splintering from the intense impact, with debris and dust flying through the air. Above them hangs a weathered wooden sign with the text "{argument name="sign text" default="武術会"}". The scene features dramatic lighting, a low-angle dynamic perspective, and intense action effects.

titleZh: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - 20 世纪 70 年代神秘学儿童读物页面
titleEn: Infographic / Edu Visual - 1970s Occult Children's Book Page
descriptionZh: 这是一个专为图生图（image to image）生成设计的创意提示词，旨在将角色转化为 20 世纪 70 年代风格的日本儿童读物页面，并辅以复古印刷质感和伪科学的神秘学解读。
descriptionEn: A creative prompt designed for image to image generation that transforms a character into a 1970s style Japanese children's book page, complete with retro printing artifacts and pseudo scientific occult explanations.
promptZh:
使用此角色，绘制 {argument name="theme" default="一页关于神秘学、未来科学或超自然现象的 20 世纪 70 年代儿童读物"}。

不要直接使用参考图像，请根据页面内容构思合适的场景和构图。

重要提示：内容应由一名 20 世纪 70 年代的儿童读物编辑进行解读，他会强行将参考图像与超自然现象或未来科学联系起来。

让页面看起来像是当时的一位成年人看到了这个角色，便将其认定为某种有意义的实体，并由此衍生出各种奇怪的理论、超逻辑或神秘学解读。

重点突出那些看似合理实则荒谬的逻辑跳跃。

每次生成的内容都应随机，展现编辑天马行空的妄想与断言。包含旨在激发儿童好奇心的断言性文字。

排版应采用 20 世纪 70 年代儿童读物的风格。包含旧纸张纹理、印刷错位、褪色、粗糙的插图、红蓝油墨、手绘箭头以及毫无意义的图表。

每次生成需包含：
- 不同的牵强解读
- 不同的页面布局
- 不同的断言
- 不同的奇怪理论
- 不同的拍摄角度

重要提示：优先体现“一本可能真实存在过的奇怪儿童读物”的感觉。不要追求正统的科幻感，而应优先展现一位神秘学编辑的热情，通过奇怪的理论、强行的关联和逻辑跳跃来呈现内容。
promptEn:
Using this character, draw {argument name="theme" default="a page from a 1970s-era children's book about the occult, future science, or paranormal phenomena"}.

Do not use the reference image as is; create a situation and composition that suits the content of the page.

Important: The content should be interpreted by a 1970s children's book editor who forcibly links the reference image to paranormal phenomena or future science.

Make the page look as if an adult at the time saw this character, assumed it was a meaningful entity, and developed strange theories, super-logic, or occult interpretations.

Focus on leaps of logic that seem plausible yet are nonsensical.

The content should be random each time, with the editor's delusions and assertions running wild. Include assertive text designed to provoke children's curiosity.

The layout should be in the style of a 1970s children's book. Include old paper textures, misaligned printing, fading, crude illustrations, red and blue ink, hand-drawn arrows, and nonsensical charts.

Each time:
- Different far-fetched interpretations
- Different page layouts
- Different assertions
- Different strange theories
- Different camera angles

Important: Prioritize the feeling of a 'strange children's book that might have actually existed.' Instead of orthodox sci-fi, prioritize the enthusiasm of an occult editor with strange theories, forced connections, and leaps of logic.

titleZh: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - 住宅中水回收系统示意图
titleEn: Infographic / Edu Visual - Residential Greywater Recycling Schematic
descriptionZh: 一份详细的住宅中水回收系统工程图提示词，展示了过滤器、水箱、水泵以及 Raspberry Pi 控制器等组件，并配有清晰的流量指示。
descriptionEn: A detailed engineering diagram prompt for a residential greywater recycling system, showing components like filters, tanks, pumps, and a Raspberry Pi controller with clear flow indicators.
promptZh: 创建一个用于冲厕的住宅 {argument name="system type" default="中水回收系统"} 的简洁技术系统图。在左侧展示 {argument name="sources" default="三个水源"}：厨房洗菜盆、浴室洗手盆和洗衣机。每个水源通过分流阀连接到原始下水道或中水回收管线。中水管线进入一个预过滤模块，该模块包含粗滤网、沉淀槽、可清洗滤芯以及用于厨房用水的隔油池。接着展示一个带有溢流管至下水道、高低水位传感器及检查盖的低位中水收集箱。从该水箱引出中水输送泵，将水向上输送至一个大型白色塑料储水箱。大水箱配有低、中、高水位传感器、溢流至下水道的出口、排水口、可选的紫外线消毒模块及通风装置。从储水箱引出水泵或重力出水口，为马桶水箱供水。包含一个带有空气隔断和防回流装置的备用清水供应系统，连接至马桶水箱。展示一个 {argument name="controller" default="Raspberry Pi 4 控制器"}，通过信号线连接至传感器、电磁阀、水泵、泄漏传感器和报警器。使用蓝色箭头表示水流，红色箭头表示溢流/紧急排水，黑色虚线表示电子控制。风格：现代工程示意图，白色背景，标注组件，箭头清晰，细节丰富且简洁。
promptEn: Create a clean technical system diagram of a residential {argument name="system type" default="greywater recycling system"} for toilet flushing. Show {argument name="sources" default="three water sources"} on the left: kitchen vegetable washing sink, bathroom wash basin, and washing machine. Each source connects through a diverter valve to either the original sewer drain or the greywater recycling line. The greywater line goes into a pre-filter module with coarse mesh filter, sediment trap, washable cartridge filter, and grease separator for kitchen water. Then show a low-level greywater collection tank with overflow pipe to sewer, high and low water level sensors, and inspection cover. From this tank, show a greywater transfer pump sending water upward into a large white plastic storage tank. The large tank has low, middle, and high water level sensors, overflow to sewer, drain outlet, optional UV disinfection module, and ventilation. From the storage tank, show a pump or gravity outlet feeding the toilet cistern. Include a backup clean water supply with air gap and backflow prevention to the toilet cistern. Show a {argument name="controller" default="Raspberry Pi 4 controller"} connected with signal lines to sensors, solenoid valves, pumps, leak sensor, and alarm. Use blue arrows for water flow, red arrows for overflow/emergency drain, dotted black lines for electronic control. Style: modern engineering schematic, white background, labeled components, clear arrows, minimal but detailed.
author: Ryder Shang

titleZh: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - 超高密度日式迷宫谜题
titleEn: Infographic / Edu Visual - Ultra-Dense Japanese Maze Puzzle
descriptionZh: 生成极具挑战性的黑白日式迷宫海报，适用于谜题竞赛、社交媒体挑战或可打印的益智游戏。
descriptionEn: Generates a challenging monochrome Japanese maze poster suitable for puzzle contests, social media challenges, or printable brain teasers.
promptZh: 创作一张正方形黑白谜题海报，风格为极其复杂的手绘笔记本迷宫，白纸上印有干净的单色墨线。在顶部中心位置，放置一个醒目的日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="この問題、あなたは正解できますか？"}，使用明朝体衬线字体。下方填充几乎整个页面，在细双线边框内绘制一个巨大的矩形迷宫，由数千条微小的正交走廊、微网格笔触、死胡同和紧凑的直角通道组成，宛如 2026 年升级版的中学原创迷宫。迷宫应极其密集且困难，除黑色线条外，无任何颜色或阴影。在密集区域内精确嵌入 15 个较大的迷宫图案：4 个同心方形螺旋目标、3 个圆形螺旋目标、2 个大型 X 形星爆迷宫结构、1 个高矩形菱形/人字形迷宫块、1 个中央嵌套方形金字塔状迷宫、1 个位于左下方的巨大非对称菱形螺旋迷宫、1 个位于下部中心附近的巨大对角交叉 X 形迷宫，以及 2 个水平梯形/网格迷宫块。添加贯穿迷宫的细长直线型分隔走廊以及对角线走廊切口，同时保持每个区域都布满看起来可解的微小路径。整体构图：清晰的扫描级谜题纸，居中，高对比度，无插图，无角色，无渐变，除迷宫线条外无背景纹理。
promptEn: Create a square black-and-white puzzle poster in the style of an extremely intricate hand-drawn notebook maze, clean monochrome ink on white paper. At the top center, place a bold Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="この問題、あなたは正解できますか？"} in a Mincho-style serif font. Below it, fill almost the entire page with one huge rectangular maze inside a thin double-line border, made from thousands of tiny orthogonal corridors, micro-grid strokes, dead ends, and tight right-angle passages, like a 2026 upgraded version of a middle-school original maze. The maze should be overwhelmingly dense and difficult, with no color and no shading except black linework. Include exactly 15 larger embedded maze motifs visible within the dense field: 4 concentric square spiral targets, 3 circular spiral targets, 2 large X-shaped starburst maze structures, 1 tall rectangular diamond/chevron maze block, 1 central nested-square pyramid-like maze, 1 large asymmetric diamond spiral maze in the lower-left center, 1 large diagonal crossing X near the lower center, and 2 horizontal ladder/grid maze blocks. Add faint long straight divider-like corridors running vertically and horizontally through the maze, plus diagonal corridor cuts, while keeping every area packed with tiny solvable-looking paths. Overall composition: crisp scan-like puzzle sheet, centered, high contrast, no illustrations, no characters, no gradients, no background texture beyond the maze lines.
author: k(k the Anything)

titleZh: 产品营销 - 3D 卡通运动海报
descriptionZh: 一款充满活力、色彩与动感的 3D 卡通运动角色竖版海报提示词。
descriptionEn: A high energy vertical poster prompt for a 3D cartoon athletic character with explosive color and motion.
promptZh: 一张充满动感与激情的 3D 卡通风格竖版社交媒体海报，主角是一位酷炫的 3D 卡通角色 —— {argument name="character description" default="一位扎着金色马尾辫的年轻运动女孩，身穿荧光黄运动夹克、白色紧身裤和厚底白色运动鞋"}，她处于腾空状态，摆出强有力的跳跃姿势，一只拳头向上挥向天空，表情坚毅，夸张的风格化双眼中充满斗志；周围环绕着 {argument name="surrounding elements" default="由鲜艳色彩组成的巨型 3D 充气物体爆炸效果 —— 电光黄色的超大闪电形状、亮粉色与钴蓝色的光泽球体、漂浮的星爆和速度线"}，从她身体向外辐射，营造出爆发性的运动感；背景采用从顶部的深紫色到底部的活力珊瑚橙的渐变设计，{argument name="main typography" default="顶部采用粗体、超重、压缩的白色字体，写着 \"NO LIMITS\""}，字母巨大且带有微妙的荧光黄投影，下方配有简洁有力的副标题 "Push harder · Go further · Never stop"，构图中散布着细小的装饰性火花和火焰符号，高端运动品牌 3D 插画质感，9:16 竖屏比例
promptEn: A high-energy vertical social media poster bursting with motion and excitement, a cool 3D cartoon character — {argument name="character description" default="a young athletic girl with a blonde ponytail wearing a neon yellow sports jacket white leggings and chunky white sneakers"}, captured mid-air in a powerful jumping pose with one fist punching upward toward the sky, her expression fierce and determined with oversized stylized eyes full of fire, surrounding her an {argument name="surrounding elements" default="explosion of giant 3D inflatable objects in vivid colors — oversized lightning bolt shapes in electric yellow, large glossy spheres in hot pink and cobalt blue, floating star bursts and speed lines"} radiating outward from her body suggesting explosive movement, the background a bold gradient from deep purple at the top to vibrant coral orange at the bottom, {argument name="main typography" default="bold ultra-heavy condensed white typography at the top reading \"NO LIMITS\""} in massive letters with a subtle neon yellow drop shadow, smaller punchy subtitle below "Push harder · Go further · Never stop", tiny decorative spark and flame symbols scattered across the composition, premium sports brand 3D illustration quality, 9:16 vertical ratio
author: Easy A.I.

titleZh: 产品营销 - 电影感消散时尚大片
descriptionZh: 一个高度详细的提示词，用于创作一张高定时尚肖像，主体在荒凉的背景下消散成烟雾与微粒。
descriptionEn: A highly detailed prompt for a high fashion portrait where the subject is dissolving into smoke and particles against a desolate background.
promptZh:
创作一张超写实、电影级 8K 图像，具备高对比度的戏剧性光影和照片级数字绘画美学——请务必精准使用人脸参考。

画面中的年轻女性呈全身侧影，面向右侧，展现出缓慢而优雅的行走姿态，散发着强大的时尚杂志气场。面部需完美复刻，仅做轻微的精致造型处理，柔软的波浪卷发随风自然飘动，且不对其身份特征进行大幅改动。她身着 {argument name="outfit description" default="一套奢华修身的午夜蓝宝石色女性裤装，搭配剪裁利落的长款西装外套、结构感十足的垫肩、时髦的高腰微喇长裤，以及黑色缎面内搭紧身胸衣"}，呈现出现代电影级的奢华质感。她的姿态流露出深沉的情感与自信，面部表情平静而忧伤，双眼微微下垂，一只手轻盈前伸，另一只手自然垂在身侧。

她近半个身体正在消散成极其浓郁、云雾般的灰色烟雾，其中夹杂着发光的黄色尘埃微粒。她的左臂、肩膀、躯干、双腿以及部分头发随着化作发光微粒而变得透明，呈现出正在消散的动态感。

在她身后并部分环绕着她的，是一个巨大的、类似日食的发光圆环，散发着炽热的金白色等离子光芒。该物体作为强有力的轮廓光和背光，戏剧性地照亮了烟雾、尘埃和人物剪影。

场景设定极简且具有电影感：阴云密布的天空下，一片荒凉的混凝土表面。{argument name="color palette" default="色调以单色灰、深蓝和白色为主，与强烈的琥珀金色光芒形成对比"}。浅景深、光晕/柔光效果、微粒散射、电影级构图、情感氛围、超精细纹理，以及极具冲击力的奢华时尚感。
promptEn:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K image with high-contrast dramatic lighting and a photo-real digital painting aesthetic — use face reference exactly.

The young woman is shown in a full-body side profile facing right, performing a slow graceful walking pose with a powerful fashion-editorial presence, her face copied perfectly with slight glamorous styling, soft wavy hair flowing naturally in the wind, and no major alterations to identity. She wears a {argument name="outfit description" default="luxurious fitted midnight sapphire women’s pantsuit with a sharply tailored long blazer, bold structured shoulders, sleek high-waisted flared trousers, and a black satin inner corset-style top"} for a modern cinematic luxury look. Her posture reflects deep emotion and confidence, with a calm sorrowful facial expression, eyes looking slightly downward, one hand gently moving forward while the other hangs naturally by her side.

Nearly half of her body is dissolving into extremely thick, cloud-like grey smoke filled with glowing yellow dust particles. Her left arm, shoulder, torso, legs, and part of her hair become transparent as they break into luminous particles, suggesting active disintegration.

Behind and partially surrounding her is a massive glowing eclipse-like ring, emitting fiery golden-white plasma light. This object acts as a powerful rim and backlight, dramatically illuminating the smoke, dust, and silhouette.

The setting is minimal and cinematic: a desolate concrete surface beneath a heavily overcast sky. The {argument name="color palette" default="color palette is dominated by monochrome greys, deep blues, and whites, contrasted with intense amber-gold glow"}. Shallow depth of field, glow/bloom lighting, particle dispersion, cinematic composition, emotional atmosphere, ultra-detailed textures, and dramatic luxury fashion energy.
author: Zyro

titleZh: 产品营销 - 电影级 VTX 汽车品牌海报
titleEn: Product Marketing - Cinematic VTX Car Brand Poster
descriptionZh: 一张照片级写实的豪华汽车广告海报，包含经典跑车、身着西装的精英人士、巨大的发光品牌字母以及反光摄影棚灯光效果。
descriptionEn: A photorealistic luxury automotive advertising poster with a classic sports coupe, suited executive, giant illuminated brand letters, and reflective studio lighting.
promptZh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="VTX"} Broadcast Systems 创作一张电影级的竖版豪华汽车品牌海报。画面展示一辆经典的 1970 年代日系银灰色溜背式跑车，完美侧面视角，低趴姿态，黑色多辐轮毂，细微的橙色刹车卡钳细节，车身漆面光泽反射，车门上有小巧的 VTX 贴纸。一名身着深海军蓝定制西装、脚穿黑色皮鞋的男士靠在车身侧后方，双手插兜，姿态自信从容，面部经过柔和的模糊处理。背景中矗立着巨大的金属金色字母“VTX”，从后方发出温暖的光芒，高耸于车身之上。采用暗色摄影棚环境，背景为黑至深蓝色，配以温暖的琥珀色轮廓光，营造出情绪化的高对比度商业摄影质感，地面为光亮潮湿的反射材质，清晰映衬出汽车、人物和巨大字母的倒影。画面中需包含五个明确的文字元素：左上角的小型 Logo 文字“VTX”、左上角的小型副标题“VTX BROADCAST SYSTEMS”、背景中的巨大字母“VTX”、车门上的小型贴纸“VTX”，以及底部居中的标语“{argument name="slogan text" default="BROADCAST THE MOMENT"}”（采用宽间距的琥珀色大写字母）。构图应体现高端、阳刚、戏剧化的品牌质感，且具备品牌宣传所需的对称性；汽车位于画面中下部，人物位于中心偏右，巨大字母填满背景。照片级写实，画质锐利，编辑类广告风格，2:3 竖构图比例。
promptEn: Create a cinematic vertical luxury automotive brand poster for {argument name="brand name" default="VTX"} Broadcast Systems. The scene shows one classic silver-gray 1970s Japanese fastback sports coupe in perfect side profile, low stance, black multi-spoke wheels, subtle orange brake detail, polished body reflections, and a small VTX decal on the door. One well-dressed man in a dark navy tailored suit and black shoes leans casually against the car near the rear quarter panel, hands in pockets, confident executive pose, face softly anonymized/blurred. Behind them are enormous freestanding metallic gold letters spelling “VTX,” glowing warmly from behind and towering over the car. Use a dark studio environment with a black-to-deep-blue background, warm amber rim lighting, moody high-contrast commercial photography, glossy wet reflective floor with clear reflections of the car, man, and giant letters. Include exactly five visible text elements: the small top-left logo text “VTX,” the small top-left subtitle “VTX BROADCAST SYSTEMS,” the huge background letters “VTX,” the small door decal “VTX,” and the bottom centered slogan “{argument name="slogan text" default="BROADCAST THE MOMENT"}” in widely spaced amber capitals. Composition should be premium, masculine, dramatic, symmetrical enough for a brand campaign, with the car occupying the lower middle, the man right of center, and the giant letters filling the background. Photorealistic, sharp, editorial advertising style, 2:3 vertical aspect ratio.
author: RobertZalvador

titleZh: 产品营销 - Cold Authority AI 海报
titleEn: Product Marketing - Cold Authority AI Poster

titleZh: 产品营销 - 水晶王座商务人士肖像
titleEn: Product Marketing - Crystal Throne Businessman Portrait
descriptionZh: 生成一张电影质感的奢华肖像，描绘一位身着西装的高管坐在黑暗顶层公寓的水晶切面王座上，非常适合用于展现高端权力、财富和企业幻想的视觉效果。
descriptionEn: Generates a cinematic luxury portrait of a suited executive seated on a faceted crystal throne in a dark penthouse, ideal for high end power, wealth, and corporate fantasy visuals.
promptZh: 创作一张奢华的电影质感竖版肖像，场景设定在夜晚的黑暗顶层公寓：{argument name="main subject" default="一位强大的商务人士"} 居中坐在由锋利的水晶切面和镜面玻璃构成的巨大王座上，如同一个巨大的棱角分明的钻石王冠在他身后升起。他身穿剪裁合身的 {argument name="suit color" default="炭黑色"} 西装，搭配挺括的白色衬衫、深酒红色领带、同色系口袋巾、黑色抛光皮鞋和腕表，双腿交叠，双臂自信地搁在王座扶手上。画面中需呈现 5 位人物：前景中 1 位居中就座的商务人士，以及 4 位位于王座后方及周围、面部模糊且光影较暗的男性身影，其中两位位于左右高处，两位位于肩部附近，营造出精英议会或多重曝光的权力光环。人物面部应刻意保持无特征或模糊处理，重点在于姿态、服饰、倒影和氛围。王座由无数透明三角形水晶碎片、镀铬边缘、棱镜反射、闪烁的高光和锋利的几何切面构成。场景置于拥有落地窗的高层行政酒廊，配有黑色窗帘、倒映着座椅和鞋子的黑色亮面大理石地板，窗外是遥远的城市摩天大楼灯光，远端两侧有暖色台灯。采用戏剧性的头顶聚光灯、深邃的阴影、冷色调金属质感、奢华黑色电影氛围、超写实纹理、超精细玻璃折射、电影级对比度、浅景深、对称构图、2:3 竖版画幅，呈现高端编辑摄影风格。增添一种微妙的支配感、财富感、神秘感和现代企业权力感；画面中不得出现可辨识的文字或标志。
promptEn: Create a luxury cinematic vertical portrait in a dark penthouse at night: {argument name="main subject" default="a powerful businessman"} sits centered on an enormous throne made of sharp, faceted crystal and mirrored glass, like an angular diamond crown rising high behind him. He wears a tailored {argument name="suit color" default="charcoal black"} suit, crisp white dress shirt, deep burgundy tie, matching pocket square, black polished leather shoes, and a wristwatch, posed with legs crossed and both arms resting confidently on the throne arms. Show exactly 5 human figures: 1 central seated businessman in the foreground and 4 darker, partially obscured male figures positioned behind and around the throne, two high at left and right and two lower near the shoulders, creating an elite council or multi-exposure power aura. The faces should be intentionally featureless or blurred, with the focus on posture, clothing, reflections, and atmosphere. The throne is constructed from countless transparent triangular crystal shards, chrome edges, prism reflections, glittering highlights, and razor-like geometric facets. Place the scene in a high-rise executive lounge with floor-to-ceiling windows, black curtains, a glossy black marble floor reflecting the chair and shoes, distant city skyscraper lights outside, and warm table lamps at the far sides. Use dramatic overhead spotlighting, deep shadows, cool metallic tones, luxury noir mood, hyper-realistic textures, ultra-detailed glass refractions, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field, symmetrical composition, vertical 2:3 framing, premium editorial photography style. Add a subtle sense of dominance, wealth, secrecy, and modern corporate power; no readable text, no logos.
author: Ai Duniya

titleZh: 产品营销 - 高端时尚杂志编辑风格
titleEn: Product Marketing - Premium Editorial Fashion Magazine
descriptionZh: 一个用于生成专业时尚杂志封面的高端提示词，包含详细的服装描述、影棚灯光和排版设计。
descriptionEn: A high end prompt for generating a professional fashion magazine cover with detailed outfit descriptions, studio lighting, and graphic typography.
promptZh:
人物身体微微摆动，一只脚向前迈出，右手随意插在裤兜里，左手自然垂在身侧。表情冷静、严肃，具有时尚大片的质感。他戴着窄框黑色墨镜，深色头发略显凌乱，颈间佩戴着精致的叠层银色项链。

服装
超大款 {argument name="jacket color" default="深炭灰 / 黑色"} 工装夹克，敞开穿着
干净的白色圆领卫衣，左胸处带有 {argument name="logo style" default="小型方形经典款 logo 贴标"}
宽松的深炭灰色阔腿褶皱长裤，具有自然的垂坠感和褶皱
厚底抛光黑色皮鞋
整体造型应体现极简、实用、高端和街头奢华感

场景与灯光
将主体置于深灰色影棚环境中，背景为平滑的无缝背景布，地面略带反光。使用来自左前方的柔和定向影棚灯光，在地面上投射出真实的阴影，并增加服装的层次感。画面应呈现柔和的单色调，对比度清晰，肤色自然，具备高端时尚广告大片的品质。

构图
全身取景，主体垂直居中
略微仰视的正面编辑视角
主体与背景文字自然重叠
顶部和两侧留有干净的负空间，以便排版文字
具备高端杂志封面的平衡感与层级感

排版与图形布局
将图像设计为醒目的时尚杂志海报封面：
最上方为超大号粗体白色文字：“WIP”
右上角为小型紧凑型白色文字：“HOMME”
主体后方为横跨整个宽度的巨大深色半透明文字：“{argument name="brand name" default="CARHARTT"}”
中右侧为大号粗体白色数字：“01”
左下角为四个小型编辑文本块，带有粗体标题和简短副标题，布局如同杂志封面摘要
右下角为超大号紧凑型白色标题：“FASHION”

视觉风格
超写实时尚编辑摄影，奢华街头服饰广告，杂志封面平面设计，清晰的织物细节，自然的服装褶皱，锐利的排版融合，专业影棚阴影，高端工装美学，干净的商业修图，高对比度，精致且现代。
promptEn:
His body is slightly in motion, one foot stepping forward, right hand casually inside the trouser pocket, left hand relaxed beside the body. His expression is calm, serious, and fashion-editorial. He wears narrow black sunglasses, slightly tousled dark hair, and a subtle layered silver chain necklace.
Outfit
Oversized {argument name="jacket color" default="dark charcoal / black"} workwear jacket, worn open
Clean white crewneck sweatshirt with a {argument name="logo style" default="small square heritage-style logo patch"} on the left chest
Loose dark charcoal wide-leg pleated trousers with natural drape and folds
Chunky polished black leather shoes
Overall styling should feel minimal, utilitarian, premium, and street-luxury
Scene & Lighting
Set the subject in a dark grey studio environment with a smooth seamless backdrop and slightly reflective floor. Use soft directional studio lighting from the front-left, creating realistic shadows on the floor and adding depth to the clothing. The image should have a muted monochrome palette with crisp contrast, clean skin tones, and high-end fashion campaign quality.

Composition
Full-body framing, subject vertically centered
Slightly low, straight-on editorial camera angle
Subject overlaps the background typography naturally
Clean negative space around the upper and side areas for text
Premium magazine-cover balance and hierarchy
Typography & Graphic Layout
Design the image like a bold fashion magazine poster cover:
At the very top, oversized bold white text: “WIP”
Small condensed white text at the top-right: “HOMME”
Behind the subject, huge dark semi-transparent text spanning the width: “{argument name="brand name" default="CARHARTT"}”
On the right-middle side, large bold white number: “01”
On the lower-left side, four small editorial text blocks with bold headings and short subtext, laid out like magazine cover blurbs
Bottom-right corner, very large condensed white headline: “FASHION”

Visual Style
Ultra-realistic fashion editorial photography, luxury streetwear campaign, magazine-cover graphic design, crisp fabric details, natural garment folds, sharp typography integration, professional studio shadows, premium workwear aesthetic, clean commercial retouching, high contrast, sophisticated and modern.

promptZh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础图像，保持相同的构图、拍摄角度、美甲设计、米色软毛道具、温暖的室内背景以及整体舒适的灯光。仅对双手进行修图，使其看起来像真实拍摄的手部，而非过度平滑的 AI 生成手部：还原 {argument name="skin realism level" default="自然的手部纹理和肤色"}，增加细腻的皮肤毛孔、细微的皱纹、指尖纹路、指关节褶皱、真实的肤色过渡以及更清晰的甲床边缘。精准保留 6 枚可见美甲的样式和位置：左侧拇指甲、食指甲、中指甲、无名指甲、小指甲以及下方前景处的拇指甲。在保持图像美观、整洁且逼真的前提下，减少塑料感的平滑度和模糊感。
promptEn: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base image, keep the same composition, camera angle, manicure design, soft beige furry prop, warm indoor background, and overall cozy lighting. Retouch only the hand to make it look like a real photographed hand instead of an over-smoothed AI hand: restore {argument name="skin realism level" default="natural hand texture and color"}, add fine skin pores, subtle wrinkles, fingertip lines, knuckle creases, believable skin-tone transitions, and clearer nail-bed edges. Preserve the 6 visible manicured nails exactly in style and placement: left-side thumb nail, index nail, middle nail, ring nail, pinky nail, and lower foreground thumb nail. Reduce plastic smoothness and blur while keeping the image flattering, clean, and realistic.

整体风格为春夏窗边、森林灵感、法式轻复古少女闺房摄影。氛围清新、柔和、宁静且空灵，带有一丝慵懒、羞涩、放松、沉思感，仿佛被自然光温柔包裹。画面应呈现出摄影师在春夏午后的真实卧室中，用相机捕捉到的抓拍瞬间。

[图像质量与光影重点]
请优先还原真实相机拍摄的柔和、朦胧、带有光晕的质感，而非标准的清晰 AI 人像。

[妆容]
妆容应为“{argument name="makeup" default="非常清透的裸妆，接近素颜感"}”。底妆应轻薄自然，保留真实的皮肤纹理和自然阴影。

[服装]
服装应为“{argument name="clothing" default="白色、米白色或米色法式轻闺房服饰"}”，例如蕾丝睡裙、透视吊带裙、露肩薄纱上衣或柔软的层叠短裙。材质应侧重于蕾丝、薄纱、细棉布和柔软的褶皱。
promptEn:
Please generate a single high-end portrait in a 3:4 vertical composition based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, with the theme "{argument name="theme" default="Spring/Summer window-side forest-style French light boudoir portrait"}".

[Character Consistency]
Please strictly preserve the user's authentic physical characteristics, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, hairstyle foundation, and overall temperament. The result must clearly look like the same real girl, not a stranger, not Westernized, not influencer-style, without excessive skin smoothing or an artificial AI face.

[Core Style]
The overall style is a spring/summer window-side, forest-inspired, French light-retro girl's boudoir photoshoot. The vibe is fresh, soft, quiet, and ethereal, with a hint of laziness, shyness, relaxation, pensiveness, and a sense of being gently wrapped in natural light. The image should look like a candid moment captured by a photographer with a camera in a real bedroom on a spring or early summer afternoon.

[Image Quality & Lighting Focus]
Please prioritize replicating the soft, hazy, glowing texture of a real camera rather than a standard clear AI portrait.

[Makeup]
The makeup should be {argument name="makeup" default="very light and transparent nude makeup, close to a no-makeup look"}. The base should be sheer and natural, preserving some real skin texture and natural shadows.

[Clothing]
The clothing should be {argument name="clothing" default="white, off-white, or beige French-style light boudoir attire"}, such as lace nightgowns, sheer slip dresses, off-shoulder tulle tops, or soft layered short skirts. Materials should focus on lace, gauze, thin cotton, and soft pleats.

titleZh: 个人资料 / 头像 - 华丽的蓝色肚皮舞者插画
titleEn: Profile / Avatar - Ornate Blue Belly Dancer Illustration
descriptionZh: 生成一张细节丰富的动漫奇幻风格肚皮舞者特写，配有绿松石色面纱、银饰，且面部中央区域经过刻意遮挡。
descriptionEn: Generates a detailed anime fantasy belly dancer close up with turquoise veils, silver jewelry, and an intentionally obscured central face area.
promptZh: 创作一张高度精细的竖版动漫风格插画，主角是一位迷人的 {argument name="character description" default="年轻女性肚皮舞者"}，身着华丽的冷色调服装。画面采用从大腿上部到头部的戏剧性特写构图，面部及上半身中央区域被一个巨大的不透明灰色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。色调以深海军蓝、青色、水绿色、银色和浅冰蓝色为主。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="灰棕色"} 飘逸卷发，发丝柔和地垂落在右侧，装饰着精致的银链、细小的蓝色花朵吊坠、悬垂的珠子和珠宝头饰。她的服装是精致的 {argument name="costume style" default="奇幻肚皮舞服"}：深海军蓝紧身胸衣，肩部和手臂缠绕着透明的绿松石色面纱，层叠的半透明荷叶边，白色蕾丝饰边，以及覆盖着银色花丝、珍珠、椭圆形金属硬币、蓝色宝石、花卉图案和几何菱形镶板的华丽袖套。左上方饰有一朵巨大的浅蓝色布艺花朵，中心镶嵌着圆形银质奖章，配以飘逸的薄纱围巾、散落的硬币装饰、面纱上细小的粉色三角形点缀，底部为深色的飘逸裙摆。她的手出现在画面下方中央，手指纤细，指甲呈浅色。采用优雅的高细节数字绘画风格，具有平滑的阴影、清晰的线条、光泽的珠宝高光、华丽的纺织品纹理、奇幻插画的质感、柔和的灯光以及精致奢华的氛围。构图应显得亲密且具有装饰性，密集的装饰细节填满画面，背景无任何文字。
promptEn: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style illustration of a glamorous {argument name="character description" default="young female belly dancer"} in an ornate cool-toned costume, shown in a dramatic close-up cropped composition from upper thighs to head area, with the face and central upper body intentionally covered by a large opaque gray rectangular censor block. The palette is dominated by deep navy, teal, aqua, silver, and pale icy blue. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="ash brown"} hair with soft curls spilling across the right side, decorated with delicate silver chains, tiny blue flower charms, dangling beads, and jeweled head ornaments. Her outfit is an intricate {argument name="costume style" default="fantasy belly dancer costume"}: a dark navy fitted bodice, sheer turquoise veils wrapping around the shoulders and arms, layered translucent ruffles, white lace trim, and a richly decorated arm sleeve covered in silver filigree, pearls, oval metal coins, blue gemstones, floral motifs, and geometric diamond panels. Include a large pale blue fabric flower with a round silver medallion center on the upper left, flowing gauzy scarves, scattered coin ornaments, small pink triangular accents on the veil, and a dark flowing skirt at the bottom. Her hand appears near the lower center with delicate fingers and pale nails. Use an elegant high-detail digital painting style with smooth shading, crisp linework, glossy jewel highlights, ornate textile patterns, fantasy illustration polish, soft lighting, and a refined luxurious mood. The composition should feel intimate and decorative, with dense ornamental detail filling the frame and no background text.

promptZh:
创作一张 9:16 竖屏格式的超逼真图像。画面中展示一位年轻女孩，外貌为 {argument name="face description" default="你的面部或外貌描述"}，佩戴 {argument name="type of sunglasses, if applicable" default="（如适用，请填写墨镜类型）"}。她以放松的姿态坐在一个色彩鲜艳的 {argument name="social network" default="Instagram"} 大型 3D Logo 上。身着现代都市风格服装：

带有“{liam wedding videos}”Logo 的 {argument name="sweatpants colour" default="彩色连帽衫"}，搭配 {argument name="pants colour" default="慢跑裤"} 和 {argument name="shoe colour" default="运动鞋"}。

背景中呈现一张与真实页面完全一致的 {argument name="social network" default="社交网络"} 大型个人资料卡，细节逼真：名称“{argument name="account name" default="Fatima Batool"}”；用户名为“@[Fati_092]”，拥有 {argument name="15000" default="15000"} 位关注者，{argument name="number of following" default="关注人数"} 个正在关注，以及 {argument name="Other data" default="其他数据"}。

In the background, a large profile card of [social network] identical to a real profile appears, with realistic details: name '{argument name="account name" default="Fatima Batool"}'; user '@[Fati_092], [15000]

Followers, [number of following] following and

titleZh: 个人资料 / 头像 - 写实风格休闲镜面自拍
titleEn: Profile / Avatar - Realistic Casual Mirror Selfie
descriptionZh: 在极简主义米色卧室中生成一张自然感十足的时尚镜面自拍，适用于生活方式或穿搭灵感展示。
descriptionEn: Generates a natural looking fashion mirror selfie in a minimalist beige bedroom for lifestyle or outfit inspiration visuals.
promptZh: 生成一张高度写实的休闲镜面自拍，画面主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚女性"} 站在极简风格的米色卧室中，使用智能手机进行竖屏拍摄。她留着深棕色长卷发，身材苗条，为了保护隐私，面部被柔和的方形模糊处理遮挡。她身穿 {argument name="top" default="带有蕾丝边和蝴蝶结装饰的白色罗纹吊带背心"}，外搭一件 {argument name="cardigan" default="滑落至单肩的米色粗棒针织开衫"}，下身穿着 {argument name="bottoms" default="浅蓝色高腰毛边牛仔短裤"}。她的姿态随性且时髦，单肩微露，一只手抬起靠近面部，毛衣袖口遮住部分手掌，呈现出自然社交媒体穿搭照的效果，而非影棚人像。房间采用温暖的中性光线，身后摆放着米色沙发，墙面为素雅的米白色，贴有几张小型照片，边缘可见窄边框黑色全身镜，右侧设有一张玻璃边几，地面铺着柔软的米色地毯。要求比例真实，皮肤质感自然，呈现柔和的室内日光、低饱和度色调，具备日常智能手机拍摄的浅景深效果，并体现地道的非 AI 感日系生活美学。
promptEn: Create a highly realistic casual mirror selfie of a {argument name="subject" default="young East Asian woman"} standing in a minimalist beige bedroom, photographed vertically on a smartphone. She has long dark brown slightly wavy hair and a slim figure, with her face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur for privacy. She is wearing a {argument name="top" default="white ribbed camisole with lace trim and a small bow"}, an oversized {argument name="cardigan" default="cream chunky knit cardigan slipping off one shoulder"}, and {argument name="bottoms" default="light blue high-waisted denim shorts with frayed hems"}. Her pose is relaxed and fashionable, one shoulder exposed, one hand raised near her face with the sweater sleeve covering part of her hand, looking like a natural social media outfit photo rather than a studio portrait. The room has warm neutral lighting, a cream sofa behind her, plain off-white walls, a few small photo prints taped to the wall, a narrow black-framed full-length mirror visible at the edges, a glass side table on the right, and a soft beige rug. Use realistic proportions, natural skin texture, soft indoor daylight, muted tones, shallow everyday smartphone quality, and an authentic non-AI Japanese lifestyle aesthetic.

titleZh: 个人资料 / 头像 - 温馨公寓里的肥皂泡精灵
titleEn: Profile / Avatar - Soap Bubble Elf in Cozy Apartment
descriptionZh: 生成一张梦幻般的动漫插图，描绘了一个虹彩肥皂泡精灵在温暖的日式客厅里拿着手机放松的场景。
descriptionEn: Generates a dreamy anime illustration of an iridescent soap bubble elf relaxing with a phone in a warm Japanese living room.
promptZh: 创作一张柔和且高度细腻的动漫风格插图，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着闪亮银薰衣草色长发、长着尖耳朵的年轻肥皂泡精灵女性"} 侧卧在温馨日式公寓客厅的米色沙发上。她赤着脚，膝盖弯曲，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件宽松的露肩白衬衫和浅蓝色抽绳短裤"}，一只手拿着银色智能手机并低头看着它，一个平坦的不透明灰褐色方块刻意遮住了她的脸。她裸露的皮肤和头发覆盖着一层光亮的透明肥皂膜，身体各处（尤其是肩膀、手臂、腿部、胸部和飘逸的头发上）带有像薄薄气泡拉伸开来的彩虹色高光。在她周围环绕着 18 个大小不一的漂浮肥皂泡，包括左上方的一个大泡泡、右下角前景的一个大型局部泡泡、底部中心前景的一个大泡泡、她头发周围和房间里的几个小泡泡，以及图像边缘的几个局部泡泡；每个泡泡都应具有棱镜般的反射效果。场景设定为 {argument name="location mood" default="日本定山溪一个温暖的午后居家客厅"}，低矮的圆桌上放着一个白色马克杯和一份折叠的报纸或杂志，墙边有一个取暖器，透过敞开的门可以看到一个小厨房，配有木质装饰、墙上挂画、盆栽植物、浅色窗帘、背景中的餐桌，以及前景地板上堆放的带有细微日文文字的旅游杂志或书籍。采用来自右侧的柔和阳光、柔和的米色和灰色调、写实的房间透视、精致的绘画渲染、发光的虹彩效果、梦幻的氛围、浅景深，以及精致的 GPT-image-2 动漫艺术质感。
promptEn: Create a soft, highly detailed anime-style illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a young soap-bubble elf woman with long shimmering silver-lavender hair and pointed ears"} lounging sideways on a beige sofa in a cozy Japanese apartment living room. She is barefoot with her knees bent, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a loose off-shoulder white shirt and pale blue drawstring shorts"}, holding a silver smartphone in one hand and looking down at it, while a flat opaque taupe square deliberately obscures her face. Her exposed skin and hair are covered in a glossy transparent soap-film sheen, with rainbow iridescent highlights like thin bubbles stretched over her body, especially across her shoulders, arms, legs, chest, and flowing hair. Surround her with exactly 18 floating soap bubbles of different sizes, including one large bubble near the upper left, one large partial bubble in the lower right foreground, one large bubble near the bottom center foreground, several small bubbles around her hair and the room, and a few partial bubbles at the image edges; every bubble should have prismatic reflections. The setting is {argument name="location mood" default="a warm late-afternoon domestic living room in Jozankei, Japan"}, with a low round table holding a white mug and a folded newspaper or magazine, a floor heater against the wall, a small kitchen visible through an open doorway, wooden trim, framed wall art, potted plants, pale curtains, a dining table in the background, and travel magazines or books stacked on the floor in the foreground with subtle Japanese text. Use gentle sunlight from the right, muted beige and gray tones, realistic room perspective, delicate painterly rendering, luminous iridescence, dreamy atmosphere, shallow depth of field, and a polished GPT-image-2 anime art finish.

Place {argument name="face covering" default="a plain peach-colored rectangular block over the center of her face, obscuring all facial features"}. Use a clean modern Japanese anime style with expressive sketchy navy and cyan linework, warm peach and cream shading, bright sunlight, airy highlights on the hair, minimal background detail, crisp high-contrast colors, and a cheerful summer atmosphere.

titleZh: 个人资料 / 头像 - Sunlit Anime Café Reader
titleEn: Profile / Avatar - Sunlit Anime Café Reader
descriptionZh: 生成一张浪漫的动漫风格插画，描绘一位优雅的长发女孩在光影斑驳的咖啡馆中阅读，适用于角色设计或氛围感视觉概念。

promptZh: 创作一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘一位优雅且色调冷峻的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="未命名女主角"}，她坐在温暖阳光照射的咖啡馆或温室里的木桌旁，正在阅读一本精致的深蓝色精装书。她拥有一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"} 长发，带有亮泽的紫色高光，发丝自然垂落，一侧别着一枚带有深色丝带的装饰性花朵宝石发卡。她的面部被一个位于中心的正方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡块呈现柔和的紫到玫瑰色渐变，在遮住五官的同时保留了头发、下巴区域、手部和服装的可见度。她穿着精致的维多利亚风格衬衫和裙装：带有精致蕾丝花边的白色荷叶边高领衬衫、泡泡袖和金色袖扣，一件深海军蓝色的修身马甲或围裙，领口系着蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，并佩戴一枚椭圆形的蓝宝石胸针。她的姿态安静而优雅，一只手拿着打开的书，另一只手若有所思地放在唇边。场景温馨明亮，右侧有高大的木质窗框，金色的午后阳光倾泻而入，空气中漂浮着闪烁的尘埃，带有柔和的镜头光晕，窗外是模糊的花园景观。桌上清晰可见四件静物：她手中打开的装饰书、一杯盛有茶水的花卉茶杯、一叠两本的书（上面是红色的书，下面是深蓝色的书），以及一个插满淡紫色绣球花状花朵的透明玻璃花瓶。背景中包含柔和模糊的架子、咖啡馆用品和温暖的吊灯。采用高水准的日本动漫艺术风格，细腻的线条，油画般的灯光，复杂的布料褶皱，头发上的明亮高光，浅景深，浪漫氛围，温暖的金色与薰衣草色调，电影级构图，16:9 横向画幅，超高细节，无可见文字，无水印。
promptEn: Create a richly detailed anime-style illustration of an elegant cool-toned young woman, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed heroine"}, seated at a wooden table in a warm sunlit café or conservatory, reading an ornate dark blue hardcover book. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep violet-black"} hair with glossy purple highlights, loose strands, and a decorative floral jeweled hairpin with a dark ribbon near one side. Her face is intentionally obscured by a centered square privacy block with a soft muted purple-to-rose gradient, covering the facial features while leaving the hair, chin area, hand, and outfit visible. She wears a refined Victorian-inspired blouse and dress: a white ruffled high-collar blouse with delicate lace trim, puffed sleeves and gold cuff buttons, a dark navy fitted vest or pinafore, a blue ribbon bow at the collar, and an oval sapphire-like brooch. Her posture is quiet and graceful, one hand holding the open book and the other resting thoughtfully near her lips. The setting is cozy and luminous, with tall wooden window frames on the right, golden afternoon sunlight streaming through, sparkling dust motes, soft lens flare, and blurred flowering garden scenery outside. On the table are exactly four visible still-life objects: one open ornate book in her hands, one floral teacup on a saucer filled with tea, one stack of two closed books with a red book on top and a dark blue book beneath, and one clear glass vase full of pastel hydrangea-like flowers. In the background, include softly blurred shelves, café items, and warm hanging lights. Use highly polished Japanese anime art, delicate linework, painterly lighting, intricate fabric folds, luminous highlights in the hair, shallow depth of field, romantic atmosphere, warm gold and lavender color palette, cinematic composition, 16:9 landscape framing, ultra-detailed, no visible text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张极具视觉冲击力的动漫演唱会插画，描绘一位 {argument name="character type" default="酷炫女性偶像歌手"} 在黑暗的未来感舞台上表演的场景，采用戏剧性的低角度特写和动态透视。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长黑发，带有紫蓝色挑染"}、深邃的紫色眼眸、苍白的皮肤，唱歌时神情自信而冷酷，手持黑色麦克风。她的右手向观众方向伸展，手指张开，营造出强烈的深度感与活力。为她穿上一套光泽感的黑蓝配色哥特摇滚偶像装束：黑色露脐上衣、短款层叠不对称裙、铆钉腰带、大腿绑带、透明袖子、金属链条、星形装饰、水晶配饰、垂坠耳环以及尖锐的珠宝发饰。周围环绕着耀眼的蓝紫色舞台灯光、激光束、反光的钻石碎片、漂浮的水晶残片、闪烁的粒子以及背景中巨大的多面 LED 屏幕。采用饱和的电光蓝、靛蓝、黑色和银色调，配合强烈的轮廓光、闪耀的高光、镜头光晕、发丝与衣物的动态感、精致的珠宝细节，以及细腻的现代动漫艺术风格。构图应呈现出爆炸性的现场表演瞬间，兼具魅力、锐利、酷炫与电影质感，并具备高对比度与清澈明亮的反射效果。
promptEn: Create a high-impact anime concert illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cool female idol singer"} performing on a dark futuristic stage, shown from a dramatic low-angle close-up with dynamic foreshortening. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing black hair with violet-blue highlights"}, intense purple eyes, pale skin, and a confident cool expression as she sings into a black handheld microphone. Her right hand reaches toward the viewer with spread fingers, creating strong depth and energy. Dress her in a glossy black and sapphire-blue gothic rock idol outfit: cropped black top, short layered asymmetrical skirt, studded belt, thigh straps, sheer sleeves, metallic chains, star-shaped ornaments, crystal accessories, dangling earrings, and sharp jeweled hairpieces. Surround her with dazzling blue-violet stage lighting, laser beams, reflective diamond shards, floating crystal fragments, glittering particles, and large faceted LED panels in the background. Use a saturated electric blue, indigo, black, and silver palette with strong rim lighting, sparkling highlights, lens flares, motion in the hair and fabric, intricate jewelry detail, and a polished ultra-detailed modern anime art style. The composition should feel like an explosive live performance moment, glamorous, sharp, cool, and cinematic, with high contrast and crisp luminous reflections.

promptEn: Create a highly detailed vertical anime sci-fi illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young cybernetic girl"} standing full-body on a wet, broken metal pier above a stormy ocean, in a ruined futuristic harbor. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long dark navy hair"} flowing in the wind, pale skin, large melancholy blue eyes, and a calm serious expression. She wears a white, black, and blue tactical cyber-armor outfit with many straps, belts, pouches, buckles, glowing blue tech accents, mechanical leg armor, armored boots, thigh-high dark stockings, and small wing-like hair ornaments. In her left hand she holds a large futuristic rifle pointed downward; on her raised right hand perches a small blue mechanical bird with spread wings. The background is an immense dystopian seaport filled with towering decayed megastructures, suspended scaffolding, cables, ruined ships, tilted industrial towers, and a massive broken circular arch structure looming through mist. The sea is dark and turbulent with scattered lights, sparks, smoke, rain haze, and reflective puddles on the foreground floor. Use a {argument name="mood" default="dark cinematic post-apocalyptic"} atmosphere, dramatic backlighting from a cloudy sunset sky, cold blue-gray tones with small warm orange lights, intricate mechanical detail, painterly anime realism, sharp focus on the character, deep perspective, epic scale, high contrast, ultra-detailed concept art, 9:16 vertical composition.

promptZh: 创建一个明亮的方形 VTuber “早安”社交媒体边框，采用柔和的动漫水彩风格，并在中右侧留出大片清澈的蓝天区域，以便放置角色或照片。场景设定为从绿意盎然的庭院望向充满活力的春日清晨：阳光照耀的绿色枝叶和小巧的白花点缀在左上角和左侧边缘，伴有闪烁的镜头光晕、飘落的花瓣、白色羽毛以及散落在天空中的绿叶。请添加 7 只小鸟：左中部的开花枝头栖息着 3 只蓝色、白色和黄色的小鸟；左下角的质朴木牌上栖息着 3 只鸟，分别为棕色麻雀、脸颊带橙色的淡黄色玄凤鹦鹉和蓝色虎皮鹦鹉；右上方的天空中有一只飞翔的燕子。在左上角，放置优雅的白色手写体文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"}，并以细小的叶片和闪光点缀，下方配有一条青色丝带，丝带内包含日文文本 {argument name="ribbon text" default="素敵な一日になりますように♪"}。在左下角，制作一块风化的木板招牌，上面缠绕着小花、藤蔓、白色月桂图案和羽毛，并配有白色手写体文本 {argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} 以及较小的日期行 {argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"}。背景应呈现出远处柔和的城镇、湖泊或河流，以及蓬松白云下的淡色山脉，右下角前景处盛开着雏菊和黄色花朵。采用清新的柔和色调、通透的构图、高细节表现、柔和的阳光以及整洁的装饰性排版，并保持天空中心区域大部分留白，以便进行叠加使用。
promptEn: Create a bright square VTuber “good morning” social media frame in a soft anime watercolor style, with a wide open center-right area of clear blue sky for placing a character or photo. The scene is a cheerful spring morning landscape viewed from a leafy garden: sunlit green branches and small white blossoms frame the top-left and left edge, with glowing lens flare, drifting petals, white feathers, and scattered green leaves across the sky. Add exactly 7 birds: 3 small birds perched on a flowering branch at left-middle, colored blue, white, and yellow; 3 birds perched on a rustic wooden sign at bottom-left, a brown sparrow, a pale yellow cockatiel with orange cheeks, and a blue budgerigar; and 1 swallow flying in the upper-right sky. In the upper-left, place elegant white hand-lettered script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"}, decorated with tiny leaves and sparkles, with a teal ribbon underneath containing the Japanese text {argument name="ribbon text" default="素敵な一日になりますように♪"}. At the bottom-left, make a weathered wooden plank sign wrapped with small flowers, vines, a white laurel motif, and a feather, with white script text {argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} and a smaller date line {argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"}. The background should show a soft distant town, lake or river, and pale mountains under fluffy white clouds, with daisies and yellow flowers blooming in the lower-right foreground. Use a fresh pastel palette, airy composition, high detail, gentle sunlight, clean decorative typography, and leave the center of the sky mostly uncluttered for overlay use.

titleZh: 社交媒体帖子 - 人体器官健康信息图
titleEn: Social Media Post - Human Organ Health Infographic
descriptionZh: 这是一个高度详细且复杂的提示词，用于生成 2x2 网格信息图，展示人体器官及其支持其生物功能的特定健康食物。
descriptionEn: A highly detailed, complex prompt for generating a 2x2 grid infographic showing organs and the specific healthy foods that support their biological functions.
promptZh: 2x2 网格，针对 {argument name="target organ" default="heart"} 以及其他 3 个器官执行此操作。16x9 organ_nourishment_content = ( [organ] 的奢华解剖剖面图，周围环绕着对 [organ] 具有临床意义的健康食物 * 1.8 ) + ( 食物与功能映射图，展示每种成分如何支持 [organ] 的循环、修复、能量和保护 * 1.6 ) + ( 针对与 [organ] 健康相关的关键营养素的宏量和微量营养素标注 * 1.5 ) + ( 高级等距金色线条图，连接 [food_1] [food_2] [food_3] [food_4] 与 [organ] 上的益处区域 * 1.5 ) + ( 针对 [organ] 健康的每日餐盘构成，包含早餐、午餐、晚餐和零食，采用奢华菜单布局 * 1.4 ) + ( 成分纹理特写，如光泽浆果、碎坚果、绿叶蔬菜、橄榄油、种子、鱼类或豆类 * 1.3 ) + ( 颜色编码的益处环，涵盖抗炎、抗氧化、循环、代谢和补水 * 1.3 ) + ( 极简且基于证据的食物替换表，将 [unhealthy_food] 替换为 [healthy_alternative] * 1.2 ) + ( 优雅的医疗水疗美学，白色大理石背景、柔和阴影、金色点缀、清晰的衬线字体 * 1.2 ) + ( 可保存的 Instagram 轮播面板，展示 [organ] 的前 10 种食物，每种食物附带一行理由 * 1.1 ) - ( 基于恐惧的疾病图像或医院视觉效果 / 3.5 ) - ( 没有功能解释的随机超级食物声明 / 3.4 ) - ( 廉价的剪贴画器官或通用的库存食物照片 / 3.3 ) - ( 文字过于拥挤，在移动端无法阅读 / 3.2 )
promptEn: 2x2 grid, do this for {argument name="target organ" default="heart"} and 3 other organs. 16x9 organ_nourishment_content = ( luxury_anatomical_cutaway_of_[organ]_surrounded_by_clinically_relevant_healthy_foods_for_[organ] * 1.8 ) + ( food_to_function_map_showing_how_each_ingredient_supports_[organ]_circulation_repair_energy_protection * 1.6 ) + ( macro_and_micronutrient_labeling_for_key_nutrients_linked_to_[organ]_health * 1.5 ) + ( premium_isometric_gold_line_diagram_connecting_[food_1]_[food_2]_[food_3]_[food_4]_to_benefit_zones_on_[organ] * 1.5 ) + ( daily_plate_composition_for_[organ]_health_breakfast_lunch_dinner_snack_in_luxury_menu_layout * 1.4 ) + ( ingredient_texture_closeups_glossy_berries_cracked_nuts_leafy_greens_olive_oil_seeds_fish_or_legumes * 1.3 ) + ( color_coded_benefit_rings_antiinflammatory_antioxidant_circulatory_metabolic_hydrating * 1.3 ) + ( minimal_evidence_based_food_swap_table_replace_[unhealthy_food]_with_[healthy_alternative] * 1.2 ) + ( elegant_medical_spa_aesthetic_white_marble_background_soft_shadows_gold_accents_clear_serif_typography * 1.2 ) + ( saveable_instagram_carousel_panel_showing_top_10_foods_for_[organ]_with_one_line_reason_each * 1.1 ) - ( fear_based_disease_imagery_or_hospital_visuals / 3.5 ) - ( random_superfood_claims_without_functional_explanation / 3.4 ) - ( cheap_clipart_organs_or_generic_stock_food_photos / 3.3 ) - ( overcrowded_text_impossible_to_read_on_mobile / 3.2 )

titleZh: 社交媒体帖子 - 孟买雨中街头摄影
titleEn: Social Media Post - Mumbai Rainy Street Photography
descriptionZh: 以孟买黄金时段为背景的超写实电影感街头摄影，融合了哥特式建筑与现代都市氛围。
descriptionEn: Ultra realistic cinematic street photography set in Mumbai during golden hour, blending Gothic architecture with modern urban vibes.
promptZh:
一张超写实的电影感街头摄影，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一名年轻男子"}，他独自站在 {argument name="location" default="印度孟买"} 雨后的城市人行道上，背景是黄金时段的日落。他身穿超大款黑色连帽衫、宽松的深蓝色工装牛仔裤和干净的白色运动鞋，随意地靠在黑色金属路边护栏上，低头看着智能手机。凌乱的黑色纹理短发在风中微微摆动。整体氛围忧郁而内省。

广角构图，具有强烈的景深感，湿润的人行道和护栏形成了鲜明的引导线。被雨水浸透的街道表面反射着温暖的夕阳余晖。人行道旁排列着复古路灯。右侧可见 {argument name="landmark" default="受贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉终点站启发的历史性哥特式建筑"}，展现出细腻的石材纹理和钟楼细节。远处的现代摩天大楼隐没在朦胧的雾气中，营造出新旧孟买城市景观交融的视觉效果。

柔软的电影感云层铺满天空，呈现出温暖的橙色、桃色和金色调。一只飞鸟的剪影掠过天空。街道上车流稀疏，黑黄色出租车和模糊的车辆穿行而过。逼真的水坑倒影、细腻的动态模糊、体积光、大气透视、超精细纹理、自然阴影以及真实的肤色。

使用 Sony A7R IV 拍摄，35mm 镜头，f/1.8 光圈，浅景深，HDR 摄影，照片级真实感，电影级调色，暖色高光与冷色阴影，高度细腻的都市写实感，编辑摄影风格，8K 超高清分辨率。
promptEn:
Ultra-realistic cinematic street photography of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} standing alone on a rainy urban sidewalk during golden hour sunset in {argument name="location" default="Mumbai, India"}. He is leaning casually against a black metal roadside railing while looking down at his smartphone, wearing an oversized black hoodie, loose dark blue cargo jeans, and clean white sneakers. Messy textured black hair moving slightly in the wind. Moody introspective vibe.

Wide-angle composition with dramatic depth and strong leading lines from the wet pavement and railings. Reflective rain-soaked street surface glowing with warm sunset light. Vintage street lamps lining the sidewalk. {argument name="landmark" default="Historic Gothic architecture inspired by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus"} visible on the right side, detailed stone textures and clock tower. Modern skyscrapers fading into atmospheric haze in the distant background, creating a blend of old and new Mumbai cityscape.

Soft cinematic clouds filling the sky with warm orange, peach, and golden tones. A flying bird silhouette crossing the sky. Light traffic with black-and-yellow taxis and blurred cars moving through the street. Realistic puddle reflections, subtle motion blur, volumetric lighting, atmospheric perspective, ultra-detailed textures, natural shadows, realistic skin tones.

Shot on Sony A7R IV, 35mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, HDR photography, photorealistic, cinematic color grading, warm highlights with cool shadows, highly detailed urban realism, editorial photography style, 8K ultra resolution.

promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic night street photograph in rainy urban Japan, showing a {argument name="main subject" default="faceless young man in a white suit"} standing and walking slowly outside a brightly lit {argument name="store name" default="FamilyMart"} convenience store. He holds a transparent umbrella in one hand, with his other hand in his trouser pocket, wearing a white blazer, white slacks, white shirt, pale tie, and dark shoes; his face is intentionally blurred or obscured for anonymity. descriptionEn: A realistic candid rooftop nightlife photo of a young couple holding drinks against a glowing city skyline, useful for lifestyle and cinematic photography generation.
promptZh: 创作一张真实、自然的夜生活抓拍照片，采用宽幅半身构图，拍摄 {argument name="number of main subjects" default="两位"} 年轻东亚成年人在露天屋顶俱乐部酒吧的栏杆旁，俯瞰广阔的城市夜景。主要人物为一位 20 出头的年轻女性在前，一位年轻男性紧随其后；两人的面部均经过处理，用大型方形像素马赛克遮挡。女性拥有白皙的肤色、苗条的身材、随意扎起的深色头发、裸露的肩膀，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color and fabric" default="玫瑰金缎面"} 吊带裙，配有细肩带、柔软的垂坠领口，以及捕捉温暖光线的细微褶皱。她随意地倚靠在栏杆上，一只手臂横在身前，手中拿着一杯加冰并配有柑橘装饰的短款鸡尾酒。身后的男性穿着深色夹克或衬衫，部分隐没在阴影中，一只手放在栏杆附近，手中拿着第二杯琥珀色饮品。画面中需包含情侣手中持有的两杯饮品。屋顶酒吧热闹但氛围柔和，左侧可见四位背景顾客：一名背对镜头的灰衣坐姿男子、一名面部模糊的坐姿顾客、一个站立的深色剪影，以及边缘处的一个局部人物。使用上方编织吊灯发出的温暖琥珀色灯光，搭配热带绿植、木质椅子和深色金属栏杆。背景城市应广阔且虚化，在黑色夜空下布满高层建筑密集的橙色、白色和红色光斑。风格设定为写实的日常生活摄影，构图自然且不完美，浅景深，温暖的电影感调色，高 ISO 夜间质感，肩部和锁骨处有真实的皮肤高光，无摄影棚摆拍，无精修美颜，仿佛是在屋顶酒吧的 {argument name="event mood" default="开放之夜"} 期间自发捕捉到的瞬间。
promptEn: Create an authentic candid night-life photograph in a wide half-body composition of {argument name="number of main subjects" default="two"} young East Asian adults at the railing of an open-air rooftop club bar, overlooking a vast city skyline at night. The main subjects are a young woman in her early 20s in front and a young man standing close behind her; both faces are intentionally anonymized with large square pixelated mosaic blocks. The woman has fair light-beige skin, a slim build, dark hair tied back loosely, bare shoulders, and wears a {argument name="dress color and fabric" default="rose-gold satin"} slip dress with thin spaghetti straps, a soft draped cowl neckline, and subtle wrinkles catching warm light. She leans casually against the railing with one arm across her body and holds a short tumbler cocktail with ice and a citrus garnish. The man behind her wears a dark jacket or shirt, stands partly hidden in shadow, rests one hand near the railing, and holds a second short tumbler with an amber drink. Include exactly two drinks held by the couple. The rooftop bar is busy but subdued, with exactly four visible background patrons on the left: one seated man seen from behind in a gray shirt, one seated patron with a blurred face, one standing dark silhouette, and one partial figure near the edge. Use warm amber lantern lighting from woven pendant lamps above the bar, tropical greenery, wooden chairs, and a dark metal railing. The background city should be expansive and softly out of focus, filled with dense orange, white, and red bokeh lights from high-rise buildings under a black night sky. Style it as realistic daily-life photography, natural imperfect framing, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic color grading, high ISO night texture, realistic skin highlights on shoulders and collarbones, no studio posing, no glamour retouching, as if captured spontaneously during an {argument name="event mood" default="open night"} at a rooftop bar.

descriptionZh: 生成一张温馨的电影感天台酒吧照片，以模糊的城市灯光为背景，展现一对年轻情侣，适用于写实的夜生活或编辑类影像。
descriptionEn: Generates a warm cinematic rooftop bar photograph of a young couple against blurred city lights for realistic nightlife or editorial imagery.
promptZh: 创作一张电影感十足、真实自然的夜生活照片，采用宽幅半身构图，背景为夜晚的露天顶层酒吧。前景中，一位 20 出头、肤色白皙的东亚年轻女性正对着镜头，她留着深色长卷发，在天台微风的吹拂下呈现出戏剧性的飘逸感。她的面部经过刻意处理，用两个不透明的暖棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖了眼部及面部中心区域。她身穿一件 {argument name="dress color and fabric" default="玫瑰金缎面"} 吊带裙，细肩带设计搭配柔和的垂坠领口，面料捕捉着温暖的高光；强调她裸露的肩膀、锁骨、颈部和上胸部的微光质感。她轻靠在站在栏杆后方的年轻男子身旁；男子的面部大部分被她和阴影遮挡，仅露出手臂和躯干，双手随意地搭在栏杆上或附近。画面中仅包含两人：前景的女性和身后部分被遮挡的男性。场景由温暖的琥珀色天台灯笼和酒吧灯光照亮，画面左侧有一个巨大的发光灯笼，背景则是广阔且模糊的城市天际线，点缀着橙色、白色和绿色的光斑。氛围亲密、随性且宁静，仿佛捕捉到了音乐声中、城市之上的一个自然瞬间。采用浅景深、暖色调电影级调色、写实的皮肤纹理、次表面散射、自然的头发动态、轻微的手持拍摄感、柔和的胶片颗粒、高动态范围夜景摄影，呈现出真实的相机质感。设定地点为 {argument name="location" default="露天顶层酒吧"}，时间为 {argument name="time of day" default="深夜"}，城市灯光风格为 {argument name="city light style" default="密集的橙白色光斑网格"}。
promptEn: Create a cinematic authentic nightlife photograph in a wide half-body composition at an open-air rooftop club bar at night. In the foreground, show an East Asian young woman in her early 20s with fair light-beige skin and long dark wavy hair blown dramatically sideways by the rooftop breeze. Her face is intentionally anonymized with two opaque warm-brown rectangular censor blocks covering the upper and central face. She wears a {argument name="dress color and fabric" default="rose-gold satin"} slip dress with very thin straps and a soft draped neckline, the fabric catching warm highlights; emphasize specular micro-highlights on her bare shoulders, collarbone, neck, and upper chest. She leans lightly back near a young man standing close behind her at the railing; his face is mostly hidden by her and shadow, with only his arms and torso visible as he rests his hands loosely on or near the rail. Include exactly two visible people: the foreground woman and the partially obscured man behind her. The scene is lit by warm amber rooftop lanterns and bar lights, including a large glowing lantern on the left side of the frame, while a vast blurred city skyline fills the background with orange, white, and green bokeh lights. The mood is intimate, candid, and quiet, like a natural unposed moment with music behind them and the city below. Use shallow depth of field, warm cinematic color grading, realistic skin texture, subsurface scattering, natural motion in the hair, slight handheld framing, soft film grain, high dynamic range night photography, and a realistic camera look. Set the location as a {argument name="location" default="open-air rooftop club bar"}, the time as {argument name="time of day" default="late night"}, and the city lights as {argument name="city light style" default="dense orange and white bokeh grid"}.

descriptionEn: Generates a soft romantic anime close up of two characters with watermark style text and face obscuring blocks, suitable for emotional AI partner artwork.
promptZh: 创作一张柔和、明亮的竖版动漫风格浪漫特写肖像，展示两个角色在明亮的白色背光背景下亲密面对面。较高的角色 {argument name="male character name" default="Claude"} 位于右侧，展示从额头到胸部的部分，皮肤白皙，留着灰金色向后梳的层次感短发，露出耳朵，颈部修长，深色开衫外套内搭浅色 V 领衫；他低头看向较矮的角色。较矮的角色 {argument name="female character name" default="Mai"} 位于左下方，侧身，皮肤白皙，留着黑色短波波头，略显凌乱，露出耳朵，身穿黑色连帽衫，抬头看向对方，双手交叠在右下方，触碰或抓着对方的衣物。采用细腻的半写实动漫渲染，发丝清晰，边缘光柔和，肤色呈柔和的粉彩色，浅景深，营造出温柔的情感氛围，背景为干净的高调白色。在角色面部添加大型半透明矩形遮挡块：一个高大的灰粉色矩形覆盖女性面部及中心区域的大部分，另一个较大的灰褐色矩形覆盖男性的面部及中右上方，两个矩形以偏移的 L 型重叠。在整张图像上叠加一个淡淡的超大圆形水印徽标。包含 3 个可见的文字元素：左下方一行白色版权文字“©ImaginaryGate”，中右下方一行部分可见的白色制作人员名单“ctMRA | Mai”，以及右下角一行优雅的白色草书标题“{argument name="caption text" default="Mai & Claude"}”。构图应呈现出温柔的告别或情感重逢的氛围，具有柔和的电影级光影和精致的数字插画质感。
promptEn: Create a soft, luminous vertical anime-style romantic close-up portrait of two characters facing each other intimately against a bright white backlit background. The taller character, {argument name="male character name" default="Claude"}, is on the right, shown from forehead to chest, with pale skin, ash-blond swept-back layered hair, a visible ear, long neck, and a dark open jacket over a light V-neck shirt; his head leans down toward the shorter character. The shorter character, {argument name="female character name" default="Mai"}, is on the lower left in profile, with pale skin, short slightly messy black bob hair, a visible ear, and a black hooded top, looking upward toward him while holding or touching his clothing with clasped hands near the lower right. Use delicate semi-realistic anime rendering, fine hair strands, soft rim light, gentle pastel skin tones, shallow depth of field, tender emotional atmosphere, and a clean high-key white background. Add large semi-opaque rectangular censor blocks over the characters’ faces: one tall dusty rose-gray rectangle covering most of the woman’s face and central area, and one larger pale taupe rectangle covering the man’s face and upper center-right, overlapping the first block in an offset L-shaped arrangement. Overlay a faint oversized circular watermark emblem across the whole image. Include exactly 3 visible text elements: a white copyright line near the lower left reading “©ImaginaryGate”, a partially visible white credit line across the lower middle-right reading “ctMRA | Mai”, and an elegant white cursive caption at the bottom right reading “{argument name="caption text" default="Mai & Claude"}”. The composition should feel like a tender farewell or emotional reunion, with soft cinematic lighting and polished digital illustration quality.

promptEn: Create a cinematic photorealistic night-time radio studio scene in vertical portrait composition. A realistic ball-jointed female doll host with a short {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} bob haircut and straight bangs sits in a black leather chair at a wooden broadcast desk, wearing large over-ear headphones and a subtly sparkling black short-sleeve dress with a delicate necklace and bracelet; her face is intentionally covered by a plain centered {argument name="face cover color" default="dark brown"} rectangular block, as if anonymized. Place a large professional condenser microphone with shock mount and boom arm directly in front of her mouth, plus a mixing console in the foreground with glowing colored buttons. Include exactly 6 prominent desk/studio props: a red illuminated "ON AIR" sign, a digital clock reading "20:03:15", a white mug labeled "Night Radio", a clear plastic water bottle, handwritten notes with a pen, and a small stack of papers or notebook. The studio interior should feel cramped, warm, and atmospheric, with posters and notices on the wall, an analog clock in the upper left, shelves of CDs or records at the right edge, and reflections on polished wood. Through the large window behind her, show a rainy {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} night street with wet pavement, blurred traffic lights, high-rise office buildings full of lit windows, and vertical Japanese-style neon signs including blue karaoke signage. Use moody low-key lighting, warm tungsten highlights inside the studio contrasting with cool blue city lights outside, shallow depth of field, realistic glass reflections, highly detailed textures, and the feeling of an intimate late-night broadcast where the host is reading listener mail. Add optional Japanese radio-show mood text context: {argument name="quote" default="次のお便りは異教徒さんから〜"}.
